61f9dd96.title: Business Technology Solutions Manager- Salesforce Delivery
61f9dd96.description:
**ZS** 
 is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
 **bringing together data, science, technology** 
 and
 **human ingenuity** 
 to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side\-by\-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life\-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
 **client\-first mentality** 
 to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life\-changing impact to ZS.
   

  

 We are seeking a seasoned Salesforce professional with a deep understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem, particularly in the field of Salesforce Health Cloud. This individual will play a crucial role in expanding our Salesforce practice, driving digital transformation across various industries, with a special focus on healthcare. Our firm looks to leverage your innovative thinking and leadership to develop cutting\-edge business solutions that leverage AI and Analytics to deliver maximum value to our clients.
   

  

 The candidate will be part of our Salesforce Expertise practice. As a Salesforce expert, the candidate will draw on their skills and experience to lead defining salesforce related business solutions/sales plays; work with team(s) to develop ZS capabilities (including: selling collateral and assets/accelerators/demos); and take the offerings to ZS’ client to convert to real opportunities, supporting the entire lifecycle of engagements. To do so, you will need to deeply understand customer requirements, understand the salesforce.com ecosystem and work closely with functional specialists to develop innovative, cutting\-edge business solutions leveraging AI/Analytics to maximize the value to our clients. You will work closely with functional specialists to develop creative business solutions, solving some of the most exciting problems for our clients.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* End\-to\-End Delivery Management:
+ Deliver exceptional client service, ensuring projects stay within expected timeframes and budgets.
+ Review application and technical design documents, ensuring they follow Salesforce best practices and integrate effectively into the client's infrastructure.
+ Team and Capability Development:
+ Develop team skills and collaborate to create accelerators and assets that enhance our service offerings to clients.

* Offerings and Business Development:
+ Collaborate with ZS and industry experts to define integrated programs and offerings, taking them to market with the client service teams.
+ Lead large\-scale business development and delivery engagements, especially in the Healthcare sector.

* Mentoring and Coaching:
+ Provide on\-the\-job feedback and coaching to team members and actively participate in the counseling and mentoring of junior consultants within the organization.

* Solution Architecture and Design:
+ Collaborate with healthcare organizations to understand their business needs and design customized Salesforce Health Cloud solutions.
+ Lead the architecture and design of scalable, secure, and high\-performance Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.

* Technical Guidance and Quality Assurance:
+ Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, data models, and integration patterns.
+ Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices are followed for Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Bachelor's degree with major in Computers or Electronics.
* 10\+ years’ of overall professional experience; with at least 5 years in a leadership role within a professional services firm.
* Proven experience as a Salesforce Health Cloud Architect, designing and implementing solutions for healthcare organizations.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, including platform configuration, Visual Force, Lightning, Workflows, Apex, and AppExchange.
* In\-depth knowledge of healthcare data models and HIPAA regulations.
* Proficiency in shaping, providing consulting, building \& implementing solutions using Salesforce cloud offerings.
* Good understanding of DevOps as they apply to Salesforce, including various methodologies and tools such as Salesforce DX.
* Active Salesforce Certifications Architect is strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel to meet client needs.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Salesforce Certified System Architect.
* Proficiency in using MuleSoft and familiarity with other Salesforce cloud offerings like Sales, Service, Community, and Marketing Cloud.
* Working experience with Salesforce.com organization to leverage the ecosystem.
* The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of motivation, excellent problem\-solving skills, a strong work ethic, and executive\-level presence and communication.


**How you’ll grow:**
* Cross\-functional skills development \& custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s\-curves, individual contribution and role expansions


**Perks \& Benefits:**
 At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations \| Where we work \| ZS.
   

  

**Hybrid working model:**
 We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on\-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face\-to\-face connections.
   

  

**Travel:**
 Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client\-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
   

  

**Considering applying?**
 At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.
   

  

 If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.
   

  

 To complete your application:
   

  

 Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on\-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.
   

  

 NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.
   

  

 Find Out More At:
   

  

 www.zs.com

68dc8470.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
68dc8470.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

* As a Senior Technical Program Manager at Qualys, you will drive the execution of complex, cross\-functional programs at the intersection of Threat Research, Product, and Platform Engineering. You will own end\-to\-end program delivery, translate deep technical work into measurable business outcomes, and ensure operational excellence in a high\-velocity cybersecurity environment.


 This role demands strong technical acumen, rigorous execution discipline, and the ability to influence across engineering, research, and executive leadership.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Planning \& Execution**
* Define program scope, success criteria, and dependencies; create and execute detailed quarterly and multi\-quarter program plans.
* Drive on\-time delivery of complex technical initiatives across research, engineering, and platform teams.
* Own program governance, milestone tracking, and execution cadence, including sprint planning and reviews.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Act as the primary interface (“API”) between Threat Research, Product Management, Platform Engineering, and Executive stakeholders.
* Identify downstream dependencies early, negotiate timelines, and resolve conflicts to prevent execution bottlenecks.
* Hold engineering and research teams accountable to commitments while fostering strong collaboration and trust.
* Risk, Dependency \& Incident Management
* Proactively identify technical, operational, and delivery risks; define mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Translate technical blockers and security risks into clear business impact statements for leadership and product stakeholders.
* Demonstrate resilience and decisiveness in high\-pressure environments such as SOC, Threat Research, or Incident Response operations.
* Technical Ownership \& Domain Expertise
* Own and manage the Threat Research execution queue, ensuring alignment with product and platform priorities.
* Apply a strong understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape, including CVEs, CVSS scoring, exploit maturity (PoC vs. weaponized exploits), and vulnerability lifecycle.
* Ensure seamless handoff of research outputs into productization and engineering workflows.
* Metrics, Dashboards \& Reporting
* Define and track KPIs to measure program health, delivery performance, risk posture, and operational efficiency.
* Design, script, and maintain automated dashboards using tools such as JIRA, Salesforce, Tableau, APIs, SQL, or Python.
* Deliver clear, data\-driven insights to technical teams and executive leadership.
* Process Excellence \& Tooling
* Configure, maintain, and optimize program management tools (JIRA, Salesforce, Confluence) to support scalable execution.
* Drive continuous improvement of workflows, operating models, and Agile practices to enhance efficiency and quality.
* Own the team’s information architecture in Confluence, enforcing a “documentation\-first” culture—no operational process exists unless it is documented.
* Required Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or Project Management within technology\-driven organizations.
* Strong expertise in SDLC, Agile methodologies, and program execution at scale.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and reporting platforms.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, evolving, and high\-stakes environments.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Experience working in the cybersecurity domain, including vulnerability management, threat research, SOC, or incident response.
* Familiarity with SQL and/or Python for data extraction, analysis, and reporting.
* Experience supporting or leading programs involving security research, platform engineering, or cloud\-scale products.

16583eb1.title: Advanced Specialist, Program Manager
16583eb1.description:
**The opportunity** 



  

  


 Pearson is transforming how 160 million learners and thousands of employees experience AI — and we need someone to make that change land with people, not just on systems. This role leads enterprise AI change management for Pearson, owning the communities, content, and communications that turn our AI strategy into everyday action across every business unit.
 


  

  


 Reporting directly to the AI Strategy \& Governance lead in the AI Center for Enablement, you will be the S\&G function's authority on change management and AI literacy — working through influence across HR, Corporate communications, Brand, and Business Units.
 


  

  


**What you'll do** 



  

  
* **Lead change.** 
 Design and own Pearson's enterprise AI change management strategy — stakeholder analysis, readiness planning, and execution for major AI rollouts, governance changes, and tool adoptions.
  

  
* **Own the community.** 
 Build and run the AI Adoption Partners Programme — Pearson's embedded AI ambassador network — from role design and onboarding through curriculum, community management, and outcomes measurement (targeting ≥80% of partners reporting they feel equipped).
  

  
* **Build the content.** 
 Create persona\-based AI literacy resources — guides, toolkits, playbooks, and training — that make responsible AI accessible and motivating for every employee level and function.
  

  
* **Shape the narrative.** 
 Craft and coordinate the internal AI change communications calendar alongside Brand/CMC, translating complex AI strategy into clear, compelling narratives using Smart Brevity principles — ensuring messaging is concise, actionable, and easy to apply for executives, managers, and frontline staff.
  

  
* **Measure what matters.** 
 Track adoption health through KPI dashboards and surveys; synthesise insights; and report programme performance to senior leadership and the AI Strategy Council.
  

  
* **Work across the enterprise.** 
 Coordinate with HR, L\&D, Legal, and Business Unit leaders to align the adoption programme to Pearson's people strategy and ensure it scales across geographies.
  


  


**What you'll bring** 



  

  
* **Enterprise change ownership.** 
 You have designed, launched, and measured change programmes at scale in a large, complex organisation — you have owned programmes, not just supported them.
  

  
* **Methodology fluency.** 
 You know a structured change framework deeply — PROSCI ADKAR, Kotter, APMG, or equivalent — and can adapt it to AI and digital transformation contexts.
  

  
* **Community\-building.** 
 You have built and sustained ambassador networks, change champion cohorts, or adoption programmes that become more self\-sufficient over time.
  

  
* **Communication excellence.** 
 You translate technical or strategic complexity into clear, high\-impact narratives that drive action across all audiences. You apply Smart Brevity to cut through noise while maintaining accuracy, and you demonstrate exceptional attention to detail in everything you produce.
  

  
* **Precision and standards.** 
 You hold a high bar for quality — producing communications that are concise, consistent, and error\-free, with strong attention to detail and alignment to brand and governance standards.
  

  
* **Cross\-functional influence.** 
 You have coordinated across HR, L\&D, Communications, and Business Units in a matrixed environment, building alignment without formal authority.
  

  
* **AI literacy.** 
 You understand AI well enough to design credible content — conversant in AI tools, responsible use principles, and what good and poor AI adoption looks like in practice.
  


  


**It would be great if you also have** 



  

  
* PROSCI Certification (CCMP) or equivalent — APMG Change Management Practitioner, ACMP CCMP.
  

  
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise AI tools (Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot) or familiarity with AI governance frameworks (Responsible AI, NIST AI RMF).
  

  
* Experience designing digital or blended learning content, or working with LMS platforms.
  

  
* A background in education, EdTech, or another purpose\-driven, learner\-centred sector
  


  


**Who we are:** 



  

  


 At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.
 


  

  


 Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E\-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.
 


  

  


 If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

ae33890e.title: Junior Architect
ae33890e.description:
**About Company:**

Medigence Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a specialised healthcare consulting firm with a dedicated Hospital Planning \& Design vertical that has shaped some of India's most complex healthcare infrastructure projects— from concept and master planning through architectural drawings, interior designing, and MEP integration.

With 125\+ completed projects spanning 2 crore\+ sq ft of designed space, our portfolio is equally split across two domains — 50% healthcare and 50% non\-healthcare. Healthcare projects are led by **Medigence Solutions (https://medigence.global/hospital\-planning\-design\-portfolio/)**, while non\-healthcare projects — spanning commercial,resorts, villas, institutional, and mixed\-use developments — are managed under our sister company, **Levitant Global Design (https://levitant.global/levitant\-portfolio/)**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented fresher Architect to join our design team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in architectural design principles, drafting tools, and a passion for creating functional and aesthetically pleasing spaces. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to gain hands\-on experience across large scale diverse projects under the guidance of senior professionals.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in preparing architectural drawings, layouts, and 3D models under supervision
* Support site analysis and design development
* Prepare working drawings, construction details, and presentation materials
* Coordinate with senior architects, structural/MEP consultants, and contractors
* Conduct site visits to monitor construction progress and ensure design compliance
* Assist in preparing project documentation, BOQs, and material specifications
* Research building codes, zoning regulations, and sustainability standards
* Support in client presentations and design proposal preparation
* Stay updated with current architectural trends, materials, and construction techniques

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch) from a recognized institution
* Valid Council of Architecture (COA) registration (or eligibility to register)
* 0–1 year of experience (internship experience mandatory)

**Required Skills**

* Proficiency in AutoCAD and SketchUp
* Working knowledge of rendering tools (Blender, V\-Ray) is a plus
* Good understanding of building materials, construction methods, and codes
* Basic knowledge of sustainable design practices

**Desired Attributes**

* Willingness to learn and take on new challenges
* Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
* Willingness to grow within the organization and demonstrate a long\-term commitment.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

9fe443d6.title: Principal Program Manager
9fe443d6.description:
**Description**
 Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go\-to partner for the world’s most forward\-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting\-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI\-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI\-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.
   

  

**Overview**
 Synaptics is looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our Global Operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in semiconductor design and manufacturing processes, coupled with exceptional program management skills. As the ASIC Program Manager, you will oversee the entire product lifecycle from concept through production, working closely with cross\-functional teams including design, verification, validation, and manufacturing to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality ASICs. The successful candidate will play a key project leadership role, acting as the primary owner of SOC program execution on the project planning scheduling, inter\-team coordination, status tracking and reporting. Sr. Director, Program Management.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Competencies**
 Job Duties
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end program management of engineering programs from idea to mass production including planning, scoping, design, development, and change management
* Lead and coordinate all aspects of ASIC development programs from requirements gathering through to final product release, including design, verification, validation, and production rampup
* Work closely with internal engineering teams (ASIC design, firmware, validation, etc.), external partners, and vendors to manage deliverables and ensure alignment on project goals and schedules
* Support the teams in issue resolution and risk mitigation through well balanced and efficient processes leveraging tools and automation
* Actively support sustainable, effective cross\-functional communication at multiple levels in the organization
* Analyze technical issues and lead the team in generating creative mitigation options and solutions
* Act as the primary point of contact between engineering, product management, and senior leadership, providing regular status updates on program progress, issues, and risk management
* Monitor and manage the program budget, ensuring projects are delivered within financial constraints
* Manage relationships with operation team and external ASIC vendors, ensuring that they meet technical and delivery requirements
* Ensure proper documentation of program processes, designs, and decisions throughout the ASIC development lifecycle
* Drive continuous improvement of all processes, methodologies, and systems


 Competencies
   

  

* Well organized with strong attention to data and detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations
* Developing talent, ability to inspire and excite team
* Highly structured planner with a strong discipline towards pragmatic and efficient processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in agile execution and facilitating multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to synthesize and report complex matters simply for senior and executive management to grasp quickly
* Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team


**Qualifications (Requirements)**
* Bachelor's (Master’s preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent
* A deep understanding of ASIC design, verification, and manufacturing processes is essential.
* 15\+ years of experience in Program Management, including 5\+ years of expertise in engineering program management Experience in rigorous life\-cycle management including capturing requirements, decomposition, architecture, design, unit testing and integration testing among others
* Proven expertise in planning tools and methodologies (Jira, MS Project / SCRUM, waterfall)
* Hands\-on technical experience preferred
* No travel required


*Belief in Diversity
   

  

 Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*

3778f9e1.title: Solution Engineer - GCC (FSI)
3778f9e1.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 We are looking for world\-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting\-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.
   

  

 The Solution Engineer will work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer\-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof\-of\-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
   

  

***This is a hands\-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
 The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever\-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.

* Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits
* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking \- quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories \& case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake


**REQUIREMENTS:**
* Minimum 8\+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands\-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers
* Experience with large\-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)

**ADDED BONUS FOR:**

 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

72d7966d.title: Lead Architect
72d7966d.description:
**Job Description:**
 AI Solutions Lead/AI (Associate) Architect
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking an AI Solutions Lead to architect, govern, and grow our AI delivery practice across GenAI, Agentic AI, and applied ML engagements. This is a hands\-on and hybrid role that includes architecting AI solutions and shaping the growth of the AI practice. This role is suited for someone who has earned technical fluency with GenAI and agentic AI on top of a strong foundation in classical ML and deep learning — and who is now ready to set the technical direction for a growing team.
   

  

 The role is a hybrid lead position: leading solutions for multiple AI delivery pods, partnering with engineering and DX leadership, and owning the craft of the practice — driving solution architectures, evaluation standards, reusable components, and the technical bar for the AI delivery team.
 **The expectation** 
 is depth and breadth showcased across the portfolio of AI work done so far, preferably in multimodal agentic systems, SLM design, ML and DL solutions, and enterprise deployments, while consistently raising the standards at which the team operates.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Solution Architecture \& Technical Direction
   

  

* Translate business problems from clients into staged, defensible AI solution roadmaps working with business leaders through pre\-sales and project delivery cycles.
* Lead solutioning, support architecture for end\-to\-end AI solutions across GenAI, Agentic AI, multimodal, and applied ML use cases, with explicit trade\-off analysis on model class (frontier vs. SLM vs. fine\-tuned), retrieval design, memory, and orchestration.
* Own the practice's reference architectures and solution design patterns for multimodal agentic systems, including planning, tool use, memory, grounding, and inter\-agent communication (MCP, A2A).
* Conduct solution design reviews across concurrent client engagements; facilitate subjective technical decisions and enable delivery excellence.


 Multimodal Agentic Systems \& SLM Design
   

  

* Design and lead the build of multi\-agent systems with reasoning, planning, tool use, persistent memory, and grounded retrieval.
* Guide multimodal system design across text, vision, speech, and structured data, including ingestion, representation, and downstream agent reasoning.
* Establish patterns for SLM design and adoption — distillation, fine\-tuning, quantization, and routing — to meet enterprise constraints on cost, latency, data residency, and on\-prem/edge deployment.
* Define hybrid retrieval and knowledge architectures spanning vector, graph (KG), and NoSQL stores; lead KG\-assisted retrieval, entity linking, and structured grounding.


 Eval, Guardrails \& Production Quality
   

  

* Establish evaluation as a first\-class discipline: design eval frameworks, golden datasets, regression suites, automated and human\-in\-the\-loop evals, and observability for agentic and generative systems.
* Define and enforce safety, guardrail, and hallucination\-control standards across the practice; lead red\-teaming and adversarial testing for high\-stakes deployments.
* Set the bar for production readiness — reliability, latency, cost, monitoring, drift detection, and incident response — for AI systems in regulated, enterprise\-grade environments.
* Drive enterprise deployment best practices across cloud hyper\-scalers, on\-prem, and edge, including GPU/accelerator ops, model serving, and lifecycle automation.


 Practice Building \& Technical Mentorship \-
   

  

* Shape the practice's capability roadmap: which techniques to invest in, which to retire, and how the team stays at the leading edge of GenAI and agentic AI.
* Mentor AI Engineers and Lead AI Engineers; run technical reviews, pairing sessions, and internal knowledge exchange on agentic, multimodal, and SLM topics.
* Set the technical hiring bar; lead architecture and senior engineering interviews and calibrate the team's evaluation standards.
* Establish and promote AI in SDLC frameworks on delivery projects


 Cross\-functional Leadership \& Delivery
   

  

* Partner with engineering, data science, product, and DX leadership on delivery and acceleration initiatives
* Engage with client and stakeholder leadership on architecture, feasibility, and risk; communicate technical direction clearly to non\-technical audiences.
* Support pre\-sales and solutioning for new GenAI and Agentic AI opportunities, including effort estimation, architectural framing, and capability storytelling.


**Required Technical Skills –**
* Programming \& Engineering: Python (advanced), SQL; strong API and backend engineering in FastAPI/Flask/Django; production\-grade software practices.
* Generative AI: LLMs and SLMs, RAG/Agentic RAG, multimodal architectures, agents, prompt engineering, grounding, knowledge graphs, fine\-tuning (SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, RLHF/RLAIF), distillation, and quantization.
* Agentic AI: Multi\-agent orchestration, planning, tool use, persistent memory, MCP and A2A patterns; frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen.
* Eval \& Safety: Eval framework design, golden datasets, automated and human evals, red\-teaming, guardrails, hallucination control, observability for AI systems.
* Machine Learning \& Deep Learning: Predictive modeling, deep learning (CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, Transformers), embeddings, vector search, classical ML; CV, NLP, and time\-series exposure.
* Cloud, MLOps \& Deployment: AWS, Azure, or GCP at depth; model serving, GPU/accelerator ops, CI/CD, monitoring, on\-prem and edge deployment patterns.
* Data Engineering: Kafka, Spark/Flink, Hadoop, MongoDB and other NoSQL/graph/vector stores; large\-scale streaming and batch pipelines.
* Math Foundations: Linear algebra, probability, statistics, optimization.
* Experience with commerce cloud ecosystems (good to have) – Salesforce and Adobe


**Experience Requirements –**
* 10–12 years of hands\-on experience building and deploying ML, DL, and AI systems in production, with progression into solution architecture and technical leadership
* 10\+ years of demonstrable experience working with global businesses, delivering on large accounts
* 3\+ years of demonstrable hands\-on work in GenAI and/or Agentic AI — beyond prompt engineering and basic RAG — including multi\-agent systems, custom fine\-tuning, multimodal pipelines, or SLM\-based deployments.
* Proven track record of architecting and shipping AI systems in enterprise\-grade environments, including regulated or high\-stakes domains.
* 3\+ Experience leading ML\-AI technical pods or teams (formal or dotted\-line), mentoring senior engineers, and setting hiring and review standards.


 Attitude \& Mindset
   

  

* You must have an architect's mindset and equipped with a builder's hands.
* You must be agile and current — actively in the thick of GenAI and agentic developments, learning and shipping at the pace the field demands, with strong fundamentals and understanding of the domain
* Excellent communicator — able to explain agentic, multimodal, and SLM trade\-offs clearly to engineering peers, business stakeholders, and clients.
* Open and flexible toward a hybrid work structure with no less than 3 days work from office — to ensure regular connection and cross\-project knowledge exchange across the AI practice.


 Skills Matrix
   

  

**Skill Category**
**AI Solutions Lead**
 Solution Architecture
   

  

 Owns reference architectures across multiple concurrent AI engagements; sets patterns for agentic, multimodal, and SLM\-based systems.
   

  

 Transformers \& Deep Learning
   

  

 Deep practical grounding in transformers, fine\-tuning (SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, RLHF/RLAIF), distillation, quantization, and SLM design for cost/latency\-bound deployments.
   

  

 Generative AI (LLMs \& Multimodal)
   

  

 Designs hybrid multimodal RAG, KAG, and grounded\-generation systems; selects the right model class (frontier vs. SLM vs. fine\-tuned) per use case.
   

  

 Agentic Frameworks
   

  

 Architects multi\-agent orchestration, planning, memory, tool use, and inter\-agent communication patterns including MCP and A2A.
   

  

 Eval, Safety \& Guardrails
   

  

 Establishes evaluation frameworks, hallucination control, red\-teaming, regression suites, and observability as a first\-class engineering discipline.
   

  

 Information Retrieval \& Knowledge
   

  

 Designs hybrid dense–sparse retrieval, ranking, KG\-augmented retrieval, and unified knowledge layers across vector, graph, and NoSQL stores.
   

  

 Predictive \& Classical ML
   

  

 Strong foundation in classical ML and DL (CV, NLP, time\-series, GNNs); able to choose non\-GenAI approaches when they fit better.
   

  

 Conversational AI
   

  

 Architects multi\-turn, multilingual, multimodal dialogue systems with grounded responses and structured evaluation.
   

  

 Model Deployment
   

  

 Drives enterprise deployment patterns — cloud, on\-prem, and edge — including GPU/accelerator ops, scaling, CI/CD, and lifecycle automation.
   

  

 Cloud \& MLOps
   

  

 End\-to\-end model and agent lifecycle on AWS/Azure/GCP; cost, latency, and reliability optimization at production scale.
   

  

 Data Engineering \& Pipelines
   

  

 Designs streaming and batch pipelines (Kafka, Spark, Flink) and the data foundations that production AI systems depend on.
   

  

 Practice Leadership
   

  

 Sets the technical bar for hiring, mentoring, code/architecture reviews, and reusable IP; grows the AI practice as a craft.
   

  

**Location:**
 DGS India \- Bengaluru \- Manyata H2 block
   

  

**Brand:**
 Merkle
   

  

**Time Type:**
 Full time
   

  

**Contract Type:**
 Permanent\#DGS

The DCIM Delivery Manager coordinates multidisciplinary activities associated with the AVEVA and Honeywell Niagara Centers of Excellence, supporting pre‑commissioning and commissioning activities for Equinix critical infrastructure construction projects worldwide.
   

  

 The role is accountable for delivering DCIM and DCOS outcomes to operations at Ready for Service (RFS), ensuring solutions are implemented in line with Equinix global standards, with a strong focus on quality, consistency, and operational readiness.

 DCIM \& DCOS Delivery

* Act as the primary point of contact for the Centers of Excellence on AVEVA and Honeywell Niagara platforms
* Partner with GOE to track product updates and ensure timely and appropriate adoption within GDC projects

* Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills with strong attention to detail

14926b47.title: Senior Architect / Interior Designer – Client Handling & Sales
14926b47.description:
**Location:** Pune  
**Experience:** 8\+ Years  
**Salary:** ₹10–15 LPA\+ post\-probation, depending on performance and overall fit

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and highly capable **Senior Architect / Interior Designer** to take ownership of commercial and interior projects from the very first client interaction through to successful project delivery.

This is a **client\-facing, business\-oriented, and execution\-focused role**. The selected candidate will not only be responsible for design and project execution but will also play an active role in **client acquisition, relationship management, requirement understanding, proposal discussions, and sales conversion**.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing the complete project lifecycle independently and acting as a key point of contact between the client, internal teams, vendors, and site execution teams.

Key ResponsibilitiesClient Handling \& Sales

* Handle clients from the initial enquiry and first interaction through project closure and handover.
* Understand client requirements, budgets, business needs, and project expectations.
* Conduct client meetings, presentations, discussions, and site visits.
* Develop strong client relationships and maintain regular communication throughout the project lifecycle.
* Actively participate in converting enquiries into confirmed projects.
* Support business development and sales efforts through effective consultations, presentations, and solution\-oriented discussions.
* Prepare and present design concepts, proposals, layouts, material recommendations, and project estimates in coordination with the team.
* Negotiate and coordinate with clients to help drive project closure.

Design \& Project Development

* Lead the design process from concept development to detailed design and execution.
* Prepare or oversee space planning, layouts, working drawings, BOQs, specifications, and other project documentation.
* Develop creative, practical, and commercially viable interior solutions.
* Coordinate with designers, architects, consultants, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure designs align with client requirements, budget, timelines, functionality, and execution feasibility.

Project \& Site Execution

* Take ownership of projects from **day one until final site delivery**.
* Conduct site surveys and coordinate project requirements before execution.
* Plan and monitor project schedules, milestones, materials, vendors, and site activities.
* Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, fabrication teams, and site supervisors.
* Regularly visit project sites to monitor progress, quality, and timelines.
* Identify and resolve design, execution, coordination, and client\-related issues proactively.
* Ensure timely project completion while maintaining expected quality standards.
* Manage client expectations and provide regular project updates.
* Oversee final handover and ensure client satisfaction.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field**.
* **Minimum 8\+ years of relevant professional experience**.
* Strong experience in independently handling clients and managing multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong understanding of interior design, space planning, materials, finishes, and project execution.
* Ability to balance **creative design, client expectations, commercial requirements, and execution realities**.
* Experience in preparing layouts, presentations, drawings, BOQs, and project\-related documentation.
* Strong ownership mentality and ability to independently manage projects.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and project/site visits as required.

**Experience in commercial interiors, office interiors, retail, hospitality, or turnkey interior projects will be highly appreciated, but is not mandatory.**

Compensation \& BenefitsProbation Period

* **3 months probation period.**
* Salary during probation will be decided based on the candidate's **relevant experience, previous compensation, demonstrated capabilities, and overall fit for the role**.
* Performance during probation will be evaluated based on factors including client handling, sales contribution, project ownership, design capabilities, execution management, and overall performance.

Post\-Probation Package

* Upon successful completion of probation, the annual CTC will be in the range of **₹10–15 LPA or above**, depending on the candidate's performance, contribution, capabilities, and business impact.

Expense Reimbursement

The company will reimburse legitimate and approved expenses related to:

* Project and site visits
* Client meetings
* Local project\-related travel
* Other necessary business and project\-related expenses

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who thinks like an **owner**, not someone limited to only designing or only visiting sites. This role is ideal for a senior professional who can confidently manage the complete journey—from receiving and developing a client opportunity to understanding requirements, creating solutions, supporting the sales process, coordinating execution, managing the client relationship, and ultimately delivering the completed project.

If you are a **senior architect or interior designer with strong client\-handling skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to take complete ownership of projects**, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹150,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Shield AI is a venture\-backed defense\-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V\-BAT and X\-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Shield AI is seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer based in New Delhi to support technical capture and pre\-sales engagement for the X\-BAT and V\-BAT aircraft platforms in India. This role will serve as the in\-country technical lead for Business Development, bridging Indian MoD operational requirements with Shield AI’s product roadmap. The ideal candidate has prior experience at a major defense prime (US OEM) in roles spanning engineering, technical sales, program management, or advanced capture, with exposure to tactical jet aircraft, CCA/ACA concepts, or Group 3/4/5 UAS programs. This individual will focus on shaping opportunities within the Indian market, supporting Go To Market of tactical aircraft, crafting proposal documentation, and providing technical expertise. This individual will also cross\-train in Shield AI’s other products to support integrated solution discussions.
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Lead X\-BAT and V\-BAT technical capture efforts for Indian opportunities, ensuring solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with Shield AI’s product roadmap.
* Capture efforts will focus on Aircraft, but will require familiarity with the entire Shield AI Product suite.
* Manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, including customer engagements, pre\-sales technical support, proposal contributions, and solution development.
* Develop and execute technical strategies that result in high\-quality, compliant, and compelling proposals to maximize win probability.
* Serve as the primary technical lead for Go To Market (GTM) engagements in India, interfacing cross\-functionally with BD, BD Operations , Engineering, Operations, Program Management, and Product Management to ensure customer needs are met.
* Manage technical content for proposals, requests for information (RFIs), white papers, and capability briefs, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and compliance.
* Support early\-phase acquisition activities (concept notes, requirements drafts, unsolicited proposals).
* Shape early operational concepts aligned to X\-BAT and/or V\-BAT capabilities.
* Support BD and Account Executives by becoming a Subject Matter Expert in Shield AI products, providing technical expertise in customer engagements, capability briefings, and solution discussions to drive successful sales outcomes.
* Act as a liaison between BD and Engineering, and the Indian Go to Market team and the U.S. based product team, ensuring that new customer requests are technically feasible and align with product capabilities, timelines, and roadmaps.
* Contribute to the technical documentation repository, maintaining capability briefs, specifications, FAQs, and other sales collateral for internal and external use.
* Provide training and mentorship to BD teams on technical aspects of Shield AI’s solutions, enabling them to articulate our value proposition confidently.
* Support competitive analysis and market intelligence specific to the Indian tactical aircraft market, ensuring the BD team remains informed on industry trends and competitor capabilities.
* Contribute to process improvement efforts, leveraging lessons learned from customer engagements to refine BD workflows and technical capture strategies.
* Analyze the unique operational and environmental factors of the assigned region, producing high\-impact white papers and briefs that inform the product roadmap and drive solutions aligned to customer mission needs.


**Required qualifications:**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical sales, capture, engineering, or program management within defense or aerospace industries.
* Demonstrated familiarity with Indian Ministry of Defence procurement processes and military force structures.
* Prior experience at a major defense prime (US OEM or equivalent) supporting tactical aircraft, CCA/ACA, or Group 3/4/5 UAS programs.
* Experience interfacing with government or military acquisition stakeholders.
* Strong systems\-level understanding of aircraft design tradeoffs, operational CONOPS, and mission\-based engineering.
* Proven ability to translate technical concepts into compelling narratives for senior stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, applied science, or related technical discipline.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast\-paced, evolving startup environment.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience supporting international defense sales or industrial partnerships.
* Familiarity with offset strategies and Make\-in\-India requirements.
* Background in autonomy, AI\-driven systems, or networked ISR.
* Experience contributing to early\-phase design or conceptual aircraft programs.
* Prior military service experience (Indian or allied forces).
* Advanced degree in engineering, aerospace, systems engineering, or business.
* 5\+ years of experience in an presales/solutions engineering role 3\+ years of experience working in a startup environment.
* Demonstrated understanding of specific MOD operational scenarios and systems.


**Why join Shield AI:**
* Help build the defining defence technology company of this century.
* Work at the forefront of AI, autonomy, and next\-generation defence systems.
* Operate in a highly entrepreneurial and mission\-driven environment.
* Make a direct impact on international growth and strategic defence partnerships.
* Collaborate with exceptional teams solving some of the world’s most complex operational challenges.

19d65226.title: Senior Presales Consultant
19d65226.description:
**Job Description**
 MTX Group Inc. (MTX) is currently hiring for the position of
 **Senior Presales Consultant** 
 with strong multi\-cloud expertise and hands\-on Salesforce knowledge. The ideal candidate will design and propose scalable, secure, and cost\-efficient technical solutions across diverse technology ecosystems—including Salesforce, AWS, Azure, and integration/middleware platforms—without vendor bias.
   

  

 This role bridges sales, delivery, and engineering, bringing deep technical insight, excellent communication skills, and strong solution\-design capabilities to the RFx process.
   

  

 MTX is a global technology consulting firm that enables organisations to modernise through digital transformation. With data as the new currency, MTX helps transform long\-term strategy with outcomes in mind around happiness, health and the economy. MTX improves decision\-making with speed and quality by partnering with leading cloud technologies. MTX provides expertise across various platforms and technologies, including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Salesforce, artificial intelligence/machine learning, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, visualization, and mobile technology.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 The Senior Pre\-Sales Consultant is expected to lead large\-scale/complex project(s), executing the following responsibilities:
   

  

 Client, Sales \& RFx Engagement:
   

  

* Lead the analysis of RFI/RFP/Tender documents to understand customer pain points, objectives, technical landscape, and constraints.
* Summarize bid details: agency background, contract duration, contract value, scope of work, user journeys, and design\-critical considerations.
* Participate in internal stakeholder/client meetings, discovery/business domain understanding workshops, requirement\-gathering sessions and existing client portal research..
* Collaborate with internal sales (including Salesforce PSS) and delivery teams to align solution direction and ensure feasibility.
* Support creation of Functional \& Technical Requirement Traceability Matrices.


 Solution Design \& Architecture (Platform\-Agnostic):
   

  

* Architect multi\-cloud, hybrid, and on\-premise solutions that meet functional, technical, security, and compliance requirements.
* Recommend best\-fit technology stacks—Salesforce or otherwise—based purely on customer needs and evaluation criteria.
* Create high\-level and detailed technical architecture diagrams, data flow models, and integration patterns.
* Translate requirements into epics, modules, feature lists, and high\-level solution blueprints.
* Apply modern architectural principles: microservices, API\-led integration, event\-driven frameworks, serverless, containerization, and cloud\-native patterns.


 Technical Expertise \& Ecosystem Knowledge:
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings broad technical versatility, including:
   

  

 Salesforce Ecosystem:
   

  

* Core technologies: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning (Aura/LWC), SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce APIs.
* Clouds: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Einstein.
* Integration: MuleSoft (API\-led connectivity), Dell Boomi, Informatica, Jitterbit, and other middleware platforms.
* DevOps \& CI/CD: Copado, Gearset, Bitbucket/Jenkins/GitHub Actions.
* Security \& governance: OAuth, SSO, profiles/permissions, event monitoring.
* Salesforce PSS engagement for deep technical validation \& alignment with product roadmap.


 Third Party Integrations:
   

  

* Document generation: Adobe DocGen, Conga, DocuSign Gen, Nintex.
* E\-signature: DocuSign, Adobe Sign, Zoho Sign.
* Storage/Content: SharePoint, Google Drive, AWS S3, OneDrive, Box.
* SMS/Communication: AWS End User Messaging, Twilio, Whatsapp APIs, Netcore.
* Monitoring/Logging: Splunk, Datadog, ELK.
* Analytics/BI: Tableau, Power BI, CRM Analytics.


 Cloud \& Application Stack:
   

  

* AWS, Azure, GCP (optional) cloud services.
* Databases: SQL, NoSQL.
* Programming: Java, Python, Node.js (advantage).
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes.
* AI/ML model usage \& LLM\-based solutioning.


 Estimation, Planning \& Financial Modelling
   

  

* Prepare accurate estimates for functional work, integrations, data migration, and system complexity.
* Develop implementation timelines, resource/staffing plans, and project roadmaps.
* Create margin analysis, cost breakdowns, and pricing models.
* Collaborate with sales and delivery leadership for approvals and validation.


 Technical Proposal \& Documentation
   

  

* Draft and refine technical sections for RFIs, RFPs, proposals, and solution decks.
* Convert customer requirements into compelling technical narratives and business value propositions.
* Document design assumptions, architectural decisions, and solution trade\-offs.
* Ensure solutions meet scalability, security, compliance, and performance standards.


**What you will bring:**
* 5–8 years of experience in Pre\-Sales, Solution Design, or Architecture roles.
* Strong multi\-cloud and Salesforce experience, including deep hands\-on understanding of integrations and ecosystem tools.
* Ability to convert requirements into modular solution components and architectural blueprints.
* Excellent communication skills to simplify complex concepts for business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with technical writing, prompt engineering, and AI\-assisted solutioning.
* Proven experience participating in large\-scale RFx processes and cross\-functional collaboration.


**What we offer:**
* Group Medical Insurance (Family Floater Plan \- Self \+ Spouse \+ 4 Dependent Children)
+ Sum Insured: INR 5,00,000/\-
+ Maternity cover upto two children
+ Cashless \& Reimbursement facility
+ Access to free online doctor consultation

* Personal Accident Policy (Disability Insurance) \-
+ Sum Insured: INR. 25,00,000/\- Per Employee
+ Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disability is covered up to 100% of Sum Insured
+ Permanent Partial Disability is covered as per the scale of benefits decided by the Insurer
+ Temporary Total Disability is covered

* Optional Food Wallet (up to Rs. 2500 per month)
+ Offered as a tax saver component
+ Part of the special allowance component in the CTC

* Monthly Internet Reimbursement of upto Rs. 1,000
* Professional Development opportunities through various MTX\-sponsored certifications on multiple technology stacks, including Salesforce, Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS \& other

8343eba1.title: Solutions Consultant
8343eba1.description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges \-\- we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes \-\- apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
 At Sovos, we deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that power global tax compliance for some of the world’s largest organizations. As a Solution Consultant, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting system\-to\-system integrations between Sovos platform, client ERP \& third\-party applications.
   

  

 This role is a client\-facing and integration\-focused. You will act as the technical owner of implementation projects, leading requirement gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, go live and hypercare. Collaboration with clients, external integration partners and internal technical teams is key to ensuring seamless integration \& successful project completion.
   

  

**More Specifically, You Will**
* Be the primary technical point of contact throughout the project lifecycle, providing technical support and guidance throughout the project lifecycle
* Collaborate with Client technical, functional \& Sovos project teams, outlining and designing Sovos products to the project scope.
* Gather \& analyse business and technical requirements from clients, translating them into effective solution and integration designs.
* Complete solution design and architecture documents which includes all configuration details and any other necessary information to support Client and Sovos implementations.
* Design and implement API\-based integrations (REST/SOAP) between Sovos platforms and client ERP systems.
* Analyse the structure and definition of our customers integration data files and map their fields/data to Sovos internal data structure according to project scope.
* Validate data flows, mappings, and transformations between source and target systems to ensure accuracy and reliability.
* Coordinate with client, internal teams and integration partners to ensure timely project delivery and resolve any issues that may arise by following internal escalation and procedures
* Ensure integrations adhere to security, compliance and performance standards as required by Sovos and its clients.
* Must be capable of leading fast\-paced work sessions with internal and/or client’s teams to come up with solutions to solve project problems within Sovos products capabilities and project scope.
* Understanding the impact of individual task completion on the overall project schedule.
* Excellent understanding of Sovos product and capabilities.
* Provide training as necessary to clients in relation to Sovos Products.
* Identify and implement improvements to processes, documents, tools, reports, etc. to benefit and improve Sovos project team and new Client’s implementation processes.
* Perform SIT (System Integration Testing) \& UAT (Users Acceptance Testing) according to Sovos products configurations and project implementation plan.


**What We Need From You**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or similar.
* 5\+ years of experience in system integration, or, enterprise application integration in customer facing role
* Knowledge of development languages, ability to read and understand code, to analyse rules/conditions and data mappings (C\# or similar)
* Good understanding of ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms.
* Solid hands\-on experience with REST and SOAP APIs, covering authentication, error handling, and retries.
* Experience in systems \& data integration, data structure and data mappings with strong knowledge of system architecture, data flows and integration patterns.
* Experience with JSON, XML, and data mapping/transformation techniques.
* Experience in Electronic Invoicing, Billing, Systems Integration, Invoicing Systems (ERP) projects an added advantage.
* Excellent English communications skills (verbal and written)
* Strong critical thinking skills and a solution\-oriented mindset.
* Strong time management, organizational and decision\-making skills.
* Interact effectively with teammates, colleagues and Client’s.
* Comprehend and communicate complex concepts.
* Concentrate, analyse and resolve complex problems.


 The tools to enhance your life \- because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
   

  

* 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with flexibility to work remotely for the remaining days
* Opportunity to work with a global organization and gain international exposure
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
* Mentoring Programs and career development opportunities
* Globally recognized Training and Development programs
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage
* Collaborative work environment with modern tools and technologies
* Opportunity to be part of a newly acquired entity and shape its growth journey


**Our Recruitment Process**
 We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what a typical process will look like:
   

  

 Stage 1: CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) and EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
   

  

 Stage 2: Automated Video Interview
   

  

 Stage 3: Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or key stakeholders
   

  

 Stage 4: Final Interview
   

  

 Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
   

  

**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose\-built for always\-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT\-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud\-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.
   

  

 More than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries \-\- including half the Fortune 500 \-\- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter

2416cd84.title: Sitecore Architect
2416cd84.description:
**Req ID:** 386749
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Sitecore Architect to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

Title \-Senior Staff Engineer (Grade 11\)
  
  

**Who we are:**  

NTT DATA America strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. Launch by NTT DATA is the culmination of the company’s strategy to acquire and integrate the skills, experience, and technology of leading digital companies, backed by NTT DATA’s core capabilities, global reach, and depth.
  
  

**How You’ll Help Us:**  

Our clients need digital solutions that will transform their business so they can succeed in today’s hypercompetitive marketplace. As a team member in our Content Platforms practice, you will make these digital solutions come to life. You will routinely deliver elite solutions to clients that will impact their products, customers, and services.
  
  

**How We Will Help You:**  

Joining our Content Platforms practice is not only a job, but a chance to grow your career. We will make sure to equip you with the skills you need to produce robust applications that you can be proud of. Whether it is providing you with training on a new programming language or helping you get certified in a new technology, we will help you grow your skills so you can continue to deliver increasingly valuable work.
  
  

**Why the Role is Important:**  

Engineers are the core of everything we create, and their work is instrumental in our success. Our goal is to be the foremost consulting firm that businesses consider partnering with for their technological needs, and our strongest evidence of success lies in the effective solutions developed by our engineers. Engineers’ design efforts will guarantee the delivery of comprehensive and efficient business solutions. Furthermore, their expertise will prove invaluable during the pre\-sales phase, significantly enhancing our prospects for securing new work. Lastly, engineers’ leadership contributes to the professional growth of less experienced engineers, ultimately resulting in a stronger and more capable team.
  
  

**Once You Are Here, You Will:**  

* Lead client discovery sessions, document solution requirements, and offer optimal solutions.
* Question requirements and proposed solutions, providing better alternatives with pros and cons.
* Assist with the architecture and configuration of development environments and deployment procedures.
* Contribute as a strong individual contributor, working within timelines and budgets to meet or exceed project success criteria.
* Collaborate effectively with multiple NTT DATA and client teams.
* Develop high\-level architecture and technical designs for Sitecore\-based solutions, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
* Contribute thought leadership, provide mentorship, perform systems analysis, architecture, design, configuration, testing, debugging, and documentation.
* Design and implement leading\-edge Sitecore solutions and integration with other systems and applications.
* Support Agile teams with planning, scoping, and creation of technical solutions for the new product capabilities, through continuous delivery to production.
* Mentor developers, conduct code reviews, and ensure adherence to Sitecore Helix principles and best practices.
* Ensure Sitecore implementations align with security best practices, GDPR, and other compliance requirements.
* Manage multiple projects in parallel when needed, effectively balancing workloads to ensure the success of all projects.


**Required Qualifications:**  

* 10 to 12 years’ development experience in Sitecore (10\.x, 9\.x) and C\#/ASP.NET
* Hands\-on experience with Sitecore 10\.x\+, Sitecore Headless implementation, Sitecore Content Hub, personalization.
* 8\+ years’ experience in .NET Core, C\#, ASP.NET MVC/Web API, GraphQL, JavaScript (React/Next.js/Angular).
* Strong understanding of Sitecore Helix architecture, SXA, and Headless Services.


**Preferred Experience:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in software development or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
* Sitecore MVP
* SCORE framework certified/trained.
* Experience with Composable DXP architectures and MACH principles (Microservices, API\-first, Cloud\-native, Headless)
* Exposure to AI/ML\-powered personalization in Sitecore
* Knowledge of containerized development approach, Docker, and Kubernetes
* Experience in JavaScript frameworks, Next.js, React, Vue, or Angular.
* Experience with the latest Sitecore product: XM Cloud, Personalize, Discover, Customer Data Platform, Digital Asset Management, Commerce, Send.
* Attended (and presented) at Meetup, Symposium, and other Sitecore user groups.
* Strong understanding of Sitecore Helix architecture, SXA, and Headless Services.
* Experience in Sitecore Experience Editor customization, EXM, xDB analytics, and marketing automation.
* Deep knowledge of Sitecore Workflows, Security, Multisite Multilingual capabilities.
* Strong experience in RESTful API development, OAuth, and integration with third\-party services
* Experience with Solr, Coveo Search, Redis, and other caching/indexing mechanisms
* Proven capabilities in Glass Mapper or other ORM tools
* Advanced proficiency in TDS and Unicorn
* Experienced with Sitecore upgrades, transforming, and migrating content from other platforms and older Sitecore versions.
* Expertise in CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) for Sitecore deployments.
* Experience deploying and managing Sitecore on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Sitecore Managed Cloud.
* Experience with source control systems, Azure DevOps Server, TFS, VSTS, Git
* Capable of leading up to two full client development teams (totaling 10\-15 people)
* Is expert in at least one platform, and proficient in a secondary platform
* Skilled in leading client communications such as status calls.
* Ability to identify potential new areas of work.
* Experience supporting pre\-sales by helping define project scope and solution options.


**Ideal Mindset:**  

* Eager Learner: Our team members are keen to enhance their technical and business skills, recognizing that their personal growth and success directly contribute to the achievements of our team and NTT DATA.
* Servant Leader: You prioritize the success of the team and are willing to go the extra mile to help a team member in need.
* Communicator: You know how to communicate your design ideas to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders, prioritizing critical information and leaving out extraneous details.


**Location:**  

Applications should contain a resume.
  
  

About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.
  
  

NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a SAP Architect to join our team in Bengaluru, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

Role Summary
  
  

Lead the design and implementation of end\-to\-end Source\-to\-Pay solutions, aligning procurement business processes with enterprise technology platforms.
  
  

Core Responsibilities
  
* Design end\-to\-end S2P architecture (Sourcing → Contracts → Procurement → Invoicing → Payments)
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs
* Define integration architecture with ERP, finance, and supplier systems
* Lead S2P platform implementations and provide design governance

* End\-to\-end S2P lifecycle expertise:
* Strategic Sourcing
* Supplier Lifecycle Management (SLM)
* Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)
* Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)
* Accounts Payable (AP)
* Procurement policies, compliance, and controls
* Spend analysis and procurement KPIs


Technical Skills
  
* Hands\-on expertise in at least one platform:
* SAP Ariba / S4 Procurement
* Sirion
* Oracle Procurement Cloud
* Ivalua / Jaggaer / GEP
* Integration expertise:
* APIs (REST/SOAP)
* Middleware (Mulesoft, CPI, Boomi)
