2c25be86.title: VP, Solutions Architect - AI
2c25be86.description:
**Description**
 VP, Solutions Architect \- AI
   

  

**Full Location:** 
 remote \- IN
   

  

 The VP, Solutions Architect \- AI designs AI\-enabled solutions that win and grow client relationships, then converts pursuit learning into repeatable products. This role owns the full solution, including technical architecture, data and compliance posture, and commercial design, ensuring every component works together and delivers the outcomes the client purchased.
   

  

 This is a builder role as much as a pursuit role. The successful candidate will move comfortably between a client whiteboard, a product roadmap conversation, and a working prototype, and will use each one to sharpen the others.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
**Solution design and pursuit leadership**
* Partner with sales, marketing, client solutions, and operations to qualify opportunities, shape the value proposition, and set the win strategy.
* Design tailored AI and automation solutions across the client journey, including conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, quality and performance intelligence, workflow automation, and analytics.
* Deliver complete solutions under tight timelines, and manage the operational, regulatory, and commercial risks that come with them.
* Define the data architecture, integration path, and security and privacy controls each solution depends on, and work with IT and information security to validate them.
* Build the business case for every solution, including baseline, projected outcomes, ramp assumptions, and the measurement plan that proves value after go live.


**Product and platform contribution**
* Feed client requirements, competitive gaps, and field learning into the product roadmap, and advocate for the capabilities that will win the next ten deals rather than only the current one.
* Convert one\-off solution work into reusable assets, including reference architectures, accelerators, demo environments, and standard configurations.
* Partner with product, engineering, and data science teams on scoping, prioritization, and release planning, and help define what good looks like before a capability is built.
* Prototype and demonstrate new capabilities, using working artifacts rather than concept slides to test ideas with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Establish and apply responsible AI standards covering model selection, evaluation, human oversight, bias testing, and auditability, and make those standards visible to clients.


**Client and market engagement**
* Engage prospects and existing clients alongside sellers and client solutions partners, acting as the senior AI and digital authority in the room.
* Translate technical design, differentiation, and commercial outcomes for audiences ranging from operations leaders to the C\-suite and procurement.
* Build durable relationships at multiple levels within accounts and establish ResultsCX as a credible advisor on applied AI.
* Track the AI, automation, and customer experience technology landscape, and articulate where the market is heading and what it means for our clients.


**Partner and commercial strategy**
* Evaluate, select, and manage technology partners, and decide deliberately where we build, where we buy, and where we integrate.
* Support pricing strategy across products, services, and partner components, including licensing models, consumption costs, and gain share or outcome\-based structures.
* Model the unit economics of AI solutions, covering inference and platform costs, labor impact, and the margin profile over the life of the contract.


**Collaboration and governance**
* Work across global functions including sales support, operations, finance, legal, IT, and program management.
* Develop strong working relationships with the senior leadership team, and give them a clear view of solution risk, feasibility, and investment need.
* Safeguard sensitive client and consumer information at all times and maintain the highest standard of confidentiality.


**We Are Looking For Someone Who Has**
* Proven track record designing and winning complex AI, automation, or digital transformation solutions in an enterprise services environment.
* Working fluency with the modern AI stack, including large language models, retrieval, agentic workflows, orchestration, and evaluation, at a level sufficient to challenge vendors and guide engineers.
* Experience contributing to product direction, whether as a product owner, a solution architect embedded with product teams, or a founder of an internal capability.
* Strong command of contact center and customer experience operations, and of the platforms that support them.
* Experience delivering in regulated industries, with healthcare, financial services, telecommunications, or media preferred.
* Experience structuring and managing third\-party technology partnerships.
* Excellent ability to understand client business drivers and connect them to a defensible solution and commercial model.
* Comfort operating across geographies and navigating the complexity of a global business.
* Consistent high performance, personal accountability, and alignment to the Results Way.


**Preferred Education And Experience**
* Experience at ResultsCX or in the wider business process outsourcing industry.
* Degree level qualification or equivalent experience.
* Consulting experience with a Big 4 or equivalent firm, or ten or more years in a comparable solutions leadership role.
* Hands\-on technical background, including the ability to read code, build prototypes, and work directly in AI development tools.


**About ResultsCX**
 ResultsCX is a premier customer experience partner to Fortune 100 and 500 companies. We design, build, and deliver digitally influenced customer journeys that achieve the satisfaction and loyalty brands need to thrive and grow, while improving efficiency and reducing costs. ResultsCX’s 30\+\-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers’ evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20,000 colleagues worldwide. Our core expertise extends to actionable analytics, contact center as a service (CCaaS), and our own SupportPredict AI\-powered digital experience platform. Our strength lies in exceptional individuals working together in a high\-performing, fun culture to deliver next\-generation customer experiences on behalf of our clients.
   

  

 Results\-CX is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factors under federal, state, or local law.

5f7c57c2.title: Technical Program Manager
5f7c57c2.description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
   

 ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.
   

 As a Technical Program Manager in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!
   

  

 Job Purpose
   

 The Technical Program Manager is an individual contributor responsible for implementing portfolio management processes, configuring work management systems, and delivering data analytics that support portfolio visibility, execution, and decision\-making.
   

 This role translates strategic portfolio objectives into operational execution through hands\-on process design, workflow engineering, Agile planning, reporting, and metrics development. The role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Agile, and leadership teams to improve delivery predictability, governance, and business outcomes.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

 Portfolio \& Process Management
   

 \- Design and implement standardized intake workflows, prioritization frameworks, governance processes, and portfolio operating models.
   

 \- Establish quarterly planning practices, including PI Planning, capacity planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement routines.
   

 \- Create and maintain documentation such as RACI matrices, SOPs, workflow diagrams, process guides, and training materials.
   

 \- Drive process adoption through change management, stakeholder engagement, training, and self\-service knowledge resources.
   

 \- Conduct process reviews, identify improvement areas, and implement corrective actions.
   

 \- Partner with Agile coaches and delivery teams to align portfolio processes with team\-level ceremonies.
   

  

 Workflow Tool Engineering
   

 \- Configure and optimize work management tools including Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, and Power BI.
   

 \- Build boards, queries, dashboards, work item hierarchies, automation rules, and reporting structures.
   

 \- Create stakeholder\-specific dashboards and reports to support delivery visibility and portfolio governance.
   

 \- Provide advanced user support for complex tool, workflow, reporting, and configuration issues.
   

 \- Develop user guides, FAQs, training materials, and platform enablement resources.
   

  

 Data Analytics \& Business Intelligence
   

 \- Design and deliver dashboards for executives, program managers, and delivery teams.
   

 \- Track portfolio health, milestones, risks, dependencies, budget, and delivery performance.
   

 \- Implement and report on DORA Metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, and change failure rate.
   

 \- Establish Flow Metrics including cycle time, lead time, throughput, WIP, and flow efficiency.
   

 \- Create executive\-level reporting that converts complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
   

 \- Support forecasting, variance analysis, burn\-rate tracking, and data quality improvements.
   

  

 Portfolio Coordination \& Delivery Support
   

 \- Coordinate quarterly planning events, governance meetings, and cross\-functional working sessions.
   

 \- Track actions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and schedule conflicts.
   

 \- Support software initiatives from concept through delivery, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and business outcomes.
   

 \- Oversee SDLC execution across requirements, development, testing, release, and post\-launch activities.
   

 \- Lead continuous improvement initiatives for the Biller Portfolio.
   

  

 Required Qualifications
   

 Education
   

 \- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
   

 \- Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
   

 Experience
   

 \- 2 to 5 years of experience in program management, portfolio operations, PMO, Agile delivery, or related functions.
   

 \- Hands\-on experience administering Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar work management tools.
   

 \- Experience configuring workflows, dashboards, reports, and process templates.
   

 \- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
   

 \- Experience supporting Agile teams using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar methodologies.
   

 \- Experience implementing or improving portfolio management processes.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

 \- Strong proficiency in Azure DevOps including boards, queries, dashboards, and process templates.
   

 \- Strong proficiency in Jira/Jira Cloud including JQL, workflows, automation, and portfolio views.
   

 \- Working knowledge of Smartsheet, APIs, webhooks, or workflow integrations.
   

 \- Proficiency in Power BI, data modeling, DAX, and visualization.
   

 \- Strong Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, Power Query, and reporting.
   

 \- SQL knowledge for querying and analyzing data.
   

 \- Understanding of data quality, validation, and reporting governance.
   

 \- Ability to use AI tools for analytics, documentation, analysis, and content preparation.
   

  

 Methodology \& Metrics Knowledge
   

 \- Portfolio management, prioritization, governance, and capacity management.
   

 \- Agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
   

 \- DevOps practices and engineering productivity measurement.
   

 \- ITIL/ITSM and PMI/PMBOK principles preferred.
   

 \- Flow Metrics including cycle time, lead time, throughput, and WIP.
   

 \- DORA Metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, and change failure rate.
   

 \- Financial and portfolio metrics including burn rate, variance analysis, ROI, and resource loading.
   

  

 Professional Skills
   

 \- Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
   

 \- Excellent written and verbal communication.

 \- Strong facilitation skills for planning sessions and working groups.
   

 \- High attention to detail in tool configuration, documentation, and reporting.

 Preferred Qualifications

 \- Atlassian, Microsoft, Power BI, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma certification.
   

 \- Experience in payments, financial services, SaaS, or regulated industries.

 \- Experience with enterprise portfolio management tools such as Planview or ServiceNow PPM.

fc47a898.title: Mechanical Engineer - Solutions
fc47a898.description:
**About CynLr** 




 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link).
 



 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to assemble a Smartphone or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots
 *intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly,* 
 eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into
 *modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories* 
 that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
 *deeply inspired by neuroscience,* 
 modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role focuses on
 **applying CynLr’s products to real\-world customer and internal R\&D use cases** 
 .
 



 You will work at the intersection of
 **product capability and customer reality** 
 , translating application needs, constraints, and workflows into
 **complete mechanical solutions** 
 . The work begins with a
 **deep understanding of customer problems** 
 , rather than jumping straight to parts or prototypes, and evolves into system\-level designs that guide
 **integration, deployment, and iteration** 
 .
 



 Strong engineering here lives in the balance between
 **theory, system understanding, and hands\-on reality** 
 . You will use first\-principles thinking to frame application problems, identify constraints, and design
 **practical, testable solutions** 
 that work reliably in real customer environments.
 



 You will own the
 **entire solution lifecycle** 
 , from application definition and system architecture to mechanical design, integration, testing, and on\-site refinement. The goal is not one\-off demos, but
 **repeatable, deployable solutions** 
 that feed back into scalable and configurable product offerings.
 



 This role suits engineers who enjoy
 **system\-level thinking** 
 , working
 **close to customers and hardware** 
 , and seeing solutions through to real\-world deployment.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Design
 **customer\-facing applications and solutions** 
 , including:
* Visualising and modelling
 **product integration into real factory environments, machines, and workflows**
* Translating
 **abstract customer requirements and constraints** 
 into complete mechanical system architectures
* Designing
 **end\-to\-end mechanical solutions** 
 that account for installation, operation, and long\-term use
* Support
 **integrator\-driven deployment** 
 through:
* Mechanically customizable interfaces and mounting strategies
* Clear physical APIs, tolerances, and integration logic for repeatable field deployment
* On\-site or near\-field iteration, troubleshooting, and refinement
* Evolve solutions from:
* Custom, integrator\-heavy deployments
* Configurable, teachable, and repeatable productized systems
* Collaborate closely with
 **product design, simulation, electronics, algorithms, manufacturing, and applications teams**
* Support validation, testing, and feedback from deployed systems



  





**What We Look For** 




 This role spans
 **end\-to\-end mechanical ownership of customer\-facing solutions** 
 , without expecting universal expertise. We look for engineers with
 **deep, hands\-on strength in designing and deploying real systems** 
 , supported by working knowledge across adjacent domains.
 



**Core Strengths** 



* Strong grounding in
 **mechanical fundamentals applied to real\-world deployments**
* Deep expertise in one or more of:
* **Customer application and deployment engineering**
* **Special\-purpose machine and station design**
* **Robotics application design and work cell integration**
* **End\-of\-arm tooling and gripper customisation**
* **Robotic system simulation for reach, cycle time, and risk**
* **Designing systems under installation, service, and uptime constraints**



**Mindset** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 **factory, lab, or customer deployments**
* Ability to think in
 **workflows, use cases, and failure modes**
* Comfort with
 **incomplete requirements and evolving customer needs**
* Strong bias toward
 **documentation, validation, and repeatability**
* Ability to translate
 **application logic, algorithms, or control behaviour** 
 into mechanical architectures



**Tools** 



* Proficiency with
 **CAD drafting and 3D modelling tools** 
 (Fusion 360 preferred)
* Working familiarity with
 **robotics simulation and validation workflows**
* Exposure to
 **robot arms, grippers, sensors, motion components, wiring, and integration hardware**
* Experience with
 **scripting or automation tools** 
 is a plus



*Specific tools are not the primary filter. Sound engineering judgment and first\-principles thinking matter more.* 




  





**Team Structure \& Growth** 




 You will be part of a
 **multi\-specialised mechanical team** 
 , working alongside
 **design engineers, simulation engineers, and general mechanical engineers** 
 .
 



 The role is
 **highly cross\-functional** 
 , with close collaboration across
 **electronics, algorithms, software, manufacturing, and applications teams** 
 . Even as a solutions\-focused engineer, your work remains tightly connected to
 **product design and long\-term evolution** 
 .
 



 As CynLr grows, you will have opportunities to
 **own larger solution spaces** 
 , build deployment playbooks, mentor teams, or expand into
 **product architecture, operations, or customer applications leadership** 
 .
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Object manipulation has remained unsolved because
 **real\-world applications refuse to behave like clean lab problems** 
 . This role exists to bridge that gap.
 



 Your work will turn cutting\-edge capability into
 **systems that actually work on factory floors** 
 , and in the process, redefine what
 **mechanical solutions engineering** 
 means in robotics.
 



  





**Detailed JD Here: Mechanical Engineer Solutions**

777985ba.description:
**Position** 




**Pre\-Sales Manager** 




  





**Experience** 




**5\-8 Years** 




  





**Location** 




**Mumbai** 




  





  





**About FuEL** 




**FuEL** 
 is
 **Intellect's Flagship program** 
 designed to develop the next generation of transformation leaders for the global Fintech/Insuretech industry.
 



 Created for high\-potential professionals, the program equips participants to move beyond operational excellence and become trusted advisors who help financial institutions reimagine business models, accelerate digital \& AI transformation and deliver exceptional customer experiences.
 



 Your journey begins with an immersive four\-week learning experience covering Digital Transformation, Product Immersion, Design Thinking and AI\-led Banking Innovation. You'll gain deep exposure to Intellect's award\-winning banking platforms across Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Transaction Banking, Capital Markets, Wealth and Insurance, while working alongside some of the industry's foremost banking, product and technology experts.
 



 Explore more at: www.intellectdesign.com
 



  





  





**The Opportunity** 




 The best presales leaders don't just respond to RFPs—they shape how clients think about their business challenges before a competitive process even begins. This role is for that kind of leader.
 



 As
 **Presales Manager** 
 , you will own the solutioning agenda across complex, high\-value deal pursuits—bringing together deep banking domain expertise, strategic thinking, consultative selling, and genuine individual and integrated product mastery to drive measurable customer value and win business that matters. You will be leading efforts to drive new sales, cross sell, and upsell at Intellect’s Key relationships engaging at the CXO level and solution with authority, and build the presales capability that turns market opportunities into signed engagements.
 



 You will engage with business leaders across Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, Transaction Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, and Wealth Management to understand strategic objectives, diagnose business challenges, and translate them into differentiated transformation opportunities.
 



  





 The role requires the ability to ask the right questions, challenge conventional thinking, bring external market perspectives, and guide customers from problem identification to solution vision.
 



 You should be comfortable in working in a networked org design and in taking ownership of the outcome therefore to pool the best resources and solution that OneIntellect has to offer to its customers. This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a boardroom solutioning session as they are shaping product strategy conversations with internal roadmap teams.
 



  





  





**Role Definition** 




 The Pre\-Sales Manager primarily drives the early\-stage sales cycle by actively shaping and qualifying pipeline opportunities through discovery and validation. They are responsible for translating customer requirements into compelling value propositions and demonstrating product value, while providing critical support in later pipeline stages to convert opportunities into successful deals.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Prospect Understanding** 




 Engage with banking executives, business heads, product owners, and operations leaders to understand strategic priorities. Analyse banking business models, revenue drivers, operational challenges, and competitive pressures. Translate market trends into actionable transformation opportunities. Actively validate critical deal qualifiers—including Need/Problem, Decision Makers, Customer’s Timeline, Customer’s Budget runway, and Proposal intent to successfully graduate opportunities.
 



**2\. Consultative Value Selling** 




 Create Business Value to shape opportunities, influence decisions and improve win probability. Ability to articulate measurable business outcomes, ROI, and value propositions aligned to customer objectives. Help banks rethink customer journeys, operating models, and product strategies.
 



**3\. Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops** 




 Conduct high\-quality product demonstrations, discovery workshops, proof\-of\-concept sessions, technical presentations, and solution walkthroughs for prospective clients aligned to their business needs. Ensure demo is aligned to use cases to prospect’s requirements and perform Demo Diagnostic
 



**4\. RFP/RFI and Bid Support** 




 Lead responses to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, and proposal documents. Ensure that responses are accurate, complete, compelling, and aligned with the customer’s stated requirements.
 



**5\. Solutioning and Proposal Development** 




 Design tailored high quality solution propositions using the company’s product capabilities, platform strengths, implementation approach, and domain expertise. Support the creation of scope documents, solution architecture inputs, effort estimates, implementation plans, timelines, assumptions, exclusions, and commercial inputs. Ensure that the proposed solution is practical, differentiated, and aligned to the customer’s needs.
 



**6\. Coordination with Product, Engineering and Delivery Teams** 




 Work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Delivery, Implementation, and Support teams to validate solution feasibility, effort assumptions, customisation needs, integration approach, dependencies, and delivery risks.
 



**7\. Sales Enablement** 




 Equip the Sales team with product collateral, demo scripts, solution notes, competitive insights, objection\-handling points, customer\-specific messaging, and proof points to support effective selling.
 



**8\. Market and Customer Feedback Loop** 




 Capture feedback from prospects, clients, partners, competitive situations, demonstrations, and RFPs, and share structured insights with Product teams for roadmap, positioning, and solution improvement.
 



**9\. Deal Conversion Support** 




 Actively drive the early\-stage sales cycle by shaping and graduating qualified opportunities. Act as a bridge between Sales, Product, and Delivery to ensure that the proposed solution is credible, client\-specific, implementable, and capable of supporting successful deal closure.
 



**10\. Knowledge Management** 




 Maintain updated value proposition product decks, reusable proposal content, case studies, standard responses, FAQs, and solution artefacts to improve pre\-sales productivity and consistency.
 



**11\. Transition to Delivery**

Job Description: Technical Presales Engineer (AV \& Unified Communications)

Role Overview

The Technical Presales Engineer serves as the primary technical bridge between the sales team, channel partners, and end customers. You will be responsible for designing high\-impact Audio\-Visual (AV) and Unified Communications (UC) solutions, driving product adoption through partner ecosystems, and ensuring technical excellence throughout the sales lifecycle. \*\*1\. Solution Design \& Technical Consultation\*\*

\* Architect comprehensive AV solutions, including boardrooms, huddle spaces, and large\-scale integrated conferencing environments.

\* Conduct site surveys and technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and translate them into Bill of Materials (BoM), line diagrams, and scope of work (SoW) documents.

\* Deliver persuasive technical presentations and live product demonstrations that highlight USP and ROI.

\*\*2\. Partner Enablement \& Business Development\*\*

\* Lead strategic \*\*partner meetings\*\* to introduce new product lines and roadmaps, positioning the brand as the preferred choice for their portfolio.

\* Proactively \*\*identify new opportunities\*\* within partner accounts by analyzing market trends and end\-user pain points.

\*\*3\. Training \& Knowledge Transfer\*\*

\* Design and execute \*\*technical training programs\*\* for partner engineering and sales teams to ensure they are self\-sufficient in deploying and supporting the products.

\* Provide regular updates on firmware, software integrations (e.g., Teams, Zoom), and industry standards to keep the partner ecosystem competitive.

\* Create technical "cheat sheets" and FAQs to assist partners in the field.

\*\*4\. Proof of Concept (PoC) \& Validation\*\*

\* Manage the end\-to\-end PoC process, including equipment setup, configuration, and successful handover to the customer.

\* Troubleshoot complex interoperability issues during the presales phase to ensure seamless integration with existing IT infrastructure.

\#\#\# \*\*Technical Skills \& Qualifications\*\*

\* \*\*Industry Expertise:\*\* Deep knowledge of AV standards (HDMI, HDBaseT, Dante, NDI) and UC platforms (Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Google Meet).

\* \*\*Hardware Proficiency:\*\* Experience with professional\-grade DSPs, PTZ cameras, wireless presentation systems, and interactive displays.

\* \*\*Networking Fundamentals:\*\* Solid understanding of VoIP, VLANs, QoS, and security protocols required for AV\-over\-IP deployments.

\* \*\*Communication:\*\* Exceptional ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.

\#\#\# \*\*Performance Indicators (KPIs)\*\*

\* \*\*Partner Readiness:\*\* Number of partner technical teams successfully certified or trained.

\* \*\*Opportunity Generation:\*\* Volume of new leads or projects identified through partner engagement.

\* \*\*Conversion Rate:\*\* Technical win rate on PoCs and submitted designs.

Pay: From ₹60,000\.00 per month

Experience:

Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
   

  

 The Opportunity

If so, you’ll thrive in our dynamic team where you will have the opportunity to lead innovative storage integration projects, mentor fellow consultants, and drive transformative solutions for our clients, all while collaborating in a supportive and growth\-focused environment.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The team you will be joining is the Professional Services team at Nutanix, located in Pune or Bangalore. This team is dedicated to delivering high\-quality architectural solutions and consultancy services to help clients optimize their IT infrastructure. With a collaborative and innovative culture, the team thrives on creating impactful solutions that modernize clients’ technological environments and drive their business success. The mission of this team is to empower enterprises to harness the full potential of Nutanix technologies by enabling integration and seamless coexistence with existing storage platforms.
   

  

 You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who is known for fostering a supportive and empowering leadership style, encouraging team members to take initiative and develop their skills. The work setup for this role is hybrid, requiring the hire to be in the office a minimum of two days per week while allowing for flexibility to work remotely on the other days.
   

  

 This role will require some travel to meet with clients and engage in on\-site consultations and architecture discussions, so a willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagement and project execution is essential.
   

  

 Your Role
   

  

* Architect and deliver enterprise storage solutions integrating Nutanix with Pure Storage, Dell EMC, and other platforms.
* Lead customer architecture and design engagements while modernizing and optimizing existing storage infrastructures.
* Define and implement storage migration strategies, ensuring seamless transitions from legacy systems to modern environments.
* Analyze and troubleshoot complex storage performance issues across applications, networking, and infrastructure.
* Mentor and guide consultants in developing reusable architecture patterns and best practices for storage integration.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align storage solutions with broader enterprise architecture goals.
* Drive automation of storage provisioning and management processes to enhance operational efficiency.
* Establish trusted relationships with clients, acting as a technical advisor on storage and infrastructure needs.


 What You Will Bring
   

  

* Strong expertise in enterprise storage architecture and integration with Nutanix environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Pure Storage and Dell EMC enterprise storage platforms.
* Proficient in SAN/NAS technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and NFS/SMB.
* Ability to design and optimize storage solutions based on performance, availability, and business requirements.
* Experience in storage modernization, migration strategies, and data protection architectures.
* Competence in automation using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and Python.
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* Strong consulting skills with the ability to engage and lead customer architecture discussions.


 Work Arrangement
   

  

 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

86bb5358.title: Technical Solutions Architect
86bb5358.description:
Technical Solutions Architect
 



 Experience: 12–20 Years
 



 Joining: Immediate / As Soon as Possible
 



 Location\-Infopark\-Kochi\-Onsite
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



  





 Job Overview
 



  





 We are looking for a Technical Solutions Architect with 12–20 years of experience to provide technology leadership across Product Engineering, ERP and Software Services.
 



 The role will be responsible for solution architecture, enterprise architecture, technical consulting, customer\-facing solutioning, technical pre\-sales, technology strategy and engineering leadership. The candidate should be capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, commercially viable and future\-ready technology solutions.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong architectural depth, broad technology exposure and the ability to work across business, customer, sales, delivery and engineering teams.
 



  





 Key Technology Expertise:
 



  .NET, Angular, Microsoft,Cloud – Azure/AWS, Integrations \& APIs,ERP Architecture,SaaS, Microservices \& Modern Architecture, AI/GenAI, Multiple Technology Platforms
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Solution \& Enterprise Architecture
 



 \*Design end\-to\-end enterprise solutions covering application, integration, data, cloud and infrastructure architecture.
 



 \*Translate business and customer requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable and cost\-effective solutions.
 



 \*Define architecture standards, reusable patterns, reference architectures and technical guidelines.
 



 \*Review complex solution designs and provide architectural direction.
 



 \*Assess legacy platforms and recommend modernization and transformation strategies.
 



  





 2\. Technology Leadership
 



 \*Provide technology leadership and strategic direction across Product Engineering, ERP and Software Services.
 



 \*Assess current technology capabilities and identify opportunities for the next level of technology maturity and organizational growth.
 



 \*Guide Technical Leads, Developers, Architects and engineering teams on complex technical decisions.
 



 \*Act as a senior technical escalation point for critical technical, architectural and customer issues.
 



 \*Promote engineering excellence, technical ownership, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
 



 \*Identify future technology capabilities, skills, tools and roles required to support business growth.
 



  





 3\. Technical Strategy \& Roadmap
 



 \*Develop and contribute to the organization's technology strategy and technology roadmap.
 



 \*Evaluate technology choices and recommend solutions aligned with business objectives, scalability, security and cost.
 



 \*Identify modernization opportunities across applications, ERP platforms, infrastructure and integrations.
 



 \*Define technology standards, architecture principles, engineering practices and governance frameworks.
 



 \*Evaluate emerging technologies including AI/GenAI, cloud, automation and modern application architectures.
 



 \*Support management in technology investment and strategic technology decisions.
 



  





 4\. Technical Guidelines – Service\-Based Projects
 



 \*Define technical and architectural guidelines for service\-based projects.
 



 \*Establish standards for technology selection, application architecture, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud, security and deployment.
 



 \*Provide technical inputs during solution estimation, feasibility assessment and project planning.
 



 \*Review major service project architectures and proposed technical approaches.
 



 \*Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable and commercially viable.
 



 \*Identify technical risks, dependencies and delivery challenges during solution design.
 



 \*Create reusable architecture patterns, technical templates and checklists for service projects.
 



  





 5\. Technical Guidelines – ERP \& Enterprise Solutions
 



 \*Define technical architecture and implementation guidelines for ERP and enterprise application projects.
 



 \*Establish standards for ERP customization, extensions, integrations, APIs, databases, reporting, security and deployment.
 



 \*Guide teams in deciding between standard ERP functionality, customization and external solutions.
 



 \*Define integration standards for ERP, CRM, HRMS, finance and third\-party applications.
 



 \*Review major ERP solution designs and integration architectures.
 



 \*Guide ERP teams on scalability, performance, security, data management, backup and disaster recovery.
 



 \*Identify opportunities to modernize ERP solutions through cloud, automation, APIs and AI.
 



 \*Provide technical direction during complex ERP implementations and customer escalations.
 



  





 6\. Cloud \& Modern Architecture
 



 \*Design and review Azure/AWS cloud architectures.
 



 \*Support cloud migration, modernization, scalability, availability, performance and cost optimization.
 



 \*Provide architecture guidance on microservices, APIs, SaaS, event\-driven architecture, distributed systems, containers, serverless and CI/CD.
 



 \*Recommend appropriate architecture patterns based on business and technical requirements.
 



  





 7\. AI, GenAI \& Emerging Technology
 



 \*Identify practical opportunities to apply AI/GenAI across products, services and customer solutions.
 



 \*Evaluate emerging technologies based on business value and practical applicability.
 



 \*Support AI/GenAI POCs and solution design involving LLMs, RAG, AI APIs, agents and vector databases.
 



 \*Identify opportunities for AI\-assisted development, automation and intelligent business processes.
 



 \*Distinguish meaningful technology opportunities from technology hype.
 



  





 8\. Technical Pre\-Sales \& Customer Solutioning
 



 \*Work closely with Sales and Business Development as the technical solutioning partner.
 



 \*Conduct customer discovery sessions, requirement discussions and solution workshops.
 



 \*Understand customer business challenges and translate them into technology solutions.
 



 \*Prepare technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, solution approaches and architecture documents.
 



 \*Conduct technical presentations, demonstrations and solution walkthroughs.
 



 \*Provide high\-level estimation, feasibility assessment, resource planning and delivery inputs.
 



 \*Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers.
 



 \*Support technical escalations and complex customer solution discussions.
 



  





 9\. Commercial \& Business Development Support
 



 \*Understand scope, effort, resource requirements, delivery risks and technology costs.
 



 \*Balance technical excellence with commercial feasibility and delivery practicality.
 



 \*Provide technical inputs for Fixed Price, T\&M and Managed Services engagements.
 



 \*Support Sales in positioning solutions and business outcomes rather than only technical resources.
 



 \*Identify cross\-sell and up\-sell opportunities through technical discussions.
 



 \*Identify opportunities for new offerings around cloud, modernization, automation, AI, managed services and product engineering.
 



  





 10\. Technical Governance \& Quality
 



 \*Establish and maintain technical governance across projects and teams.
 



 \*Lead or participate in architecture and technical design reviews.
 



 \*Ensure technical decisions are documented with appropriate risks, assumptions and trade\-offs.
 



 \*Promote secure, scalable, reliable and maintainable architecture.
 



 \*Ensure consideration of application, cloud and infrastructure security, IAM, VAPT and compliance requirements.
 



 \*Establish standards for technical documentation, architecture diagrams and solution handover.
 



  





 11\. Cross\-functional Leadership
 



 \*Collaborate closely with Sales, Business Development, Product, Project/Delivery, Engineering, ERP and Management.
 



 \*Bridge business requirements, customer expectations, technical capabilities and delivery realities.
 



 \*Ensure alignment between solutions proposed by Sales and actual delivery capabilities.
 



 Support management in strategic technology and capability decisions.
 



  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 \*12–20 years of overall experience in software engineering, architecture, technology consulting or related areas.
 



 \*Strong experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting and Customer\-facing Solutioning.
 



 \*Strong exposure to enterprise application architecture and system integrations.
 



 \*Strong depth in at least one major technology ecosystem, preferably Microsoft/.NET.
 



 \*Broad technology exposure beyond a single technology stack.
 



 \*Strong understanding of cloud architecture, preferably Azure/AWS.
 



 \*Experience with modern application architecture and distributed systems.
 



 \*Strong technical pre\-sales, solution proposal and customer workshop experience.
 



 \*Experience working with product engineering and/or software services organizations.
 



 \*Good understanding of ERP and enterprise application environments.
 



 \*Strong understanding of technical estimation, feasibility, resource planning and delivery risks.
 



 \*Awareness of AI/GenAI and emerging technologies.
 



 \*Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 \*Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability.
 



 \*Ability to make pragmatic technology decisions and clearly communicate technical trade\-offs.
 



  





 Preferred Exposure
 



 SaaS / ERP / Enterprise Applications
 



 International customer engagements
 



 Large\-scale integrations
 



 Cloud migration and modernization
 



 AI/GenAI POCs
 



 Managed Services
 



 Product Engineering
 



 Software Services
 



 Digital Transformation
 



 Automation and DevOps
 



 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



 The ideal candidate should be:
 



 Technology\-agnostic
 



 Business\-oriented
 



 Customer\-centric
 



 Commercially aware
 



 Strategic and solution\-focused
 



 Strong in technology leadership and decision\-making
 



 Curious about emerging technologies
 



 Capable of balancing architecture quality, customer value, delivery practicality and commercial objectives
 



 Able to provide both hands\-on technical direction and organization\-level technology leadership
 



 Joining Preference
 



 Immediate joiners or candidates who can join at the earliest will be strongly preferred.
 



  




* Interested candidates if matches the profile shall send the update CV with subject line\-"Application for Technical Solutions Architect"

3b943154.title: Lead Technical Architect – Planview
3b943154.description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Lead Technical Architect in the Capabilities team will be responsible for for Planview platform enablement through defining technical architecture, configuring advanced system modules, designing robust database solutions, and engineering secure API integrations with external platforms like ADO, ServiceNow, and data lakes. Will drive platform roadmaps and ensure the Planview ecosystem scales seamlessly to support enterprise portfolio management, resource capacity planning, and financial tracking.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Governance:**
* Platform Roadmap: Own the platform roadmap for Planview Products \& Shared capabilities in partnership with Solution Architect.
* Technical Governance: Establish best practices for environment management (Sandbox, Production). Manage deployment of changes from Sandbox to Production. Manage multiple Sandbox environment for Planview Portfolios, Manage Sandbox refresh and post refresh steps for Planview Portfolios
* Mentorship: Act as the subject matter expert (SME), guiding and mentoring a team of administrators and system engineers.


**Advanced Configuration \& Platform Administration (Planview Admin)**
* Core Configuration: Configure complex portfolio structures, investment strategies, and fiscal time periods.
* Lifecycle \& Workflow Automation: Design and build multi\-stage automated routing configurations and approval workflows to streamline demand intake and governance.
* Manage Planview Product and Shared Capabilities access via Planview Admin
* System Health \& Security: Manage user access profiles, object permissions, and Single Sign\-On (SSO)/Active Directory integrations.


**Integration Engineering \& Development**
* API Development: Design, build, and maintain custom integration pipelines utilizing Planview Portfolios’ Public REST APIs and OData feeds using OAuth2\.
* Partner with Solution Architects, business product owners, and cross\-functional engineering teams to shape platform strategy.
* Ecosystem Orchestration: Configure and extend Planview Hub (Tasktop) to drive flawless, bidirectional data synchronization between Planview Portfolios and peripheral tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps).
* ETL \& Data Scripting: Write efficient scripts in Python, Java, or Shell to automate data transfers, system maintenance jobs, and backend configurations.


**Database Management \& Advanced Analytics**
* Database Optimization: Write, debug, and optimize complex SQL queries, views, and stored procedures on enterprise databases.
* Data Schema Design: Leverage knowledge of Planview’s underlying relational database schema to troubleshoot data discrepancies and build high\-performance reporting views.
* Business Intelligence: Collaborate with BI teams to design data models and write custom DAX/SQL queries for Microsoft Power BI or tableau executive dashboards.


**What Success Looks Like**
* A stable and well\-governed platform that supports business planning and delivery needs.
* End\-to\-End technical Leadership
* Technical enablement and effective delivery of enhancements, releases, and implementations.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of experience in enterprise applications, platform architecture, systems integration, or technical administration.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Planview Portfolios or a comparable enterprise portfolio management platform.
* Knowledge of Planview Ecosystem
* Proven experience defining technical architecture, platform scalability, and environment strategy across enterprise systems.
* Strong experience designing secure integrations using REST APIs, OData feeds, OAuth2, and connecting platforms such as Azure DevOps, ServiceNow.
* Strong scripting and database skills, including Python, Java along with advanced SQL for queries, views, and stored procedures.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical delivery, manage platform security and SSO, solve complex issues, and mentor administrators or engineers


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Planview Portfolios administration, implementation, or technical certification.
* Experience with Planview Hub and bidirectional integration design across enterprise tools
* Knowledge of Planview’s relational data model and experience troubleshooting data issues or building reporting views.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment frameworks for enterprise SaaS or hybrid platforms.
* Experience building analytics and reporting solutions in Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI platforms.
* Proven success delivering platform upgrades, enhancements, and implementations in large, highly governed enterprise environments.


**ELIGIBILITY**
 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

4eb959ab.title: Technical Architect-CMS and Digital Experience
4eb959ab.description:
**Role:\- Technical Architect/Senior Technical Architect** 




**Location:\- Gurgaon** 




  





**Exp:\- 10\+ years** 




  





**Senior Technical Architect** 




 CMS \& Digital Experience Platforms
 



  





**Role Context** 




 We are looking for a Senior Technical Architect to provide technical leadership on an established, large\-scale enterprise digital program (a running account with multi\-year continuity). This is a hands\-on\-enough architecture leadership role: you will own the technical quality of the platform end to end, drive estimation and solutioning, and act as the guardian of non\-functional requirements — security, performance, accessibility, and analytics/observability — across every release.
 



 The right person is equally comfortable in an architecture review, an estimation workshop, and a client\-facing solution conversation, and can hold the technical line on a mature codebase while continuously modernizing it. The role is not tied to a single account — you will be expected to bring architecture leadership across engagements as needs evolve.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Architecture \& Solution Design** 



* Define and evolve the end\-to\-end architecture for enterprise web, mobile, and CMS\-driven applications on the account.
* Design composable, headless, API\-first, and microservices\-based solutions that are scalable, secure, and high\-performing.
* Establish and maintain architecture standards, design principles, and governance frameworks.
* Lead technical discovery, solution roadmaps, and modernization planning.



**CMS \& Digital Experience Platforms** 



* Architect enterprise CMS/DXP solutions, including headless and hybrid patterns.
* Define content modeling, personalization, localization, workflow, and publishing strategies.
* Lead CMS migrations, upgrades, and modernization programs.
* Integrate the CMS with CRM, CDP, DAM, marketing automation, and analytics platforms.



**Technical Leadership \& Quality** 



* Provide technical leadership across front\-end and back\-end engineering teams.
* Own coding standards, architecture reviews, performance tuning, and secure\-by\-design practices.
* Define reusable components, shared platform services, and API contracts.



**Cloud \& DevOps** 



* Architect cloud\-native solutions and own CI/CD, IaC, containerization, and orchestration.
* Define observability, monitoring, logging, and DR frameworks.



**Estimation \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead effort estimation, solution costing, and pre\-sales / proposal support for the account.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Partner with product owners, delivery managers, and client stakeholders; mentor the team.



  





**Must\-Have (Required):** 




**Experience \& Leadership** 



* 10\+ years in software engineering, with 4\-5\+ years as a Technical / Solution Architect.
* Proven track record delivering and sustaining large\-scale CMS/DXP programs, ideally on an established / running enterprise account.
* Demonstrated ownership of technical quality, estimation, and stakeholder communication.



**CMS / DXP** 



* **Deep, hands\-on —** 
 architecture experience with at least one enterprise CMS/DXP — e.g., Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentful, or Drupal.
* Practical experience with headless / hybrid / composable CMS patterns, content modeling, personalization, and multi\-locale publishing.
* Experience leading a CMS migration or modernization program.



**Front\-End Architecture** 



* Deep hands\-on experience with at least one modern JS framework (React, Angular, Vue, or Next.js) and strong command of TypeScript / ES6\+.
* Component / design\-system thinking and front\-end performance ownership. (Breadth across multiple frameworks is a plus, not a requirement.)



**Back\-End / Services Architecture** 



* Depth in at least one server\-side stack (.NET Core, Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, or Python).
* Strong REST and/or GraphQL API design.



**Distributed \& Integration Architecture** 



* API\-first and microservices design.
* Event\-driven architecture, pub/sub, and messaging/streaming (e.g., Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent); reactive patterns.



**Cloud \& DevOps** 



* Cloud\-native architecture on at least one major cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and containerization/orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes).



**Data** 



* Polyglot persistence — comfortable with at least one relational and one NoSQL store; able to make sound data\-modeling and caching decisions.



  





**Non\-Functional Requirements (core to this role)** 



* Demonstrable ownership of security (secure\-by\-design, OWASP, IAM concepts), performance \& scalability, accessibility (WCAG), and analytics/observability.



  





**Good\-to\-Have (Advantageous)** 



* Breadth across multiple front\-end frameworks and/or back\-end languages.
* Additional CMS platforms beyond the primary (e.g., AEM and Sitecore/Optimizely/Drupal).
* Deep integration\-platform experience: MuleSoft, Boomi, API Gateway products, enterprise service bus.
* gRPC; advanced GraphQL federation.
* Deep IAM / auth architecture: OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, Zero Trust.
* Experience applying GenAI / LLMs to content generation or engineering delivery (with governance / human\-in\-the\-loop).
* Second cloud, or multi\-cloud / hybrid experience.
* Broader datastore experience (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, Redis).



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of performance, scalability, and security best practices.
* Client\-facing consulting experience and the ability to lead geographically distributed teams.



  





**Preferred Certifications (any of the following are a plus)** 



* Azure Solutions Architect Expert / AWS Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional).
* AEM, Sitecore, or equivalent CMS certification.
* CKA / Kubernetes certification.
* Scrum / Agile certifications.



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Strong communication and stakeholder management.
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making.
* Ability to influence architecture direction across teams.
* Strong mentoring and leadership.



  





**Key Deliverables** 



* Enterprise architecture blueprints and solution design documents.
* Technical roadmaps and CMS architecture strategy.
* Integration and cloud architecture frameworks.
* Security \& governance standards.
* Estimation models and performance\-optimization recommendations.

e4bbed04.title: Lead, Enterprise Architect
e4bbed04.description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Lead, Enterprise Architect – Enterprise Architecture**
**Your Role**
 We are seeking a technically hands\-on Enterprise Architect who combines strong architecture expertise with practical engineering capability. This individual will operate as a player\-coach, contributing directly to solution design and implementation \- writing code, building automation, and enhancing AI\-driven solutions.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an architect who does not want to stay purely at the conceptual level, but instead actively participates in building, prototyping, and evolving enterprise solutions alongside engineering teams.
   

  

**Requirements/Responsibilities**
**Architecture and Engineering Execution**
 Design and evolve enterprise architecture patterns across cloud, SaaS, and AI\-enabled platforms
   

  

 Directly contribute to codebases where appropriate (e.g., APIs, automation, integrations, AI agents)
   

  

 Develop proofs\-of\-concept and reference implementations to validate architectural decisions
   

  

 Develop solution designs for enterprise architecture solutions and consult with other teams as needed
   

  

**AI and Automation Development**
 Design, build, and enhance AI agents and copilots using modern frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, LangChain, Semantic Kernel)
   

  

 Contribute to prompt engineering, orchestration logic, and integration patterns
   

  

 Automate enterprise governance and operational processes using tools such as Power Automate, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, or similar
   

  

**Platform \& Integration Engineering**
 Write and review code for APIs, microservices, and integration layers
   

  

 Build reusable services and automation pipelines that accelerate delivery teams
   

  

 Assist in debugging, performance tuning, and resolving complex technical issues
   

  

**Governance \& Standards**
 Define and enforce architecture standards while ensuring they are practical and implementable
   

  

 Partner with engineering teams to ensure alignment between architecture and delivery
   

  

 Support modern engineering practices (CI/CD, IaC, testing strategies) into enterprise workflows
   

  

**Collaboration \& Leadership**
 Act as a bridge between architecture and engineering teams
   

  

 Provide hands\-on technical guidance and mentorship to developers and solution architects
   

  

 Engage with stakeholders to align technical solutions with business needs
   

  

**Programming \& Development**
 Proficiency in Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript
   

  

 Experience building APIs, services, and automation workflows
   

  

 Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices
   

  

**Cloud \& Platforms**
**Hands\-on Experience With Cloud Platforms (Azure Preferred)**
 Experience building and deploying cloud\-native applications (containers, serverless, microservices)
   

  

**AI \& Emerging Technology**
 Practical experience building or integrating AI/ML or LLM\-based solutions
   

  

 Understanding of agent\-based architectures, prompt orchestration, and AI governance
   

  

 Ability to evaluate and apply emerging technologies in real\-world enterprise contexts
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 AI System \& Agentic Workflows
   

  

 Design, build, and optimize agentic AI systems using modern agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, Haystack Agents, ReAct\-style agents).
   

  

 Implement multi\-agent collaboration patterns, task orchestration, memory architectures, tool integrations, and reasoning\-enhancing strategies.
   

  

 Develop secure, robust, and scalable tool‑calling and function\-execution flows for agents operating in dynamic environments.
   

  

**Automation \& Integration**
 Experience with workflow automation tools (Power Automate, Logic Apps, etc.)
   

  

 Strong understanding of system integration patterns (REST, messaging, event\-driven architecture)
   

  

**Enterprise Architecture**
 Knowledge of architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) with a pragmatic, execution\-focused mindset
   

  

 Experience defining architecture patterns, standards, and reusable design components
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience. Knowledge of enterprise architecture principles, patterns, and best practices, with familiarity in cloud computing and SaaS models. Excellent consultative and communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with business, partner, and IT stakeholders. Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Architect, or TOGAF a plus Experience in financial services or other highly regulated environments Familiarity with governance, compliance, and risk frameworks (e.g., NIST, FFIEC, GDPR)
   

  

**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**
 The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

c04adbcb.title: Cloud Engineer III [T500-28814]
c04adbcb.description:
**About McDonald’s:** 




 One of the world’s largest employers with locations in more than 100 countries, McDonald’s Corporation has corporate opportunities in Hyderabad. Our global offices serve as dynamic innovation and operations hubs, designed to expand McDonald's global talent base and in\-house expertise. Our new office in Hyderabad will bring together knowledge across business, technology, analytics, and AI, accelerating our ability to deliver impactful solutions for the business and our customers across the globe.
 



  





**Global Tech Infrastructure \& Operations – Cloud Engineer III, Cloud Security** 




**Company Description:** 




 McDonald’s new growth strategy, Accelerating the Arches, encompasses all aspects of our business as the leading global omni\-channel restaurant brand. As the consumer landscape shifts, we are using our competitive advantages to further strengthen our brand. One of our core growth strategies is to Double Down on the 3Ds (Delivery, Digital and Drive Thru). McDonald’s will accelerate technology innovation so 65M\+ customers a day will experience a fast, easy experience, whether at one of our 25,000 and growing Drive Thrus, through McDelivery, dine\-in or takeaway.
 



 Leading this revolution is McDonald’s Global Technology organization made up of intrapreneurs who get to build really cool tech with scary smart people using the latest innovations like AI, IOT, and edge computing. We do this working along diverse, global teams who are always hungry for a challenge. It’s bonus points when you get to see your family and friends use the tech you build at their favorite McD restaurant.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 This opportunity is part of the Global Technology Infrastructure \& Operations team (GTIO), where our mission is to deliver modern and relevant technology that supports the way McDonald’s works. We provide best\-in\-class foundational technology products and services including Global Networking, Cloud, End User Computing, and IT Service Management. It’s our goal to always provide an engaging,
 



 The Cloud Security Engineer III role is part of the Cloud Ecosystem team in Global Technology Infrastructure \& Operations. The role reports to the Director of Cloud Security and is responsible for delivering the enterprise security platform engineering outcomes, delivering enhancements and automating security remediations, supporting DevOps and Engineers consuming cloud resources to ensure it is done in a meaningful and secure manner, and engaging with cybersecurity and risk management teams to improve the security posture of the cloud environments.
 



 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technology leader to help shape the transformation of infrastructure and operations products and services to the entire McDonalds environment.
 



  





**Responsibilities \& Accountabilities:** 



* Automate the provisioning of cloud monitors, automated remediation, security baselines and templates, etc through the concept of pipeline engineering.
* Implement core cloud security capabilities such as identity \& access, data protection, security controls and compliance, vulnerability management, threat detection and response, and logging/monitoring.
* Performing penetration testing, red/blue teaming, and gap analysis with audit and cybersecurity partners.
* Support operations and incident response in cloud events and incidents.
* Design and deploy programs, dashboards, tests, scripts, and automation to enhance cloud security posture, detection, and response.
* Build prototypes and perform proof of concepts to demonstrate security value
* Remain up\-to\-date on emerging technologies and architecture and propose ways to use them in current and upcoming projects.
* Educate and guide team members on cloud standards, procedures, and guidelines/best practices.
* Act as a SME for all Cloud technical hands\-on questions cloud security related.
* Lead and facilitate the creation of compliance automation and policy\-as\-code to streamline cloud governance in partnership with the Technical Product Analyst(s) and Manager(s).
* Strive to provide internal and external customers with excellent customer service and world\-class service and focus on improvement and benefits to the cloud consumer’s outcomes.
* Influence and support more junior cloud security engineers and help develop their skill sets and understanding of cloud security.



  





**Basic Qualifications:** 



* Willingness and ability to live the McDonald’s values every day: Serve, Inclusion, Integrity, Community, and Family.
* Ability to effectively communicate with other senior leaders of IT on program strategies and plans and negotiate quality solutions.
* Must be attentive to details, organized, self\-motivated, and driven.
* Ability to create system and process flow diagrams, data flow diagrams, sequence and UML diagrams, inter and intra system dependencies within the functional domain and across them
* Knowledge and understanding of industry trends and new technologies and ability to apply trends to architectural needs.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical staff.
* Defines and promotes best practices; cultivates a culture of innovation and learning, including willingness to instruct and coach in a cloud training program as needed.
* Demonstrated strong analytic and problem\-solving abilities.



  





**Expert technical knowledge in three or more and strong technical knowledge in 6 or more of the following domains:** 



* Cryotography, encryption, and key management
* Data protection and security
* Governance and risk management
* Identity, access and permissions
* Infrastructure security
* Logging and monitoring
* Security event and incident response
* Threat and vulnerability management
* Application and interface security
* DevOps pipeline governance and security
* Professional\-level cloud certifications (AWS, Azure)



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) experience \- scripting and automation via AZ CLI/PowerShell, Bash, Bicep, JSON templates etc.
* Deep experience in building Kubernetes environment.
* Prior experience in security Windows and Linux servers at scale. Enabling DevOps in IaaS/PaaS is a plus.
* Experience in multiple programming languages like Python, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Ruby on rails etc.
* CCSK or similar technical security certification.



  





**Experience:** 



* 5\+ years of Cloud development and support experience such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and a Bachelor’s degree or 3 years relevant experience and a Master’s degree.
