f54848cd.title: Cloud Engineer II [T500-28813]
f54848cd.description:
**About McDonald’s:** 




 One of the world’s largest employers with locations in more than 100 countries, McDonald’s Corporation has corporate opportunities in Hyderabad. Our global offices serve as dynamic innovation and operations hubs, designed to expand McDonald's global talent base and in\-house expertise. Our new office in Hyderabad will bring together knowledge across business, technology, analytics, and AI, accelerating our ability to deliver impactful solutions for the business and our customers across the globe.
 



  





**Company Description:** 




 McDonald’s new growth strategy, Accelerating the Arches, encompasses all aspects of our business as the leading global omni\-channel restaurant brand. As the consumer landscape shifts, we are using our competitive advantages to further strengthen our brand. One of our core growth strategies is to Double Down on the 3Ds (Delivery, Digital and Drive Thru). McDonald’s will accelerate technology innovation so 65M\+ customers a day will experience a fast, easy experience, whether at one of our 25,000 and growing Drive Thrus, through McDelivery, dine\-in or takeaway.
 



 Leading this revolution is McDonald’s Global Technology organization made up of intrapreneurs who get to build really cool tech with scary smart people using the latest innovations like AI, IOT, and edge computing. We do this working along diverse, global teams who are always hungry for a challenge. It’s bonus points when you get to see your family and friends use the tech you build at their favorite McD restaurant.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 This opportunity is part of the Global Technology Infrastructure \& Operations team (GTIO), where our mission is to deliver modern and relevant technology that supports the way McDonald’s works. We provide best\-in\-class foundational technology products and services including Global Networking, Cloud, End User Computing, and IT Service Management. It’s our goal to always provide an engaging, relevant, and simple experience for our customers.
 



 The Cloud Security Engineer II role is part of the Cloud Ecosystem team in Global Technology Infrastructure \& Operations. The role reports to the Director of Cloud Security and is responsible for delivering the enterprise security platform engineering outcomes, delivering enhancements and automating security remediations, supporting DevOps and Engineers consuming cloud resources to ensure it is done in a meaningful and secure manner, and engaging with cybersecurity and risk management teams to improve the security posture of the cloud environments.
 



 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technology leader to help shape the transformation of infrastructure and operations products and services to the entire McDonalds environment.
 



  





**Responsibilities \& Accountabilities:** 



* Automate the provisioning of cloud monitors, automated remediation, security baselines and templates, etc through the concept of pipeline engineering.
* Implement core cloud security capabilities such as identity \& access, data protection, security controls and compliance, vulnerability management, threat detection and response, and logging/monitoring.
* Performing penetration testing, red/blue teaming, and gap analysis with audit and cybersecurity partners.
* Support operations and incident response in cloud events and incidents.
* Design and deploy programs, dashboards, tests, scripts, and automation to enhance cloud security posture, detection, and response.
* Build prototypes and perform proof of concepts to demonstrate security value
* Remain up\-to\-date on emerging technologies and architecture and propose ways to use them in current and upcoming projects.
* Educate and guide internal and external team members on cloud standards, procedures, and guidelines/best practices.
* Act as a SME for all Cloud technical hands\-on questions cloud security related.
* Lead and facilitate the creation of compliance automation and policy\-as\-code to streamline cloud governance in partnership with the Technical Product Analyst(s) and Manager(s).
* Strive to provide internal and external customers with excellent customer service and world\-class service and focus on improvement and benefits to the cloud consumer’s outcomes.



  





**Basic Qualifications:** 



* Must be fully vaccinated (i.e., at least 2 weeks after last dose) for COVID\-19 and, if hired, present proof of vaccination by start date.
* Willingness and ability to live the McDonald’s values every day: Serve, Inclusion, Integrity, Community, and Family.
* Ability to effectively communicate with other senior leaders of IT on program strategies and plans and negotiate quality solutions.
* Must be attentive to details, organized, self\-motivated, and driven.
* Ability to create system and process flow diagrams, data flow diagrams, sequence and UML diagrams, inter and intra system dependencies within the functional domain and across them
* Knowledge and understanding of industry trends and new technologies and ability to apply trends to architectural needs.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical staff.
* Defines and promotes best practices; cultivates a culture of innovation and learning, including willingness to instruct and coach in a cloud training program as needed.
* Demonstrated strong analytic and problem\-solving abilities.



  





**Strong technical knowledge in 6 or more of the following domains:** 



* Cryotography, encryption, and key management
* Data protection and security
* Governance and risk management
* Identity, access and permissions
* Infrastructure security
* Logging and monitoring
* Security event and incident response
* Threat and vulnerability management
* Application and interface security
* DevOps pipeline governance and security
* Associate\-level cloud certifications (AWS, Azure)



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) experience \- scripting and automation via AZ CLI/PowerShell, Bash, Bicep, JSON templates etc.
* Deep experience in building Kubernetes environment.
* Prior experience in security Windows and Linux servers at scale. Enabling DevOps in IaaS/PaaS is a plus.
* Experience in multiple programming languages like Python, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Ruby on rails etc.
* CCSK or similar technical security certification.



  





**Experience:** 



* 2\+ years of cloud experience and a Bachelor’s degree.
* Experience in software development (e.g. C\#, .Net, .Net core) or scripting (e.g. Python, Powershell, etc.).

5af809dc.title: Senior Managed Services Consultant
5af809dc.description:
**About ITRS**

 At ITRS, we make society's critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms. 
 



  
 



 We believe when our team thrives, so do our customers. With us, you'll find: 
 



  
 


* **A culture that backs you** 
 \- We're proud to be a Great Place to Work for multiple years in a row due to our inclusive, supportive environment.


* **Work that matters** 
 \- Make a real difference with 1,000s of global customers in industries that keep the world running, including 9 out of 10 top investment banks.


* **Room to grow** 
 \- Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, we're committed to your development. Just ask our team members who've been excelling here for 10\+ years.



  
 



 With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high\-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity\-backed global partner. 
   

  




**Scope of Role**

 Our clients choose Managed Services to ensure Geneos is kept up to date, operational and correctly configured. We also work with our clients to ensure their monitoring is taken to a higher advancement level, to allow them to get the most value out of the product.
 



  
 



 Reporting to our Service Delivery Manager, our Managed Service team monitors all ITRS components in our client environment to ensure they are up and operational. We respond to client queries on how to use the product, requests to make changes and configuration requests where the client requires. Also, we perform project work which includes upgrading and enhancing the client's Geneos environment. We also work with our on\-site team members who are based in Singapore and Mumbai working onsite our client premises.
   




**As an Onsite Senior Managed Services Consultant, you will:**
* **Monitor** 
 ITRS components in our client environment and resolve issues to ensure uptime and Client SLAs are met.
* **Answer Client Queries** 
 providing clients with the information they need to use ITRS products and implementing changes to deliver the latest monitoring for the client.
* **Restore Client Incidents** 
 by investigating and resolving issues with ITRS components in our client environment with assistance.
* **Perform root cause analysis** 
 using problem analysis methodology to assess and diagnose underlying causes of recurring Incidents
* **Hands\-on implementation of technical solutions** 
 to permanently fix reccuring incidents.
* **Monitor progress on the resolution of Known Errors** 
 and ensure best available workaround for Incidents are documented and communicated.
* **Fulfil Client Configuration Requests** 
 by gathering requirements and helping our client configure Geneos implementing within client SLA.
* **Document and share information** 
 by updating the knowledge base to provide accurate troubleshooting for the Managed Services team.
* **Provide ideas and suggestions** 
 improve products, services, or processes.



  
 



**Performance is measured through regular quarterly appraisals with your line manager to include a review of the following:** 



* Quality of client communication by providing concise information to the client.


* Quality of work to the client by meeting our defined standards including quality checks.
* Client satisfaction and feedback of your work.
* Positive contribution to the Managed Service workload by meeting the targets set by your line manager.
* Meet your ticket response and resolution time SLA.
* Meet Geneos uptime SLA by monitoring and resolving incidents.
* Expectation to perform according to our behaviour and values



  
   

  

  




**Requirements**
* Minimum of 6 years' experience in a client\-facing role, preferably within a financial institution, vendor environment, or IT Operations
* Strong experience working in project\-driven and time\-sensitive environments, with the ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues effectively
* Proven track record of initiative and driving continuous improvement
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and user\-friendly manner
* Experience or strong interest in Business Analysis and Project Management practices
* Solid experience with Unix/Linux and Windows operating systems (e.g., Linux, Solaris, Windows Server)
* Working knowledge of databases (e.g., Oracle) and SQL
* Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Bash, Shell, Perl, Python, PowerShell, XML)
* Experience with IT Service Management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy)
* Familiarity with deployment and automation tools (e.g., Chef, Ansible, Jenkins)
* Experience in setup, configuration, and maintenance of IT monitoring tools
* Willingness to work onsite in Mumbai and on a shifting schedule


**Benefits**
* Health insurance with Care
* Provident Fund
* Group personal accident policy
* Generous leave entitlements



 ITRS is an Equal Opportunity employer and Inclusion is part of our everyday life. We celebrate diversity and pride ourselves on providing an environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and have a voice, allowing everyone to contribute equally. We remain committed to advocating inclusion, diversity, and equality into our ITRS family as we grow and enrich our business.
 



  
 



 We welcome applications from everyone in the community as we recognise that a diverse workforce is a stronger workforce.

510e0e46.description:

**Location: Pune and Indore only** 




  





**Role Summary** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Solution Architect with deep expertise in Field Service Management (FSM) or CSM module, HRSD module, IT Service Management (ITSM), CMDB, and enterprise integrations. In this role, you will be responsible for designing scalable and future\-ready ServiceNow solutions, leading customer workshops, translating business requirements into technical architecture, and driving platform modernization initiatives. You will work closely with business stakeholders, delivery teams, and customers to ensure successful implementation of enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
 



  





**What will your role look like?** 




  




* Design and architect scalable ServiceNow solutions across
 **FSM, CSM, HRSD, ITSM, and CMDB modules and Platform Development** 
 .
* Lead discovery sessions and customer workshops to gather business requirements and translate them into technical solution designs.
* Develop solution blueprints, architecture documents, and implementation roadmaps.
* Create intuitive user experiences using ServiceNow UI Builder and Service Portal, including wireframes and mockups.
* Design and oversee integrations with enterprise applications using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other integration platforms.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring adherence to ServiceNow best practices and architectural standards.
* Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, instance health assessments, performance optimization, and modernization initiatives.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers, and client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Mentor development teams and provide guidance on solution design, governance, and implementation best practices.



  





**Why will you love this role?** 




  




* Work on enterprise\-scale digital transformation initiatives using the ServiceNow platform.
* Design innovative and scalable solutions for global customers across multiple industries.
* Collaborate with experienced architects, consultants, and technology leaders.
* Gain exposure to complex integrations, platform modernization, and next\-generation ServiceNow capabilities.
* Enjoy continuous learning opportunities, certifications, and career growth in a collaborative environment.
* Make a significant impact by delivering business\-critical solutions that drive operational excellence.



  





**We would like you to bring along** 




  




* 10\+ years of overall IT experience with strong expertise in ServiceNow solution architecture.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow
 **FSM, CSM, HRSD, ITSM, and CMDB** 
 implementations.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, data model, and best practices.
* Experience with UI Builder, Service Portal, and user experience design.
* Expertise in designing and implementing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and IntegrationHub.
* Experience conducting customer workshops, solution demonstrations, and architectural discussions.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow upgrades, instance management, governance, and platform optimization.
* Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Good\-to\-have skills** 




  




* Experience with Dell Boomi or other enterprise integration platforms.
* Exposure to ServiceNow Integration Hub, Flow Designer, and Automation Engine.
* Knowledge of CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, and ITOM.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA (Certified System Administrator), CAD (Certified Application Developer), and CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist).

d107a4ff.title: Technical Program Manager
d107a4ff.description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem


ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.


As a Technical Program Manager in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!  



Job Purpose


The Technical Program Manager is an individual contributor responsible for implementing portfolio management processes, configuring work management systems, and delivering data analytics that support portfolio visibility, execution, and decision\-making.


This role translates strategic portfolio objectives into operational execution through hands\-on process design, workflow engineering, Agile planning, reporting, and metrics development. The role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Agile, and leadership teams to improve delivery predictability, governance, and business outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


Portfolio \& Process Management


* Design and implement standardized intake workflows, prioritization frameworks, governance processes, and portfolio operating models.
* Establish quarterly planning practices, including PI Planning, capacity planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement routines.
* Create and maintain documentation such as RACI matrices, SOPs, workflow diagrams, process guides, and training materials.
* Drive process adoption through change management, stakeholder engagement, training, and self\-service knowledge resources.
* Conduct process reviews, identify improvement areas, and implement corrective actions.
Partner with Agile coaches and delivery teams to align portfolio processes with team\-level ceremonies.  
* 

Workflow Tool Engineering


* Configure and optimize work management tools including Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, and Power BI.
* Build boards, queries, dashboards, work item hierarchies, automation rules, and reporting structures.
* Create stakeholder\-specific dashboards and reports to support delivery visibility and portfolio governance.
* Provide advanced user support for complex tool, workflow, reporting, and configuration issues.
Develop user guides, FAQs, training materials, and platform enablement resources.  
* 

Data Analytics \& Business Intelligence


* Design and deliver dashboards for executives, program managers, and delivery teams.
* Track portfolio health, milestones, risks, dependencies, budget, and delivery performance.
* Implement and report on DORA Metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, and change failure rate.
* Establish Flow Metrics including cycle time, lead time, throughput, WIP, and flow efficiency.
* Create executive\-level reporting that converts complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
Support forecasting, variance analysis, burn\-rate tracking, and data quality improvements.  
* 

Portfolio Coordination \& Delivery Support


* Coordinate quarterly planning events, governance meetings, and cross\-functional working sessions.
* Track actions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and schedule conflicts.
* Support software initiatives from concept through delivery, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and business outcomes.
* Oversee SDLC execution across requirements, development, testing, release, and post\-launch activities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives for the Biller Portfolio.

Required Qualifications


Education


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Experience


* 2 to 5 years of experience in program management, portfolio operations, PMO, Agile delivery, or related functions.
* Hands\-on experience administering Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar work management tools.
* Experience configuring workflows, dashboards, reports, and process templates.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
* Experience supporting Agile teams using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar methodologies.
* Experience implementing or improving portfolio management processes.

Technical Skills


* Strong proficiency in Azure DevOps including boards, queries, dashboards, and process templates.
* Strong proficiency in Jira/Jira Cloud including JQL, workflows, automation, and portfolio views.
* Working knowledge of Smartsheet, APIs, webhooks, or workflow integrations.
* Proficiency in Power BI, data modeling, DAX, and visualization.
* Strong Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, Power Query, and reporting.
* SQL knowledge for querying and analyzing data.
* Understanding of data quality, validation, and reporting governance.
* Ability to use AI tools for analytics, documentation, analysis, and content preparation.

Methodology \& Metrics Knowledge


* Portfolio management, prioritization, governance, and capacity management.
* Agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
* DevOps practices and engineering productivity measurement.
* ITIL/ITSM and PMI/PMBOK principles preferred.
* Flow Metrics including cycle time, lead time, throughput, and WIP.
* DORA Metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, and change failure rate.
* Financial and portfolio metrics including burn rate, variance analysis, ROI, and resource loading.

Professional Skills


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Ability to adapt communication style for technical, business, and executive audiences.
* Strong facilitation skills for planning sessions and working groups.
* High attention to detail in tool configuration, documentation, and reporting.
* Customer\-service mindset with the ability to support and enable users.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.

Preferred Qualifications


* PMP, CAPM, PMI\-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or similar Agile/program management certification.
* Atlassian, Microsoft, Power BI, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma certification.
* Experience in payments, financial services, SaaS, or regulated industries.
* Experience implementing DORA or Flow Metrics programs.
* Experience with enterprise portfolio management tools such as Planview or ServiceNow PPM.
* Scripting or automation exposure using Python, PowerShell, Groovy, or similar technologies.
* Intermediate SQL skills.

Work Environment


* Standard office environment with frequent computer\-based work.
* Hybrid work model with regular in\-office presence as required.
* Collaboration with global teams across Engineering, Product, Agile, and business functions.
Minimal travel may be required for planning sessions, workshops, or business meetings.  
* 

I n return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.  



Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at **www.aciworldwide.com**

\#LI\-AP


  
ACI Worldwide is a global leader in mission\-critical, real\-time payments software . Our proven, secure and scalable software solutions enable leading corporations, fintechs and financial disruptors to process and manage digital payments , power omni\-commerce payments , present and process bill payments , and manage fraud and risk . We combine our global footprint with a local presence to drive the real\-time digital transformation of payments and commerce.

You will design and build intelligent quoting engines, AI\-assisted pricing rules, automated renewal and amendment flows, and ASC 606\-compliant revenue recognition systems. Your functional understanding of pricing models, deal desk governance, and revenue recognition principles — encoded intelligently using Agentforce, Einstein AI, Claude, and Cursor — is what transforms a CPQ implementation from a configuration exercise into a true revenue intelligence platform.**

**Salesforce Practice**

**Revenue Cloud Technical Lead / Technical Architect**

**Full\-Time \| Revenue Transformation Programs**

**Claude (Anthropic)**

**Cursor IDE**

**ChatGPT\-4o**

**Gemini Code Assist**

**Git, SFDX, Copado**

**SALESFORCE CLOUD EXPERTISE (** ARM mandatory and ANY OF 2 CLOUDS AS MENTIONED BELOW **)**

**Revenue Cloud (CPQ \& Billing)**

**Expert\-level configuration and development across the full CPQ stack: product catalogue, bundles, pricing strategies (list, block, cost\-plus, percentage of total), discount schedules, product rules, price rules, constraint rules, quote templates, multi\-tier approval chains, and order management. Deep Salesforce Billing knowledge: invoice generation, payment processing, usage summaries, credit memos, and revenue schedule management.**

**Advanced Revenue Management (ARM)**

**Hands\-on experience with Salesforce ARM for ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition: performance obligation definition, standalone selling price (SSP) configuration, transaction price allocation, and automated revenue schedule generation. Ensure ARM outputs withstand internal audit and external auditor review.**

**Sales Cloud**

**Deep CPQ\-to\-Sales Cloud integration expertise: Opportunity Products, Contract generation, Order management, Account hierarchy pricing, and partner pricing tiers. Build AI\-assisted Deal Desk workflows and approval automations triggered by CPQ pricing and margin data.**

**Service Cloud**

**Connect Revenue Cloud to service operations: contract entitlements triggering service SLAs, usage\-based billing alerts, automated renewal case creation, and Agentforce Service Agent deflection for billing enquiries and contract amendment requests.**

**Experience Cloud**

**Build CPQ\-connected partner portals enabling partner quoting, deal registration, margin visibility, and self\-service renewal and amendment flows for end customers — reducing revenue team operational overhead.**

**Data Cloud \& Revenue Intelligence**

**Unify product usage, billing, contract, and CRM data in Data Cloud to power AI\-driven upsell/cross\-sell recommendations, renewal risk scoring, and Revenue Intelligence dashboards that give leadership real\-time ARR visibility.**

**INDUSTRY DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE (** ANY ONE OF FOLLOWING **)**

**Hi\-Tech \& SaaS**

* **Subscription pricing models: per\-seat, usage\-based, tiered, hybrid, and consumption\-based billing configurations in Salesforce CPQ**
* **SaaS ARR/MRR/NRR metrics and how Salesforce Billing data feeds into revenue reporting and board\-level financial dashboards**
* **Co\-terming, pro\-ration, and mid\-term amendment logic for SaaS contract changes, upgrades, downgrades, and expansions**
* **Channel sales CPQ: reseller pricing tiers, distributor margins, partner deal registration discount logic, and MDF allocation**
* **PLG (Product\-Led Growth) integration: product telemetry triggering auto\-generated upsell quotes in Salesforce via MCP / API events**

**Healthcare \& Life Sciences**

* **Complex contracting in MedTech and Pharma: GPO contracts, IDN pricing agreements, government pricing, and formulary management**
* **Usage\-based billing for medical devices and clinical SaaS platforms (per\-scan, per\-test, per\-seat) with Salesforce Billing**
* **Compliance considerations affecting pricing configuration: Anti\-Kickback Statute (AKS), Sunshine Act, and government contract requirements**
* **Multi\-site, multi\-entity contract structures common in health systems and hospital networks with parent\-child account hierarchies**
* **RFP\-driven pricing, government contract vehicles (GPO, VA, DoD), and public sector quoting configuration requirements**

**FUNCTIONAL KNOWLEDGE (FOUNDATION FOR AI SOLUTIONS)**

**Deep functional knowledge enables professionals to design AI\-powered Salesforce solutions that reflect real business intent — not just technical requirements. This is what separates good implementations from transformative ones.**

**Configure\-Price\-Quote Business Knowledge**

**Understanding WHY products are bundled, priced, and discounted the way they are — not just HOW to configure it — enables CPQ developers to build AI\-assisted pricing recommendations that respect real margin guardrails, reflect actual commercial strategy, and survive Finance review.**

**Contract Lifecycle \& Amendment Logic**

**Functional fluency in co\-terming, upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations means developers can build amendment and renewal automations that handle real\-world edge cases — not just happy\-path scenarios that break on the first mid\-term change request.**

**Revenue Recognition Principles**

**A working understanding of ASC 606 / IFRS 15 allows CPQ/ARM developers to correctly configure performance obligations, SSP hierarchies, and revenue schedule rules — producing ARM outputs that survive audit without manual correction.**

**Deal Desk \& Approval Governance**

**Understanding the real\-world deal desk process — who approves what, under which margin thresholds, with what exceptions — allows developers to encode intelligent approval routing logic and build Agentforce Deal Desk Agents that mirror actual commercial governance.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Design, build, and configure end\-to\-end Salesforce CPQ implementations: product catalogue architecture, pricing models, bundle configurations, approval workflows, and order generation**
* **Develop Salesforce Billing configurations: invoice runs, payment gateway integrations, usage summaries, credit memos, and tax integrations**
* **Build and maintain Salesforce ARM (Advanced Revenue Management): performance obligation templates, SSP hierarchies, revenue recognition rules, and ASC 606 / IFRS 15 compliant schedules**
* **Develop custom Apex CPQ plugins (pricing plugins, quote calculator plugins, custom action scripts) and LWC components for CPQ UI extensions**
* **Use Cursor and Claude for AI\-pair\-programmed development of complex Apex plugins, pricing scripts, and ERP integration connectors**
* **Integrate CPQ/Billing with ERP systems (SAP, NetSuite, Oracle) via MuleSoft or direct REST APIs for seamless order\-to\-cash automation**
* **Build Agentforce\-powered Deal Desk Agents: AI\-assisted quote structuring, margin analysis, competitive positioning, and approval escalation**
* **Implement DocuSign / Conga CLM integrations for automated quote\-to\-contract document generation and e\-signature workflows**
* **Design and execute CPQ data migration strategies for transitions from legacy quoting systems (Apttus, Zuora CPQ, custom\-built tools)**

**AI \& AGENTFORCE SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Build Agentforce Deal Desk Agents with CPQ\-aware skills: AI\-assisted quote structuring, upsell identification, discount guardrails, and approval workflow initiation**
* **Use Einstein Prompt Builder to generate AI\-authored Executive Summary fields on quotes — surfacing key deal terms, risk flags, and competitive context to approvers**
* **Expose CPQ pricing waterfall, quote configuration, and approval status via MCP servers for conversational deal intelligence in AI assistants**
* **Use Claude or Codex to generate complex CPQ Apex pricing scripts, product rule logic, constraint rules, and comprehensive Apex test classes**
* **Integrate Revenue Intelligence AI dashboards with CPQ data to identify renewal risk, churn patterns, and expansion opportunities from billing and usage signals**
* **Build AI\-assisted renewal flows: Agentforce proactively identifies contracts approaching renewal, generates renewal quotes, and triggers approval and outreach workflows**
* **Implement Einstein Deal Insights integration to surface CPQ anomalies — unusual discounts, configuration errors, missing required fields — before quotes reach deal desk review**

**TECHNICAL SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Salesforce CPQ (Steelbrick) — Expert**
* **Salesforce Billing \& Revenue Schedules**
* **Salesforce ARM (ASC 606 / IFRS 15\)**
* **CPQ Apex Plugins \& Pricing Scripts**
* **LWC custom CPQ UI components**
* **REST/SOAP APIs for ERP integration**
* **Agentforce Agent Builder**
* **Einstein Prompt Builder**
* **MuleSoft / Boomi integration**
* **DocuSign / Conga CLM integration**
* **Git, SFDX, Copado CI/CD**
* **Cursor / Claude AI\-pair development**
**NICE TO HAVE**

* **Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist or Revenue Cloud Consultant credential**
* **Salesforce Industries (Vlocity) Contract Lifecycle Management experience**
* **Zuora or Chargebee migration experience to Salesforce Billing**
* **Revenue Intelligence (formerly Clari) or Gong integration experience**
* **MEDDICC / MEDDPICC sales methodology and its CPQ data model implications**
* **Multi\-currency, multi\-entity, and multi\-language CPQ configuration for global enterprises**

**SOFT SKILLS \& MINDSET**

* **High commercial acumen and pricing intuition**
* **Precision in technical documentation and audit trails**
* **Challenges commercial configuration decisions constructively**
* **Strong Finance, Legal, and Sales Ops collaboration**
* **Navigates complex approval hierarchies with confidence**
* **Identifies revenue leakage and quoting inefficiency proactively**

c7d8e82f.title: Technical Lead Architect - CTI MD
c7d8e82f.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  

About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  

About Technology@Lilly
  
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  

**About the Business Function:**  

CTI\-MD enable the digital capabilities that power Lilly's clinical development and patient safety ecosystem. We build connected trial platforms, AI\-driven solutions, and data products that support study design, trial execution, clinical insights, and pharmacovigilance. Our teams help ensure patient safety through the collection, assessment, monitoring, and reporting of safety data while accelerating the development of life\-changing medicines. By combining clinical expertise with engineering excellence, we improve patient and site experiences, strengthen regulatory compliance, and drive innovation across the development lifecycle.
  
  

**Role:**  

The Sr. System Architect, Global Patient Safety operates at the intersection of business context, product management, engineering, data, AI, and enterprise architecture for the GPS portfolio — accountable for technology strategy, architecture direction, and measurable business outcomes across Pharmacovigilance. This role is split 70% hands\-on technical execution including coding and 30% strategy, and shapes the future technology landscape. The role balances delivery needs with long\-term vision for scalable, secure, compliant, and maintainable solutions; drives transformation and future\-state platforms; mentors technical leaders; and represents GPS as a global partner in enterprise architecture decision\-making — bridging business stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams while building a durable architecture capability inside Lilly. Operates at the senior system architect level, engaging across the enterprise — including Enterprise Architecture — and providing technical leadership across the full solution lifecycle, from design through implementation
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Portfolio Architecture Ownership — own end\-to\-end technical architecture across the Safety ecosystem (Case Management, Signals, Reporting) and connected Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, and Data systems; set portfolio\-level architecture roadmaps and standards, preparing decisions ahead of delivery rather than resolving them reactively. Understands the pharmacovigilance system, its business context, and adjacent platforms shaping upstream/downstream decisions.
* AI / Agentic Architecture Enablement — convert emerging AI/agentic use cases into reusable, governed architecture patterns, translating proofs\-of\-concept into production\-ready solutions that scale across the portfolio; partner with AI, engineering, and vendor teams to embed AI/agentic components responsibly within safety architecture and compliance guardrails. Requires deep, broad technology knowledge — cloud\-native services, data products, and responsible\-AI controls.
* Governance, Risk \& GxP Compliance — embed audit\-readiness and change\-control thinking into architecture patterns, ensuring compliance with FDA/EMA and internal IT/quality policies; maintain architecture documentation in support of audit, inspection, and CSV readiness; evaluate technical debt in legacy Safety and Regulatory systems and shift governance upstream to reduce late\-stage compliance issues. Leverages adjacent\-system knowledge to drive robust business discussions and influence how GPS platforms evolve.
* Vendor Independence \& Knowledge Retention — serve as the primary technical authority for architecture judgement, reducing reliance on vendors (e.g., Veeva, Qinesca, etc.), with delivery partners executing within Lilly\-owned guardrails; act as the primary technical point of contact for vendor teams, leading design and configuration decisions that protect long\-term design integrity.
* Product \& Business Partnership — partner with Patient Safety, Quality, Regulatory, and IT stakeholders to translate business strategy into technology capabilities, articulating trade\-offs and risks that inform prioritisation; participate in strategic planning and portfolio reviews as a trusted advisor to business and technology leadership. Challenges the status quo, recommending improvements to team processes, governance, and control patterns that drive innovation
* Global Leadership — represent GPS Tech in global architecture forums, building partnerships across global Patient Safety technology teams; drive shared ownership and accountability models between India and global organisations, promoting Lilly's product operating model principles across GPS. Actively promotes ideas and impacts decisions across multiple teams and capabilities — leading, global architecture direction.
* Decision\-Making Authority — make strategic architecture recommendations and approve major solution and integration designs across the GPS portfolio; influence technology investment decisions and challenge product, engineering, or vendor approaches when architectural or compliance risks exist; recommend platform standardisation opportunities and escalate enterprise architectural or GxP concerns to leadership when necessary. Breaks down complex portfolio problems into decisions delivering broad business impact and measurable risk reduction.
* Talent Development \& Technical Leadership — mentor engineering leads, building architecture capability through coaching and communities of practice; create a succession path for future GPS architecture leadership, with emphasis on growing technical talent, and contribute to hiring and talent planning; review and approve technical designs and configuration specifications for quality and compliance. Coaches through design reviews and communities of practice to broaden team impact.


**Qualifications Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred).
* 12\+ years in IT/enterprise/portfolio architecture or senior technical leadership, including 4\+ years supporting pharmacovigilance or patient safety technology and processes (case intake, triage, signal management, regulatory reporting).
* Demonstrated ownership of architecture decisions at a portfolio or platform level across multiple concurrent programmes.
* Proven experience designing, deploying, or governing AI/agentic solutions, scaling POCs into production architecture.
* Deep hands\-on experience with Pharmacovigilance (Safety) and their integration with Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, and Data platforms.
* Strong command and hands\-on experience with enterprise integration patterns (APIs, middleware, ETL, data mapping), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure), and integration middleware \& architecture development.
* Experience operating in regulated (GxP) environments, including computer system validation (CSV) and inspection\-readiness practices.
* Strong communication skills, translating complex technical architecture into business and regulatory language for senior stakeholders.
* Experience chairing or presenting to architecture review boards / governance forums, and influencing senior leadership on technology investment and risk trade\-offs.
* Track record of building and scaling architecture capability within a global, distributed delivery model — including establishing communities of practice and mentoring paths for engineering leads.
* Working knowledge of Agile\-at\-scale and product operating model practices (backlog governance, value\-stream mapping) applied to a regulated technology portfolio.
* Demonstrate success negotiating and governing multi\-vendor delivery arrangements at an enterprise or portfolio scale, with clear separation of Lilly\-owned vs. vendor\-executed responsibilities.
* Demonstrate ability to break down complex, portfolio\-level problems into initiatives that drive broad business impact.
* Recognised subject\-matter expert in one or more core GPS technologies, with demonstrated initiative to continuously learn and adopt emerging tools and technologies.
* Coaching and continuous\-improvement leadership — growing technical capability, challenging the status quo, and driving adoption of improved architecture practices.
* Influence across multiple teams, functions, and governance forums, gaining support from business and technology partners.


**Preferred:**  

* Veeva Vault platform training/certification.
* Experience in global, distributed delivery models and global technical leadership; experience representing in global enterprise architecture or product governance forums.
* Strategic and analytical thinking — preparing architecture decisions ahead of delivery rather than reacting to them.
* Strong vendor governance, management, and negotiation skills; ownership mindset managing multiple priorities, stakeholders, and concurrent programmes.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, driving clarity around architecture dependencies and portfolio\-level timelines.
* Excellent communicator — articulates role scope, independence, and portfolio impact
* Functional influence mindset — gains support for architecture decisions across GPS, product, engineering, Quality, Security, and vendor stakeholders.


At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. This is not just a policy. It is who we are.
  
  

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
  
  

Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

* Lead customers through the end\-to\-end cloud delivery lifecycle from solution design through environment handover.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives around cloud deployment and delivery processes.
* Participate in pre\-sales discussions, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, and technical assessments when required.

* 8\-12 years of experience in Cloud Consulting, Cloud Architecture, ERP Delivery, Infrastructure Engineering, or Technical Solution Consulting.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud delivery methodologies.
* Experience supporting enterprise application deployments and cloud\-based environments.
* Knowledge of ERP implementation and delivery lifecycles.

5b05a254.title: AI Architect
5b05a254.description:
About the job
 



  





**AI Solutions Architect** 




 Searce's AI Architects design and deliver applied AI solutions \- owning technical execution end\-to\-end while growing the next generation of solutions consultants.
 



  





**Your Mission: The Role** 




 solving for better.
 



  





 You're a transformation\-owning, outcome\-delivering, forward\-deployed solver (FDS) who architects AI\-native systems that move from hype to real outcomes. As a Directly Responsible Individual (DRI), you'll design and spearhead applied AI architectures that reimagine how enterprises work, compete, and grow.
 



 This isn't the typical architect role — success here isn't measured in reference diagrams or "innovation theater." At Searce, you prototype, build, and deploy real\-world AI platforms that embed into workflows, scale responsibly, and generate measurable enterprise impact.
 



 This role is about engineering the future and building the bridge between business vision and scalable reality. If you're a strategist who can architect, a builder who can influence, and a visionary who can blueprint the complex — we've got a seat for you at the front of the table.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities** 




 what you will wake up to solve.
 



  





 You are the founder, the architect, and the DRI who bridges AI vision with enterprise\-ready systems.
 



 Your mission is to futurify enterprise platforms with applied AI — from architecture to adoption — while ensuring scalability, security, and responsibility.
 



 Here's how you'll make your mark:
 


* **Architect \& Lead:** 
 Lead and own the outcome of all POCs that showcase Searce's capabilities. Deliver compelling presentations and demonstrations.
* **Enable AI\-Powered Products:** 
 Develop and design comprehensive solution proposals, technical specifications, and business use\-cases.
* **Mentor \& Grow:** 
 Guide the architectural design of cloud, data, and AI solutions, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and directly aligned with client requirements.
* **Optimize Performance \& Cost:** 
 Continuously optimize AI models and architectures — across Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI stacks — for performance, efficiency, and cost\-effectiveness, ensuring solutions deliver maximum value.
* **Pre\-Sales Leadership:** 
 Lead technical engagements, workshops, POCs, and demos that showcase real AI ROI to enterprise customers.
* **Build \& Deliver:** 
 Drive AI reference architectures into production\-ready solutions that integrate seamlessly into enterprise IT ecosystems.
* **Client Partnership:** 
 Engage deeply with executives and technical leaders, becoming a trusted advisor on their AI transformation journey.
* **Stay Ahead:** 
 Track emerging AI/ML trends (generative AI, copilots, agent frameworks) across the frontier model landscape — Google, Anthropic, OpenAI — and apply them intelligently to unlock enterprise value.



  





**Functional Skills** 




  




* **Technical Consulting Mastery:** 
 Translate complex business challenges into applied AI\-enabled architectures.
* **Team Leadership:** 
 Manage, mentor, and inspire high\-performing AI solution architects.
* **Architectural Visionary:** 
 Designs and co\-creates comprehensive solution blueprints, championing an engineering\-first design philosophy.
* **Enterprise\-Grade Architecture:**

80718a14.title: Sr. Program Manager - POD, Pay on Delivery
80718a14.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We are the cash people!  

  

Cash / Pay on delivery is the largest instrument of choice by customers on Amazon.in (and in other similar emerging markets where we are expanding) – this despite the rapid advances in digital payments technology space. Customers continue to prefer Pay on Delivery (POD), not only because they want to pay by cash (indeed half of our COD customers pay digitally at doorstep!) – but because it solves many other needs for them – Building trust in the Amazon marketplace, peace of mind to only pay when the item is delivered, and not block money until then, ordering for friends and family who are not digitally savvy etc.  

  

On the other hand, POD also has its down\-sides: it leads to low\-intent purchases, casual rejects and abuse from some customers, which impacts the sustainability of the instrument. Hence there is a need to continuously shape the POD offering, to make it available for the good customers, while reducing its access to the not\-so\-good customers, and make it an overall more sustainable business lever for Amazon.  

  

Our mission is to make POD a sustainable and profitable payment instrument for Amazon's flywheel, enabling more and better POD access to all Amazon customers providing a first\-class payment experience better or at least at par with prepaid instruments.  

Our vision is to build POD into an APP that enables customers to pay using cash/ digitally at doorstep seamlessly, for physical goods as well as digital services on Amazon as well as external merchants, helping businesses to scale faster and sustainably.  

We work on improving Customer experience and sustainability for POD – across onsite availability and experience, post\-order payment experience, doorstep experience, refund experience and managing overall instrument P\&L.  

  

This role will own the management of the Cost\-to\-Serve for Pay on Delivery. You will need to identify and run interventions to reduce cost of offering POD \- across reducing rejects, optimizing POD availability to spur growth, and managing POD 3P vendors.  

  

The role will be also be the primary interface for both global and cross\-functional, cross\-departmental teams to conceptualize, execute, track and report progress on the program interventions \- including Product, Machine Learning, Cost of Business Waste, Finance, Last Mile Operations, Shopping Experience and Technology.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Program interventions to reduce POD rejects: Research on why customers are rejecting on POD, build the right reject attribution to differentiate between customer controllable vs non\-controllable rejects and run targeted interventions through Weblabs to reduce POD rejects
* GTM of POD Initiatives: Identify what would increase the adoption of POD Initiatives with customers, run GTM (Go\-To\-Market) plan, improve customer targeting and iterate through experiments to increase OPS/GMS while keeping POD Rejects in check
* POD PnL: Establish POD PnL and Identify opportunities to increase the bottom\-line, increasing revenue and cutting down costs
* Vendor management \- Work with POD 3P vendors to optimize the cost of POD operations, communication channels like SMS/ WhatsApp to reduce POD OpEx
* Cross\-functional stakeholder management: Work with Cost of Business Waste, Category teams to identify drivers, opportunity areas for POD rejects, track actions through WBR/ MBRs

  

A day in the life  

You start your day reviewing POD performance metrics on POD availability, POD share, POD rejects and POD overall P\&L and costs.  

  

Throughout the day, you collaborate with Product, Machine Learning, Cost of Business Waste, Category, Shopping Experience teams to refine customer segmentation models, meet with operations teams to optimize delivery processes, and analyze data to identify trends in customer payment preferences.  

  

You will be required to ideate, research on customer needs/pain points, thoroughly analyze data, generate insights, develop proof of concepts, write compelling business cases and gain agreement from Leaders across levels \& functions, to implement the solutions.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of professional or military experience
* Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
* Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps
* Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience structuring and negotiating complex agreements and leading cross\-functional groups to orchestrate and successfully complete deals
* Experience working in a fast\-moving consumer business
* MBA

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

a5dc10e0.title: Senior Solutions Lead (Pre-Sales & Implementation)
a5dc10e0.description:
Knowmax is an AI Knowledge Management platform built for enterprise CX teams. Telecom, BFSI, healthcare and BPO leaders use us to turn scattered process documentation into guided, AI\-ready answers their agents and customers can act on, across every channel.
 



 Governed knowledge that drives action. That is the whole idea.
 



 We are part of the KocharTech group, and we serve enterprise customers across North America, the GCC, Southeast Asia and APAC. The US is our biggest growth bet right now, and this role sits close to it.
 



  





 THE ROLE
 



  





 You win the deal, then you deliver it.
 



 Most companies split this into two jobs and lose something in the handover. The promise made in the demo quietly becomes someone else's problem at kickoff. We keep it in one pair of hands. You shape the technical solution during the sales cycle, then own the implementation once the contract is signed.
 



 Roughly half your time is pre\-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, RFPs. The other half is implementation: configuration, integrations, go\-live, early adoption. In practice the split flexes week to week with whatever is closing or going live.
 



 You will be the technical face of Knowmax to enterprise buyers and the steady hand that gets them live. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership individual contributor seat, not a people management track.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 Pre\-sales
 


* Run technical discovery. Map the prospect's contact centre stack, content estate and integration surface before anyone promises anything
* Build and deliver tailored demos and proofs of concept against the buyer's actual use cases, not a generic script
* Own the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs and security questionnaires
* Work alongside sales as the trusted technical advisor through the deal cycle
* Translate requirements into clear solution designs, scopes of work and timelines we can actually hold
* Call out the deals we should not chase. A clean no early is worth more to us than a messy yes.



  





 Implementation
 


* Own enterprise implementations end to end, from kickoff to go\-live
* Configure the platform, run integrations across CRM, CCaaS, ticketing, SSO and APIs, and oversee content migration
* Run onboarding and enablement so customer teams genuinely adopt what we build, not just receive it
* Coordinate across customer success, engineering and product to clear blockers
* Build the implementation playbooks, templates and documentation that make the next ten deployments faster than the last



  





 WHAT THE FIRST SIX MONTHS LOOK LIKE
 


* Month 1: fluent in the product. Shadowing live deals and one active implementation
* Month 3: running discovery and demos independently, and owning at least one enterprise implementation through to go\-live
* Month 6: the default technical voice on our largest pursuits, with a documented implementation playbook a new joiner can follow



  





 WHAT YOU BRING
 



 Must have
 


* 6 to 10 years in solutions engineering, technical pre\-sales, implementation or customer\-facing technical delivery, ideally in enterprise SaaS
* Working command of enterprise integrations: REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and SAML, and the common CX stack (Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Genesys, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Freshworks, Microsoft Dynamics)
* Enough fluency in how modern AI knowledge systems work to lead a credible discovery conversation: retrieval quality, grounding answers in source content, handling accuracy and hallucination concerns, and what it takes to get a customer's content AI\-ready
* Presence with both technical evaluators and business sponsors, often in the same room
* Hands\-on configuration ability. You are comfortable in the detail of a deployment, not just the diagram of one
* Experience carrying enterprise security and compliance conversations: SOC 2, data residency, access control
* Writing that holds up. Solution documents, scopes and responses a CIO will actually read
* Engineering background is a must



  





 Nice to have
 


* Contact centre or CX domain background
* Exposure to US, GCC or Southeast Asia enterprise buyers
* Multilingual or Arabic deployment experience
* Time at a company scaling from early traction to repeatable enterprise delivery



  





 THE PRACTICAL STUFF
 


* Based in Gurgaon, WFO
* Our customers sit in North America, EMEA and APAC, so part of your day shifts earlier or later to meet them. That is a flexed schedule, not extra hours stacked on top of a full office day
* Occasional travel for key customer engagements. Frequency depends on the accounts you support



 WHY THIS SEAT
 



 You report to the CTO and work close to the leadership team. You will see a deal from first call to first value, which is rare in enterprise software and hard to learn any other way. The playbooks and documentation you build become how the company sells and delivers as we scale in the US and the GCC.
 



 If you like both selling the vision and making it real, this is the seat.

cc91a24b.description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

 As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe, or helping find cures for cancer.
   

  

 How will you make an impact?
   

  

 Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as a
 **Program Manager** 
 and play a key role in driving innovation and operational excellence across our organization. As a program leader, you will coordinate cross\-functional projects that support scientific advancement and customer success. You will manage programs from customer engagement through successful product delivery, ensuring disciplined execution while fostering collaboration across functional teams. This role offers the opportunity to apply your program management expertise to deliver high\-quality outcomes that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
   

  

 In this position, you will develop and maintain integrated project plans, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and communicate effectively with stakeholders throughout the organization. You will proactively identify and mitigate risks, facilitate timely decision\-making, and drive accountability to ensure successful program execution. Your organizational skills, collaborative approach, and ability to manage competing priorities will be essential in delivering projects on time, within budget, and to quality expectations.
   

  

 What you will do?
   

  

* Lead, manage, coordinate, and be accountable for the execution of programs from Customer Engagement through Product Delivery, Launch, and Program Closure.
* Manage multiple projects and programs simultaneously with varying levels of complexity and scope.
* Serve as the primary communication link between the Core Team and key stakeholders, providing regular status updates and escalating issues when appropriate.
* Prepare and present Program Reviews and project status updates to functional leadership; facilitate issue resolution and exception reviews as required.
* Lead cross\-functional teams to define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines.
* Develop resource plans and partner with functional managers to secure required project resources.
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans aligned with business objectives, project constraints, and identified risks.
* Drive program risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and issue resolution throughout the project lifecycle.
* Monitor project progress, communicate status to stakeholders, resolve schedule deviations, and facilitate core team meetings.
* Collaborate across functional areas, including R\&D, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Service, and other key stakeholders, to ensure successful program execution.
* Lead program closeout activities, including lessons learned, best practice documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with core team members, extended teams, functional managers, and key stakeholders.


 Key to Success:
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in program or project management leading cross\-functional technical initiatives.
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Business, or related technical discipline.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
* Agile or SAFe certifications are advantageous.


 Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:
   

  

* Demonstrated experience successfully managing cross\-functional programs and delivering business results.
* Working knowledge of product development processes, stage\-gate methodologies, and quality systems.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage stakeholders across multiple organizational levels.
* Proven ability to lead and influence cross\-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
* Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Ability to identify project risks, develop mitigation plans, and drive timely issue resolution.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and relationship\-building skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently while driving accountability and execution.
* Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of overall program objectives and business priorities.
* Experience with project management methodologies, tools, and best practices.
* Proficiency with project management software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Basic financial management skills, including project budget tracking and resource planning.
* Ability to adapt communication and leadership style based on project needs and stakeholder audience.

e2dd871d.description:
**Job Summary:**


Responsible for analyzing and gathering business and technical requirements to design and document fit\-for\-purpose solutions. Contributes to solution development, design, integration and testing, and configuration of technology solutions ensuring that delivered solutions adhere to defined architecture and security standards. Works closely with with cross\-functional teams, vendors, and business partners to ensure smooth execution and continuous improvement in solution performance and quality. Ensure seamless solution implementation and effective issue resolution.


**Key Responsibilities:**


Supports the design of fit\-for\-purpose solutions by collaborating with stakeholders to identify integration points and ensure alignment with business processes and goals. Supports technical analysis, design and customization of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial\-off\-the\-shelf products versus custom built solution. Develops and maintains technical design documents, workflows, and architecture diagrams. Assists in defining and executing the test strategy and validating solutions against business objectives. Ensures smooth interoperability by validating integrations and documenting configuration steps. Identifies and communicates potential technical dependencies and risks. Works with vendors and IT service providers to address technical issues, evaluate and improve product functionality and ensure proper configuration according to design specifications. Designs and implements data migration solutions to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Develops, designs, tests, maintains and configures solutions and systems as needed. Serves as subject matter expert and point of contact on content, processes, procedures and functionality associated with assigned applications for projects and application support (as needed). Documents recommendations to enhance business process efficiency and increase adoption of standard application features and capabilities, aligning solutions with enterprise standards. 8ac92873.description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope
   

  

 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade\-offs.
   

  

 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.

**About the position:**

This is an amazing opportunity for the sales professional who has a history of completely dominating their territory and who wants to make an impact on building the next iconic cloud security company.

* Deliver effective demos, best practices session on UCs, deployments \& workshops as needed

* Help partners create evaluation test plans with customers that highlight the strengths of our platform to position Netskope as the clear cloud security leader

**Job Requirements:**
