08f11ee9.title: Principal - Solution Engineering
08f11ee9.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of "solutions" that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  





**There's another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**




 Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
   

  





**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**



**Job Description**

 As a GSI Solution Architect, you will be the technical and solution engine behind our Global Systems Integrator ecosystem, with a dedicated focus on Employee Experience and Freshservice.
   

  





 You will help GSI partners find, shape, and progress new business and expansion opportunities — bringing solution credibility to early conversations, turning employee service challenges into structured opportunities, and building the assets and capability that let partners eventually run these motions themselves.
   

  





 You will work day\-to\-day with two Business Development colleagues and our GSI Partner Managers, and partner closely with Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, and Professional Services. This is a commercially aligned role — you will be measured on partner\-sourced ARR — but it is not a pure sales role. Solution leadership, partner enablement, and technical credibility are the core of the job.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Work with GSI partners to identify and shape new Freshservice opportunities linked to employee service transformation.
* Support early\-stage discovery with partner teams and end customers, translating service challenges into structured solution opportunities.
* Build solution narratives across ITSM modernisation, employee self\-service, workflow automation, knowledge management, and legacy ITSM migration.
* Identify where existing EX or ITSM footprints can expand into broader Enterprise Service Management — HR, Finance, Facilities, Legal, Procurement, Security, and Operations.
* Position AI as a practical accelerator: self\-service, ticket deflection, agent assist, knowledge discovery, and automation.
* Equip our two Business Development colleagues with messaging, discovery questions, and qualification guides, and join calls where solution credibility is needed.
* Deliver enablement sessions for GSI sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams, and support their certification and readiness.
* Create reusable assets — demo flows, reference architectures, discovery guides, and partner playbooks — that scale beyond any single deal.
* Support partner account planning and contribute to the quality and conversion of partner\-sourced pipeline.


**Qualifications**

**Required**



* Experience in solution architecture, presales, consulting, or partner solution engineering.
* Strong understanding of Employee Experience, ITSM, ESM, service desk modernisation, and internal service delivery.
* Experience working with GSIs, systems integrators, consulting firms, or other partner\-led business models.
* Ability to build EX, ESM, and AI solution narratives, and to support both new business and expansion motions.
* Understanding of AI use cases in service management — self\-service, agent assist, automation, knowledge, and ticket deflection.
* Experience creating demos, discovery guides, enablement content, and reference architectures.
* Comfortable being commercially aligned to partner\-sourced ARR.
* Strong stakeholder management across partner, sales, product, and technical teams, with excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Based in or able to work from Chennai.



**Preferred**



* Experience with Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC, Ivanti, ManageEngine, or similar ITSM/ESM platforms.
* Experience supporting partner\-sourced or partner\-influenced revenue motions, or GSI\-led transformation programmes.
* Experience working with Indian or global GSI partners.
* Familiarity with ITIL, workflow automation, and internal service operations.
* Ability to build business cases, value propositions, and repeatable go\-to\-market plays.
* Experience supporting migrations from legacy ITSM platforms.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

55fb7e3a.title: Lead, Enterprise Architect
55fb7e3a.description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Lead, Enterprise Architect – Enterprise Architecture**

**Your Role**


We are seeking a technically hands\-on Enterprise Architect who combines strong architecture expertise with practical engineering capability. This individual will operate as a player\-coach, contributing directly to solution design and implementation \- writing code, building automation, and enhancing AI\-driven solutions.


This role is ideal for an architect who does not want to stay purely at the conceptual level, but instead actively participates in building, prototyping, and evolving enterprise solutions alongside engineering teams.


Requirements/Responsibilities

**Architecture and Engineering Execution**


Design and evolve enterprise architecture patterns across cloud, SaaS, and AI\-enabled platforms


Directly contribute to codebases where appropriate (e.g., APIs, automation, integrations, AI agents)


Develop proofs\-of\-concept and reference implementations to validate architectural decisions


Develop solution designs for enterprise architecture solutions and consult with other teams as needed

**AI and Automation Development**


Design, build, and enhance AI agents and copilots using modern frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, LangChain, Semantic Kernel)


Contribute to prompt engineering, orchestration logic, and integration patterns


Automate enterprise governance and operational processes using tools such as Power Automate, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, or similar

**Platform \& Integration Engineering**


Write and review code for APIs, microservices, and integration layers


Build reusable services and automation pipelines that accelerate delivery teams


Assist in debugging, performance tuning, and resolving complex technical issues

**Governance \& Standards**


Define and enforce architecture standards while ensuring they are practical and implementable


Partner with engineering teams to ensure alignment between architecture and delivery


Support modern engineering practices (CI/CD, IaC, testing strategies) into enterprise workflows

**Collaboration \& Leadership**


Act as a bridge between architecture and engineering teams


Provide hands\-on technical guidance and mentorship to developers and solution architects


Engage with stakeholders to align technical solutions with business needs

**Programming \& Development**


Proficiency in Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript


Experience building APIs, services, and automation workflows


Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices

**Cloud \& Platforms**


Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred)


Experience building and deploying cloud\-native applications (containers, serverless, microservices)

**AI \& Emerging Technology**


Practical experience building or integrating AI/ML or LLM\-based solutions


Understanding of agent\-based architectures, prompt orchestration, and AI governance


Ability to evaluate and apply emerging technologies in real\-world enterprise contexts

**Preferred Skills**


AI System \& Agentic Workflows


Design, build, and optimize agentic AI systems using modern agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, Haystack Agents, ReAct\-style agents).


Implement multi\-agent collaboration patterns, task orchestration, memory architectures, tool integrations, and reasoning\-enhancing strategies.


Develop secure, robust, and scalable tool‑calling and function\-execution flows for agents operating in dynamic environments.

**Automation \& Integration**


Experience with workflow automation tools (Power Automate, Logic Apps, etc.)


Strong understanding of system integration patterns (REST, messaging, event\-driven architecture)

**Enterprise Architecture**


Knowledge of architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) with a pragmatic, execution\-focused mindset


Experience defining architecture patterns, standards, and reusable design components

**Qualifications**


Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience. Knowledge of enterprise architecture principles, patterns, and best practices, with familiarity in cloud computing and SaaS models. Excellent consultative and communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with business, partner, and IT stakeholders. Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Architect, or TOGAF a plus Experience in financial services or other highly regulated environments Familiarity with governance, compliance, and risk frameworks (e.g., NIST, FFIEC, GDPR)

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

c4d08637.title: Technical Delivery Manager- LINA GI
c4d08637.description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S\&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: http://www.chubb.com/


**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution\-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organisation that is dedicated to solving real\-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.


**Position Details:**

**Job Title:** Technical Delivery Manager


**Function/Department:** Technology


**Location:** Hyderabad


**Employment Type:** Full\-time  



**Position Overview:**

As a Technical Delivery Manager, you will be accountable for end\-to\-end technology delivery across LINA Korea’s application portfolio as work is established within CECI. You will translate business priorities into clear delivery plans, manage execution across engineering squads, remove impediments, coordinate dependencies, and ensure high\-quality releases across applications, integrations, platforms, and operational changes. The role requires a strong blend of delivery leadership, technical understanding, stakeholder management, governance discipline, and hands\-on ownership of outcomes. You will partner closely with Korea business and technology stakeholders, product owners, architects, engineering leads, QA, DevOps, security, vendors, and CECI leadership to build a predictable, scalable, and high\-performing delivery capability from the ground up.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* • Own end\-to\-end technical delivery for LINA Korea initiatives managed through CECI, ensuring predictable execution, quality outcomes, and alignment with business priorities
  

• Translate business demand, product priorities, and technology objectives into integrated delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and release roadmaps
  

• Lead day\-to\-day delivery governance across engineering squads, including sprint planning, backlog readiness, execution tracking, dependency management, RAID management, and stakeholder reporting
  

• Partner with engineering leads, architects, QA, DevOps, security, infrastructure, vendors, and business teams to ensure delivery commitments are clearly understood and actively managed
  

• Drive technical delivery across Java, APIs, enterprise platforms, integration services, databases, cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, and production support activities
  

• Ensure delivery teams follow disciplined engineering practices, including requirements traceability, solution design reviews, secure development, code quality, automated testing, release readiness, and operational handover
  

• Establish clear operating rhythms between Korea stakeholders and CECI teams, including status reviews, governance forums, escalation paths, decision tracking, and continuous improvement loops
  

• Manage delivery risks and issues proactively, escalating blockers early with options, impact assessment, mitigation plans, and ownership clarity
  

• Track delivery performance through meaningful metrics such as milestone adherence, sprint predictability, defect trends, release quality, production stability, and dependency closure
  

• Support portfolio planning, capacity management, prioritisation, and financial alignment by providing reliable management information and transparent delivery insights
  

• Promote the practical use of AI\-enabled delivery and engineering tools, such as Copilot, Claude Code, and similar platforms, to improve documentation, analysis, testing, reporting, and engineering productivity with appropriate governance
  

• Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across geographically distributed teams

  
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline
* 12–15 years of technology delivery experience, including proven experience managing complex application delivery, engineering squads, or transformation initiatives
* Strong technical understanding of full\-stack application delivery, preferably across Java, APIs, microservices, integration patterns, databases, cloud services, and modern DevOps practices
* Proven ability to manage delivery plans, sprint execution, release schedules, dependencies, risks, issues, and cross\-functional delivery governance
* Experience working with product owners, architects, engineering leads, QA, DevOps, security, infrastructure, vendors, and business stakeholders across distributed teams
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, SDLC governance, release management, change management, production readiness, and operational support models
* Ability to create clear delivery reporting, RAID logs, milestone plans, dependency maps, executive updates, and management information that supports decision\-making
* Experience in regulated enterprise environments, preferably insurance, financial services, or other complex technology\-led organisations
* Practical familiarity with tooling such as Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Confluence, ServiceNow, CI/CD platforms, dashboards, and AI\-assisted productivity tools such as Copilot or Claude Code
* Strong commercial and delivery discipline, with the ability to align scope, capacity, timelines, risks, and financial tracking across a portfolio of work
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, and escalation management skills
* High ownership mindset with the ability to bring structure to ambiguity, build trust across markets, and drive outcomes in a greenfield delivery setup

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation\-driven environment.  
* 

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!


Our constant focus on employee experience, along with a start\-up\-like culture, empowers you to achieve impactful results.


* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to Work: Chubb India has been recognised as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023\-2024, 2024\-2025 and 2025\-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb, we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness, where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start\-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start\-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment  
* 

**Employee Benefits**

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well\-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision\-related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:


* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialised benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long\-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customised programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees’ well\-being in and out of work and have benefits like a hybrid work environment, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.  
* 

**Application Process**

Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent and inclusive.


Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal.


Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.


Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).


Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership.


**Join Us**

With you, Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India’s journey.


**Apply Now** : Search Jobs \- Chubb Careers

79196b4d.description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
Job Summary
  
  

The Senior Specialist \- Unified Messaging \& Collaboration (UMC) Services is an E5\-level technical expert responsible for end\-to\-end ownership, engineering, administration, operations, optimization, governance, and strategic evolution of enterprise Messaging, Collaboration, Directory Services, Email Relay Infrastructure, and associated Application Operations platforms. This role serves as a senior individual contributor and technical leader accountable for ensuring highly available, secure, scalable, and resilient collaboration ecosystems supporting global business operations.
  
  

The position requires deep expertise across enterprise messaging architectures, collaboration technologies, identity and directory services, UNIX/Linux\-based mail relay environments, and operational support functions. The incumbent will drive platform modernization initiatives, operational excellence programs, automation strategies, reliability engineering practices, security compliance, and service governance standards. The role partners closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, cloud, architecture, and business stakeholders to deliver stable and future\-ready platforms.
  
  

As the highest\-level technical specialist within the UMC domain, the individual is expected to provide architectural guidance, lead complex problem resolution, govern enterprise standards, mentor technical teams, manage strategic technology roadmaps, and continuously improve service quality, availability, and user experience through automation, analytics, and proactive engineering practices
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Own end\-to\-end lifecycle management of enterprise Unified Messaging \& Collaboration platforms, ensuring availability, security, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  
Lead administration, engineering, support, and optimization of enterprise messaging infrastructure, including email transport, mailbox services, SMTP routing, and message hygiene solutions.
  
Design, maintain, and optimize enterprise mail flow architecture, including inbound/outbound routing, SMTP connectors, relay configurations, gateway integrations, and secure message transit.
  
Manage UNIX/Linux\-based email relay environments utilizing Postfix, Sendmail, Exim, or equivalent technologies across distributed enterprise infrastructures.
  
Drive continuous improvement of messaging security controls, including anti\-spam, anti\-malware, anti\-phishing, email authentication, and threat protection mechanisms.
  
Provide expert\-level troubleshooting for complex mail delivery issues, transport failures, routing anomalies, latency concerns, bounce management, and interoperability challenges.
  
Administer and optimize enterprise collaboration platforms supporting messaging, content sharing, communication, productivity, and team collaboration capabilities.
  
Manage Directory Services infrastructure, including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, group management, federation, and access governance.
  
Ensure seamless integration between messaging, collaboration, directory, security, cloud, and business application ecosystems.
  
Establish monitoring frameworks, health analytics, service dashboards, alerting mechanisms, and proactive operational controls to improve service reliability.
  
Lead major incident management activities for critical system outages, providing rapid restoration, communication management, impact mitigation, and service recovery coordination.
  
Conduct detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations and implement preventive actions that eliminate recurring incidents and improve operational resilience.
  
Govern Change, Release, and Problem Management processes to ensure minimal business disruption and high deployment success rates.
  
Design and implement automation solutions using scripting and infrastructure management tools to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and accelerate service delivery.
  
Drive platform modernization initiatives, migration programs, infrastructure refresh activities, and technology transformation roadmaps.
  
Develop capacity planning models, perform trend analysis, and forecast future infrastructure requirements based on business growth and consumption patterns.
  
Define and maintain High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), backup, recovery, and business continuity strategies for all UMC services.
  
Establish technical governance standards, operational procedures, configuration baselines, and service management best practices across all UMC towers.
  
Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, audit controls, and risk management frameworks.
  
Perform infrastructure and application operational support activities, ensuring service dependencies are properly maintained and optimized.
  
Collaborate with enterprise architects to evaluate emerging technologies and develop future\-state collaboration and messaging architectures.
  
Manage relationships with technology vendors, support providers, cloud service partners, and product engineering organizations.
  
Define service improvement initiatives using operational metrics, SLA trends, incident analytics, customer feedback, and technology performance indicators.
  
Provide technical leadership, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and capability development for L2/L3 engineers and platform administrators.
  
Act as the final escalation point and trusted technical advisor for critical messaging, collaboration, directory, and mail relay platform issues affecting enterprise operations.

51de981a.description:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Allegro is seeking an experienced Kinaxis Solution Architect to lead supply chain planning and Maestro solution strategy. This role will design, configure, and deploy end\-to\-end supply chain planning solutions using the Kinaxis Maestro platform. They will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution, leading the Allegro Supply Chain team to build scalable models for demand, supply, and S\&OP, while integrating with Oracle ERP.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Reporting into the Supply Chain business team, this role will oversee end\-to\-end Kinaxis solutions including Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S\&OP, Inventory Management and Capacity Planning. They will design and implement Kinaxis Maestro solutions to drive user adoption while ensuring system reliability and sustainability for the Global Supply Chain Planning organization. Act as the primary point of contact for all Kinaxis Maestro authorship, configuration, data mapping, automation, and performance improvement for all aspects of Planning.
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Translate complex supply chain requirements into technical blueprints, ensuring scalability and peak system performance.
* System Configuration: Configure key Kinaxis modules, including worksheets, dashboards, alerts, and scenario\-planning models.
* Data Integration: Architect seamless data flows, APIs, and ETL pipelines to sync data between Kinaxis and enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).
* Sustainability: Configure and optimize supply chain planning workflows. Troubleshoot and resolve functional and technical issues. Develop, enhance, and maintain Kinaxis resources, ensuring seamless integration into the existing supply chain planning ecosystem
* Leadership: Lead business workshops, guide functional teams through User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and provide architectural governance.


**What You Will Need**
 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Kinaxis configuration, solution design, integration, and business process optimization.
   

  

* 5\+ years of deep, hands\-on knowledge of Kinaxis RapidResponse and the Maestro AI platform. Experience as a Solution Architect in supply chain planning projects.
* 5\+ years of experience with integrations and data modeling, preferably with ERP system like SAP or Oracle and other business tools like SalesForce.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end planning processes (Demand/Supply planning, Inventory optimization, Capacity Planning and S\&OP). Prior semiconductor experience a plus.
* Proficiency in data modeling, APIs, ETL processes, and ERP synchronization.
* Ability to distill complex technical concepts into actionable strategies for executive stakeholders. Ability to work across a global organization, balancing multiple time zones.
* Kinaxis Author\-level certification is a plus.


**Why Allegro?**

**Job Name\-GDS Consulting Cloud Data Architect – Snowflake**
**Position Summary**
 The Cloud Data Architect will lead the strategic migration and transformation of enterprise data platforms from legacy systems to modern cloud\-native architectures using Snowflake. This role is pivotal in enabling scalable, secure, and high\-performance data analytics environments for EY clients across sectors.
   

  

 The architect will be responsible for designing future\-state reference architectures, guiding implementation teams, and ensuring alignment with EY’s data modernization strategy. The role demands deep technical expertise, hands\-on leadership, and the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology domains.
   

  

 The leader will be responsible for accelerating the following:
   

  

 Strategic Leadership
   

  

* Drive the strategic vision for cloud data modernization, leveraging Snowflake capabilities within EY
* Lead cross\-functional teams across geographies to deliver scalable data solutions that support enterprise transformation.
* Influence client C\-suite stakeholders by articulating the business value of cloud\-native data architectures. Market Intelligence and Go\-To\-Market (GTM)
* Monitor industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies in cloud data platforms to inform solution strategy.
* Collaborate with EY GTM teams to develop differentiated offerings around Snowflake.
* Contribute to EY’s market positioning by aligning architecture capabilities with client demand and sector\-specific needs.


 Sales and Business Development
   

  

* Support pre\-sales activities including client workshops, RFP responses, and solution demos.
* Partner with account teams to identify opportunities for cloud data transformation and drive pipeline growth.
* Translate client requirements into scalable architecture proposals that align with EY’s delivery capabilities.


 Thought Leadership
   

  

* Represent EY in industry forums, webinars, and conferences focused on cloud data and analytics.
* Author whitepapers, blogs, and internal knowledge assets on Snowflake best practices.
* Mentor junior architects and contribute to EY’s internal capability development programs.


 Partnership and Ecosystem Development
   

  

* Build and nurture strategic alliances with Snowflake and Azure to codevelop joint solutions.
* Engage with technology partners to stay abreast of product roadmaps and integration capabilities.
* Leverage EY’s ecosystem to deliver end\-to\-end solutions that span data, AI, cloud, and security.


**Essential Functions Of The Job**
* Lead and architect the migration of data analytics environments from legacy systems to Snowflake with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Define high\-level migration roadmaps and future\-state reference architectures on Azure cloud.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end data analytics solutions leveraging Snowflake utilities (SnowSQL, SnowPipe), notebooks, and big data modeling techniques using Python.
* Setup, configure, and deploy Snowflake solutions across multidepartment environments.
* Guide teams in implementing best practices for data transformation, aggregation, and workload management.
* Address technical inquiries related to customization, integration, and enterprise architecture.
* Enable business stakeholders to make data\-driven decisions through accurate analysis, reporting, and presentation of key findings.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities**
* Make strategic decisions on cloud architecture design, resource allocation, and technology investments.
* Evaluate performance metrics and ROI of Snowflake implementations.
* Conduct impact analysis of proposed solutions on client operations, including cost\-benefit, scalability, and integration feasibility.
* Prioritize solution components based on business value and technical feasibility


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 15\-20 years of experience in data architecture, solution design, and implementation.
* At least two end\-to\-end implementations of Snowflake and cloud data platforms.
* Demonstrated success in leading large\-scale data migration projects and managing cross\-functional teams.
* Experience in client\-facing roles with a track record of delivering high\-impact solutions.


**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
* Proven experience in designing and implementing cloud data warehouse solutions (Snowflake) on Azure.
* Deep understanding of Snowflake architecture including compute/storage separation, RBAC, performance tuning, and advanced features like time travel and zero\-copy clone.
* Expertise in big data modeling, ETL pipeline optimization, and Python\-based data engineering.
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to manage client relationships and drive consensus.
* Experience in handling complex deployments and multi\-tower configurations.
* Familiarity with Presto/Starburst, shell scripting, and Unix/Windows environments is a plus.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

2b29fa9d.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 



**Support Manager – SAP S/4HANA (AMC / Managed Services)** 


 Dynamo Infotech · Onsite – Client Location · Full\-time · 8–12 Years Experience
 




  





  




**About the Role** 

 Dynamo Infotech is seeking an experienced Support Manager to lead SAP S/4HANA Application Management Support (AMC) delivery for a key client, based onsite at the client location. You will own the day\-to\-day health of a live S/4HANA landscape — managing the support team, SLA performance, and the client relationship — while serving as the senior escalation point for business\-critical issues.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership role suited to someone who has moved beyond pure implementation work and enjoys the discipline of running a stable, well\-governed support operation.
 



  




**Key Responsibilities** 

 •     
 **Delivery ownership —** 
 Own end\-to\-end AMC / Managed Services delivery for the client’s SAP S/4HANA landscape, ensuring response and resolution SLAs are consistently met across L1, L2, and L3 tiers.
 



 •     
 **Team leadership —** 
 Lead, mentor, and allocate a team of functional and technical consultants handling incident, problem, and change management.
 



 •     
 **Client relationship —** 
 Act as the primary point of contact for client IT and business stakeholders on all support matters, including status reporting, escalation handling, and governance meetings.
 



 •     
 **Queue governance —** 
 Review and prioritise the ticket queue daily, ensuring correct triage, clear ownership, and adherence to defined turnaround times; personally own critical and high\-severity incidents through to closure.
 



 •     
 **Problem management —** 
 Drive root\-cause analysis on recurring issues and push for permanent fixes rather than repeated workarounds.
 



 •     
 **Cross\-functional coordination —** 
 Coordinate with Basis, technical/ABAP, and functional module teams to resolve issues that span multiple areas of the landscape.
 



 •     
 **Change control —** 
 Manage the change control process for support transports and minor enhancements, ensuring proper testing, approval, and documentation before deployment.
 



 •     
 **Reporting —** 
 Track and report support KPIs — ticket volume, SLA compliance, ageing, backlog, and CSAT — to both internal leadership and the client.
 



 •     
 **System stewardship —** 
 Support periodic system health checks, patch and upgrade cycles, and audit or compliance requirements as they relate to ongoing support.
 



 •     
 **Continuous improvement —** 
 Identify automation opportunities, maintain the knowledge base, and refine processes to reduce recurring effort and ticket volume over time.
 



  




**Required Skills \& Experience** 

 •     8–12 years of overall SAP experience, with substantial time spent in AMC / Application Managed Services support roles rather than implementation alone.
 



 •     Hands\-on experience supporting a live SAP S/4HANA environment (Public or Private Cloud), with strong working knowledge across core modules — FI, MM, SD, CO — and how they integrate.
 



 •     Proven track record managing a support team and being accountable for SLA delivery in a client\-facing AMC engagement.
 



 •     Strong incident, problem, and change management discipline; comfortable working within structured ITSM tools and ticketing processes.
 



 •     Excellent client\-facing communication skills, with the ability to manage escalations calmly and represent the support team credibly to client leadership.
 



 •     Experience coordinating with Basis and technical (ABAP) teams on issues requiring cross\-functional resolution.
 



 •     Willingness to work onsite at the client location on a full\-time basis.
 



  




**Preferred Qualifications** 

 •     SAP certification in one or more relevant modules.
 



 •     Familiarity with Indian statutory and localisation requirements — GST, e\-invoicing, TDS — within an SAP context.
 



 •     Exposure to SAP Ariba, SuccessFactors, or other adjacent SAP solutions in a support capacity.
 



 •     ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent process training.
 



 •     Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Commerce, or a related discipline.
 



  




**What We Offer** 

 •     Ownership of a live, business\-critical S/4HANA landscape — real impact, not ticket\-pushing.
 



 •     A leadership role with direct client exposure and genuine autonomy to shape support processes.
 



 •     Competitive compensation aligned to experience, with structured growth into practice or account leadership.
 



  





  




**How to Apply** 

**Email:** 
 sivasankar@dynamoinfotech.com
 



**Subject line:** 
 Support Manager – SAP S/4HANA whatsup : 9036060330
 




 Please include your current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period along with your CV.

**METAGUISE** 




 Pre\-Sales Presentation \& Qualification Specialist
 



***Gurgaon, Haryana, India /Full\-time\-Monday\-Saturday / Timings\-2pm\-11pm***




 About Metaguise
 



 Metaguise designs and manufactures architectural metal cladding and facade systems for landmark commercial, institutional and residential projects. Our work spans parametric metal facades, perforated and welded modules, and premium interior cladding — specified by leading architects across India, the Middle East and Europe.
 



 Role Summary
 



 You are the first voice a prospective client hears. You will present Metaguise’s credentials, capabilities and case studies to architects, developers, PMCs and contractors over Zoom and Microsoft Teams — then run a structured discovery conversation to capture the design intent, scale, timeline and commercial context of their project. You will log this into our CRM and hand a qualified, well\-documented brief to the sales team.
 



 This is not a cold\-calling role. Leads are inbound and inbound\-referred. Your job is to represent the brand with polish and extract the intelligence that lets our sales team win.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Deliver Metaguise’s credentials presentation and curated case studies to international and Indian clients over video calls
* Conduct structured discovery: design language sought, project scale and area, material and finish preferences, budget band, timeline, decision\-making structure and competitive set
* Qualify opportunities against defined criteria and prioritise accordingly
* Maintain complete, accurate CRM records — call notes, briefs, attachments, next actions and pipeline stage
* Prepare and deliver clean handover briefs to the sales and technical teams, including full project diligence
* Coordinate follow\-up scheduling and keep prospects warm until sales engagement begins
* Maintain and improve the presentation deck and case study library in coordination with marketing
* Track and report on lead quality, call\-to\-qualified\-opportunity conversion, and market\-wise trends



 Requirements
 



**Essential** 



* 2–5 years in pre\-sales, client\-facing presentation, inside sales, business development or account management
* Exceptional spoken and written English with a clear, neutral accent — you will present daily to GCC, European and Indian audiences
* Strong on\-camera presence: confident, composed and articulate across a structured 30–45 minute presentation
* Demonstrated CRM proficiency (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Pipedrive or similar) with genuine discipline in data hygiene
* Excellent active listening and note\-taking; able to translate a loose client conversation into a precise written brief
* Fluent with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace and PowerPoint



**Preferred** 



* Exposure to architecture, construction, building materials, interiors or facade systems
* Experience working with Middle East or European clients
* Ability to grasp technical vocabulary quickly — finishes, substrates, fabrication methods, installation systems
* Additional language: Arabic, French or German



 What Success Looks Like
 


* Within 30 days: fluent, independent delivery of the Metaguise credentials presentation
* Within 60 days: running discovery calls solo with complete CRM capture
* Within 90 days: measurably improved brief quality and reduced sales\-team rework on handovers



 What We Offer
 


* Competitive salary with performance\-linked incentive tied to qualified pipeline
* Direct exposure to landmark international architecture projects
* Structured training on Metaguise products, processes and technical vocabulary
* Growth path into key account management or market ownership



 To Apply
 



 Send your CV and a 2–3 minute video introduction to \[email] describing a project or product you admire and why. We assess communication ability directly — a strong video matters more to us than a long CV.
 



*Metaguise is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on capability alone.*

5380e571.title: Technical Program Manager
5380e571.description:
**Company Overview:** 




  

 Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 
   

  

 BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. 
   

  

 We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!
 



  
 



  
 



 Blink Health is seeking a
 **Senior Technical Program Manager** 
 to join our Cloud Engineering organization. In this role, you will lead complex infrastructure, platform, reliability, and security\-sensitive engineering programs that improve Blink’s scalability, operational maturity, developer productivity, and production readiness.
 



 You will partner closely with cloud engineering, security, engineering, product management, and business stakeholders to bring structure to ambiguous technical initiatives, drive cross\-functional execution, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure critical programs are delivered safely, predictably, and with measurable impact. This is an exciting opportunity for a hands\-on TPM who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and wants to make a real impact on healthcare technology.
   

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Lead complex
 **Cloud Engineering programs** 
 across infrastructure, platform, reliability, security, migrations, and operational maturity initiatives.
* Translate business and technical objectives into clear program scope, milestones, ownership, dependencies, risks, and success criteria.
* Support
 **quarterly planning** 
 and
 **annual operations planning for Cloud Engineering, including roadmap intake, prioritization support, capacity planning, dependency mapping, and executive\-ready planning artifacts.**
* Partner with engineering managers and technical leads to improve
 **Agile execution practices** 
 , Jira hygiene,
 **backlog structure, sprint planning** 
 , milestone tracking, and delivery visibility.
* Coordinate across cloud engineering, security, engineering, product management, business teams, and external partners to align priorities,
 **resolve dependencies,** 
 and drive execution.
* Ensure programs include appropriate production\-readiness planning, including rollout strategy, observability, documentation, support ownership, access controls, and operational handoff.
* ****Identify risks early,****
 develop
 **mitigation plans** 
 , escalate appropriately, and proactively remove roadblocks.
* Create clear, data\-driven updates, dashboards,
 **spreadsheets, and presentations** 
 to support planning, decision\-making, stakeholder communication, and leadership reporting.
* ****Use AI****
 and modern program management tools effectively to improve planning, reporting, documentation, analysis, communication, and overall execution.



**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* 10\+ years of experience managing technical programs, portfolio planning, Agile delivery, and cross\-functional execution within engineering or infrastructure organizations.
* Experience working with infrastructure, platform, cloud, DevOps, security, reliability, or other technically complex engineering teams.
* Proven ability to lead complex, multi\-team programs with competing priorities, unclear ownership, external dependencies, and shifting requirements.
* Strong command of Agile delivery practices and Jira best practices, including backlog organization, sprint planning, workflow hygiene, dependency tracking, reporting, and dashboard creation.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to use data, metrics, and structured thinking to drive prioritization, risk management, and decision\-making.
* Strong presentation and communication skills, including the ability to create clear, executive\-ready materials.
* Ability to understand technical tradeoffs, ask effective engineering questions, and translate between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Familiarity with AI tools and demonstrated ability to use AI effectively.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Should be open to work late evening India hours.



 Candidates with experience in healthcare, fintech, regulated environments, or organizations with high reliability, privacy, security, or compliance expectations may be especially well suited for this role.
 



**Why Join Us:** 




  

 It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.

45b2bd39.title: Data Architect & Canonical Model Lead
45b2bd39.description:
About Us: \*\*

BDIPlus, a US\-based leading transformation Consulting \& Customer Data Platform (CDP) company, is dedicated to delivering cutting\-edge capabilities and solutions that foster the development of enduring competitive advantages. Our innovative solutions showcase our unparalleled proficiency in technology and our profound domain expertise within the Financial Services and Insurance sectors. By synergizing our unmatched technical skills with a comprehensive grasp of each client’s institutional landscape and distinctive areas for improvement, we empower them to convert data into actionable and well\-organized information. This facilitates precise decision making, increased efficiency, and rampant business growth.

\*\*About the Role \*\*

We're seeking an experienced Data Architect \& Canonical Model Lead to own the canonical data model across multiple teams and systems. You'll design cross\-system entity models for policy, customer, and distributor data, lead architecture reviews, and — critically — see those models through to production: implemented in AWS, deployed through automated pipelines, and governed by contracts and quality checks that run without manual intervention.

This is not a documentation role. Models you design are expected to be enforced in running systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Canonical modelling and architecture:**

* Own canonical data model reconciliation across teams, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
* Design and maintain cross\-system entity models for policy, customer, distributor, claims, and product domains.
* Lead architecture reviews for alignment with enterprise data standards.
* Identify gaps and inconsistencies across systems and drive resolution.
* Mentor engineers and analysts on modelling and architecture practice.

**Implementation and production systems**

* Translate canonical models into physical implementations: warehouse and lakehouse schemas, event and API payload contracts, and mappings from source systems.
* Define and enforce data contracts between producers and consumers — schema, semantics, ownership, and SLAs — with breaking\-change detection in CI.
* Design integration patterns across batch, CDC, and event\-driven paths; own how entities are keyed, versioned, deduplicated, and resolved across systems.
* Model slowly changing dimensions, effective\-dating, and bitemporal history where policy and regulatory reporting require point\-in\-time accuracy.
* Embed automated data quality into pipelines — schema, referential integrity, freshness, and reconciliation checks between source and canonical layers, with alerting and quarantine rather than silent failure.
* Own lineage, cataloguing, and metadata so any field can be traced to source and to consumer.

**AWS and deployment**

* Design and govern the data platform on AWS: S3\-based lake with Glue Catalog, Redshift and/or Athena, Lake Formation for access control, and Glue, EMR, or Databricks for processing.
* Define deployment practice for data assets — schemas, models, and pipelines managed as code through Git, with CI/CD, environment promotion (dev/test/prod), and reviewable, reversible schema migrations.
* Manage infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and set standards for the teams building on the platform.
* Set orchestration and observability standards across pipelines, including monitoring, alerting, cost visibility, and incident response for data outages.

**Governance**

* Ensure compliance with data governance, security, privacy, and retention standards.
* Design access controls, masking, and tokenisation appropriate to a regulated environment, and support audit and regulatory reporting requirements.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* 5–8 years in data architecture, data modelling, or a closely related role.
* Proven ownership of canonical or enterprise data models and reconciliation processes.
* Strong cross\-system entity modelling — particularly policy, customer, and distributor domains.
* Deep modelling fundamentals: conceptual/logical/physical modelling, normalisation, dimensional modelling (Kimball), Data Vault or equivalent, and entity resolution across systems with conflicting keys.
* AWS hands\-on: S3, Glue, Athena or Redshift, Lake Formation, IAM. Table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake.
* SQL at an advanced level; Python for pipeline, validation, and tooling work.
* Data integration and ETL/ELT design across batch and streaming; dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks.
* Deployment practice for data platforms — Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment promotion.
* Automated data quality and validation tooling in production use.
* Modelling tools (Erwin, SqlDBM, ER/Studio, or equivalent) and the ability to keep models synchronised with what's actually deployed.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management — you'll influence standards you don't have direct authority over.

**Preferred Skills**

* Insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry — policy administration, claims, or distribution systems.
* Industry data models: ACORD, OMG, or similar.
* Data governance frameworks and tooling (Collibra, Alation, AWS DataZone).
* Event streaming (Kafka, Kinesis) and schema registry practice.
* Master data management and identity resolution.
* Legacy modernisation — mainframe or policy admin system migration to cloud.
* Cost optimisation for large\-scale data platforms.

**Our Purpose and Culture:** At BDIPlus, our mission is to help enterprises utilize their resources more efficiently, implement effective information management, and empower them by enabling richer insights and intelligence.

We are driven by a single purpose: empower the technology transformation. We are passionate about creating foundational technology platforms for enterprise data and information management. Our employees are at the heart of the work we do at BDIPlus. We are committed to encouraging and celebrating innovation, creativity, and hard work among our team members.

**Working at BDIPlus offers:** A diverse, fun, highly intelligent, and innovative team. Provident Fund A competitive salary and an annual bonus. Standard time off, sick leave, and holidays. An environment where creative thinking is encouraged, and innovation drives everything we do.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Are you an experienced architect with a passion for designing and delivering cutting\-edge end\-user computing solutions, leveraging your expertise in Citrix and Omnissa technologies? If so, you will thrive in our dynamic team environment at Nutanix, where you will influence large\-scale transformations, work with innovative technologies, and provide technical leadership to drive impactful customer engagements in hybrid infrastructures.**About the Team**
The Staff Consulting Architect will be joining the Professional Services team at Nutanix, located in Bangalore. This team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions in end\-user computing (EUC) that empower organizations to enhance their IT infrastructure and optimize user experience. With a culture that emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and customer\-centricity, team members are encouraged to leverage their expertise and creativity to drive transformative results for clients. The mission of the team is to architect and implement scalable EUC solutions that seamlessly integrate with Nutanix infrastructure, enabling organizations to achieve their digital transformation goals.


You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who fosters a supportive and empowering leadership style that promotes both individual growth and team collaboration. The work setup for this role is hybrid, requiring the hire to be in the office for three days a week while also allowing flexibility for remote work on other days.


The role requires some travel to client locations and other Nutanix offices, as needed, to engage directly with customers and support the implementation of EUC projects. This travel will be essential for building strong relationships and understanding client needs in their specific environments.

 **Your Role*** Architect and design enterprise end\-user computing (EUC) solutions utilizing Citrix and Omnissa technologies within Nutanix infrastructure.
* Lead customer engagements to define architecture, migration strategies, and optimization plans for virtual desktop and application environments.
* Troubleshoot complex EUC environments and provide technical leadership to consulting teams and customers.
* Develop reusable reference architectures, design guides, and standard operating procedures for Citrix/Omnissa deployments.
* Conduct workshops with clients to outline EUC strategy, performance optimization, and security measures.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the development of EUC technical capabilities within the team.
* Establish and monitor performance metrics for EUC solutions to ensure optimal user experience and system reliability.
* Drive initiatives for EUC modernization, automation, and standardization across platforms to meet business continuity requirements.
 **What You Will Bring*** 10\+ years of experience in EUC, virtualization, infrastructure, or related technologies.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with Citrix and/or Omnissa enterprise EUC platforms.
* Deep understanding of VDI, application virtualization, and enterprise networking.
* Proficiency in Nutanix AHV and VMware vSphere environments.
* Experience in designing high\-availability, backup, DR, and business continuity solutions for EUC.
* Strong customer\-facing consulting, communication, and technical leadership skills.
* Proficiency in automation tools such as PowerShell, Terraform, or Ansible.
* Relevant certifications in Citrix, VMware, or related technologies are a plus.

The Staff Consulting Architect will be joining the Professional Services team at Nutanix, located in Bangalore. This team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions in end\-user computing (EUC) that empower organizations to enhance their IT infrastructure and optimize user experience. With a culture that emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and customer\-centricity, team members are encouraged to leverage their expertise and creativity to drive transformative results for clients. * Proficiency in Nutanix AHV and VMware vSphere environments.

* Strong customer\-facing consulting, communication, and technical leadership skills.

d482a560.title: Solutions Consultant
d482a560.description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges \-\- we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes \-\- apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
 At Sovos, we deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that power global tax compliance for some of the world’s largest organizations. As a Solution Consultant, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting system\-to\-system integrations between Sovos platform, client ERP \& third\-party applications.
   

  

 This role is a client\-facing and integration\-focused. You will act as the technical owner of implementation projects, leading requirement gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, go live and hypercare. Collaboration with clients, external integration partners and internal technical teams is key to ensuring seamless integration \& successful project completion.
   

  

**More Specifically, You Will**
* Be the primary technical point of contact throughout the project lifecycle, providing technical support and guidance throughout the project lifecycle
* Collaborate with Client technical, functional \& Sovos project teams, outlining and designing Sovos products to the project scope.
* Gather \& analyse business and technical requirements from clients, translating them into effective solution and integration designs.
* Complete solution design and architecture documents which includes all configuration details and any other necessary information to support Client and Sovos implementations.
* Design and implement API\-based integrations (REST/SOAP) between Sovos platforms and client ERP systems.
* Analyse the structure and definition of our customers integration data files and map their fields/data to Sovos internal data structure according to project scope.
* Validate data flows, mappings, and transformations between source and target systems to ensure accuracy and reliability.
* Coordinate with client, internal teams and integration partners to ensure timely project delivery and resolve any issues that may arise by following internal escalation and procedures
* Ensure integrations adhere to security, compliance and performance standards as required by Sovos and its clients.
* Must be capable of leading fast\-paced work sessions with internal and/or client’s teams to come up with solutions to solve project problems within Sovos products capabilities and project scope.
* Understanding the impact of individual task completion on the overall project schedule.
* Excellent understanding of Sovos product and capabilities.
* Provide training as necessary to clients in relation to Sovos Products.
* Identify and implement improvements to processes, documents, tools, reports, etc. to benefit and improve Sovos project team and new Client’s implementation processes.
* Perform SIT (System Integration Testing) \& UAT (Users Acceptance Testing) according to Sovos products configurations and project implementation plan.


**What We Need From You**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or similar.
* 5\+ years of experience in system integration, or, enterprise application integration in customer facing role
* Knowledge of development languages, ability to read and understand code, to analyse rules/conditions and data mappings (C\# or similar)
* Good understanding of ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms.
* Solid hands\-on experience with REST and SOAP APIs, covering authentication, error handling, and retries.
* Experience in systems \& data integration, data structure and data mappings with strong knowledge of system architecture, data flows and integration patterns.
* Experience with JSON, XML, and data mapping/transformation techniques.
* Experience in Electronic Invoicing, Billing, Systems Integration, Invoicing Systems (ERP) projects an added advantage.
* Excellent English communications skills (verbal and written)
* Strong critical thinking skills and a solution\-oriented mindset.
* Strong time management, organizational and decision\-making skills.
* Interact effectively with teammates, colleagues and Client’s.
* Comprehend and communicate complex concepts.
* Concentrate, analyse and resolve complex problems.


 The tools to enhance your life \- because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
   

  

* 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with flexibility to work remotely for the remaining days
* Opportunity to work with a global organization and gain international exposure
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
* Mentoring Programs and career development opportunities
* Globally recognized Training and Development programs
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage
* Collaborative work environment with modern tools and technologies
* Opportunity to be part of a newly acquired entity and shape its growth journey


**Our Recruitment Process**
 We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what a typical process will look like:
   

  

 Stage 1: CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) and EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
   

  

 Stage 2: Automated Video Interview
   

  

 Stage 3: Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or key stakeholders
   

  

 Stage 4: Final Interview
   

  

 Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
   

  

**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose\-built for always\-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT\-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud\-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.
   

  

 More than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries \-\- including half the Fortune 500 \-\- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter

Are you an experienced database professional with a strong background in database lifecycle management, virtualization, and automation who excels in solution architecture and collaboration? If so, join our innovative Professional Services team at Nutanix, where you'll have the opportunity to design and manage cutting\-edge database service platforms in a dynamic hybrid environment, all while enhancing client outcomes through your expertise and a supportive, collaborative culture.**About the Team**
The Staff Consulting Architect role will be part of the Professional Services team at Nutanix, located in Bangalore. This team is dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences by providing innovative solutions focused on database lifecycle management and virtualization. The culture within the team is collaborative and client\-centric, promoting a supportive environment where diverse perspectives are valued. The mission of the Professional Services team is to ensure successful deployments and optimizations for Nutanix's database service platforms, ultimately enhancing business outcomes for clients through automation and efficiency.


You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who is known for a leadership style that emphasizes empowerment and mentorship, fostering an atmosphere of continuous learning and professional growth. The work setup for this role is hybrid, requiring occasional in\-office presence to facilitate collaboration and client engagements, while also allowing for flexibility in remote work. The exact number of days in the office will be determined based on project needs and team activities.


This role involves approximately 15% travel, which may include trips to client locations for project kick\-offs, deployments, or workshops. This travel is essential for understanding client environments and ensuring successful implementations of Nutanix solutions.

* Oversee the complete lifecycle of database services, focusing on backup, restore, scaling, and performance optimization.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to develop and integrate database solutions with infrastructure and automation frameworks.
* Establish and document blueprints for consistent database provisioning and lifecycle management.

* Monitor and analyze platform health and performance, driving continuous improvement initiatives based on gathered insights.
* Engage with clients to understand requirements and deliver tailored database solutions that enhance their IT infrastructure.
 **What You Will Bring*** 10\+ years of experience in database administration and infrastructure engineering.

* Proficient in database design, deployment, and migration for major RDBMSs (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Experience with automation frameworks (API integration, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform).
* Excellent communication and client\-facing consulting skills.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and lead database modernization initiatives.
* Relevant certifications in database management or virtualization preferred.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL and MongoDB technologies.

075d580c.title: Applied Solutions Architect, Google Cloud
075d580c.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Experience designing and building AI applications.


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the technical bridge between our customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer the Proof of Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. By keeping the final production end\-state in mind from day one, you will advocate for our AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape. Design comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation. Code, build, and deploy robust cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions—such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, and applied foundation models—backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value. Ensure all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

 On 1st July 2021, Rave Technologies became NEC Software Solutions India. This change brought us under the global NEC Corporation brand. We are proud to be part of an organisation with 122 years of experience in evolution with technology and innovation.
   

  

 We have more than 30 years of experience in providing end to end IT services across the globe and have earned a reputation for delighting our customers by consistently surpassing expectations and helping them deliver robust, market\-ready software products that meet the highest standards of engineering and user experience. Supported by more than 1300 exceptionally talented manpower, we are a hub for offshore support and technology services.
   

  

 We work with diverse industry verticals which include publishing, media, financial services, retail, healthcare and technology companies around the world. Our customers range from two\-person startups to $bn listed companies.
   

  

 For more information, visit at www.necsws.com/india.
   

  

**About NEC Corporation**
 NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational information technology and electronics company, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
