5694bdd5.title: Technical Solutions Architect
5694bdd5.description:
**Company Overview**
 Leading with our core values of Quality, Integrity, and Opportunity, MedInsight is one of the healthcare industry’s most trusted solutions for healthcare intelligence. Our company’s purpose is to empower easy, data\-driven decision\-making on important healthcare questions. MedInsight products, education, and services make an impact on healthcare by helping to drive better outcomes for patients while reducing wasteful services. Over 300 leading healthcare organizations have come to rely on MedInsight analytic solutions for healthcare cost and care management.
   

  

 MedInsight is a subsidiary of Milliman; a global, employee\-owned consultancy providing actuarial consulting, retirement funding and healthcare financing, enterprise risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics, and business transformation, as well as a range of other consulting and technology solutions.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The MedInsight Strategic Analytics Services team is looking for a Technical Solutions Architect (Cloud Engineer) to support a variety of healthcare analytics, predictive analytics, and digital transformation projects, leveraging a variety of data types. As a member of the technical staff and a trusted advisor to clients, this professional will join our team to assist in all phases of technical consulting work, including requirements gathering, scalable solution design, data architectures, research, and development. The successful candidate will have strong analytic, technical, and communication skills, and the ability to partner in the delivery of business value to diverse organizations, manage multiple simultaneous projects and innovate solutions that leverage a cloud\-first environment.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Work both independently and in a cross\-functional team environment.
* Listen to, understand, and break client questions down into manageable tasks.
* Be comfortable in presenting and discussing ideas with senior leaders of client organizations and Milliman MedInsight.
* Understand client business goals and strategic context and harvest requirements from client organizations.
* Work independently on assigned tasks, i.e., plan, organize, delegate, problem solve, and meet established deadlines.
* Develop senior technical staff through involvement with effectively aligned cross\-functional teams.
* Prioritize work under time pressure. Follow\-through and exceptional attention to detail on all project tasks are essential.
* Use a variety of proprietary products and technologies to answer simple and complex client questions.
* Turn data results into client\-facing deliverables that are informative and easy\-to\-use.
* Standardize ad hoc processes and drive continuous improvement for automating and optimizing performance of ongoing processes.
* Assist senior technical staff with the support of, upgrades of, and modifications to, existing advanced data products.
* Ensure clear and comprehensive documentation of analytic methodologies and new technical approaches.
* Represent MedInsight at client meetings and trainings.


**Basic Qualifications**
 Minimum 8 to 10 years of relevant work experience. Preference will be given to candidates with healthcare data experience and cloud solutions experience. Previous experience working with large healthcare claims and/or EHR databases preferred.
   

  

**General**
* Working knowledge of healthcare concepts and data structures.
* Familiarity with healthcare claims data and data analytic platforms.
* Ability to prioritize and manage concurrent projects.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Execute work with exceptional attention to detail on all project tasks.
* Ability to work independently and within a diverse team environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks with little supervision and work under time pressure.
* Client consulting experience.


**Technical**
* Programming/development experience with Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Python.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Spark, SQL, Python, R, C\#) preferred.
* Experience in managing or guiding organizations’ transitions from on\-premise to cloud resources.
* Data warehousing and/or large IT project experience.
* Understanding of OLAP technologies.
* Experience working with large data sets.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite of products.
* Healthcare informatics, analytics, and reporting knowledge.


**Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in statistics, mathematics, computer science, information systems, finance, economics, engineering, or related fields.


**Desired Experience And Traits**
* Experience working with relational and big data database technologies (Databricks, Microsoft Azure). Experience collapsing, joining, merging data sets.
* Hands\-on experience in creating microservices architecture and cloud\-native applications.
* Hands\-on experience in Agile design and implementation approaches.
* Experience in reducing costs and improving efficiencies in data analytics.
* Healthcare claims analysis experience a plus.
* Ability to translate complex healthcare data questions from clients or account managers into manageable tasks.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and adaptable – adept at planning and execution, capable of prioritizing and accomplishing goals across a spectrum of concurrent tasks for varying stakeholders.
* Consultative and confident approach: Critical thinker, able to effectively comprehend complex business issues and develop solutions and communications that work for varying stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented: Recognizes that the small things make all the difference and pays attention to everything.
* Collaborative: Demonstrated ability to work with engineering and analytics teams to discuss technical concepts, make tradeoffs and evaluate new ideas.
* Intellectually curious: Desire and ability to learn new skills, systems, and processes, and interest in exploring data credibility and advanced analytic approaches.
* Energetic, optimistic, and hard\-working: Maintains a can\-do attitude and is unrelenting in the pursuit of excellence.


 Above all else, we are looking for someone who is excited about working in a fast\-paced environment, collaborating with individuals across multiple teams to solve problems, and developing data\-driven solutions that make important information easy to access, understand and act upon.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an innovative self\-starter with solid technical foundations, who is interested in working with our team of experienced professionals to make a measurable impact on the business challenges faced by healthcare organizations today. The Milliman MedInsight group has been rapidly growing within different segments of the healthcare field, with presence amongst payers, employers, providers, accountable care organizations, pharmacy benefit managers, digital health companies, and other types of organizations. Successful candidates will support a variety of custom analytic client engagements and will also have opportunities to develop within their position and grow within the larger team.
   

  

**What makes this a great opportunity?**
* Join an award\-winning firm with a track record of growth backed by a marketplace powerhouse.
* Be part of the expansion and evolution of an analytics, technology, and research team in a data\-driven company.
* Enjoy significant visibility and be recognized for your wins.
* Work with a tenured collaborative team that values diversification of thought and new ideas.
* Grow and develop your skills and experience in an organization that invests energy in your career trajectory every day.
* Accelerate data interoperability, advanced analytics, and optimal use of cloud technologies.
* Help client and partner organizations improve healthcare for populations and communities.

**Experience: 10\+yrs** 




**Notice period: Only immediate \- 15days only** 




**Location: Bangalore** 




**Mode of work: Remote** 




  





**About the Role**




 The Global Program Manager for Autonomous Data Platform (ADP) is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end program strategy and delivery for flagship autonomous infrastructure initiative. ADP aims to make self\-operating, self\-healing, and fully autonomous in its data management capabilities — and this role is at the center of making that vision real. You will coordinate across product management, engineering, cloud infrastructure, customer success, and field teams to drive structured delivery, manage cross\-functional dependencies, and ensure ADP reaches customers in a form that generates immediate, measurable value.
 



  





**What You'll Do**



* Own the ADP program roadmap — translating product and engineering intent into a structured, milestone\-driven delivery plan with clear owners, timelines, and success criteria.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across engineering, platform architecture, product management, and field\-facing teams to ensure ADP capabilities are built, validated, and launched cohesively.
* Identify and manage technical and organizational dependencies across ADP workstreams, including integrations with Elastic Compute, Fabric as a Service, and other platform pillars.
* Establish and maintain program health reporting — tracking scope, risks, blockers, and milestone progress with the transparency needed for informed leadership decision\-making.
* Lead launch readiness for ADP capabilities, ensuring GTM teams, support, and enablement functions are prepared ahead of each release.
* Define and track metrics that measure ADP program health and customer\-facing impact, including time\-to\-value, automation coverage, and operational reliability benchmarks.
* Represent ADP in leadership reviews — communicating program status, escalating risks, and driving resolution with appropriate urgency.
* Coordinate with implementation and customer success teams to ensure smooth handoffs and early customer feedback loops that feed back into engineering priorities.



  





**What Success Looks Like**



* ADP capabilities ship on a predictable cadence with clear launch criteria, strong cross\-functional alignment, and high\-quality readiness artifacts across GTM, support, and enablement.
* Leadership has real\-time visibility into program health, risks, and delivery confidence — with no surprises at launch.
* Engineering and product teams operate with reduced coordination friction, and dependencies across platform programs are managed proactively rather than reactively.
* Customer\-facing outcomes — including time\-to\-automation and operational reliability — improve measurably release over release.



  





**Who You'll Work With**




 You will work closely with engineering leads, platform architects, product managers, and cloud infrastructure partners on the build side — and with sales engineering, field enablement, customer success, and marketing on the launch and adoption side. This role requires frequent engagement with senior leadership to drive alignment and communicate program status.
 



 Non\-Negotiable Qualifications
 


* 10\+ years of program management experience in the tech industry, with at least 5 years leading cross\-functional, global programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, infrastructure\-heavy or platform engineering programs — preferably in cloud, data infrastructure, or enterprise software.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, distill complex technical dependencies into clear plans, and influence across organizational levels without direct authority.
* Strong communication skills — equally comfortable in engineering standups and executive briefings.
* Bachelor's degree required.

f189f142.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
f189f142.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Solutions Consultants at Curlec by Razorpay are the linchpin of our enterprise sales team. You will be the technical and strategic partner to our sales team, bridging the gap between customer challenges and Razorpay's innovative payment solutions. This is not a traditional pre\-sales role; it's a chance to be a change leader and a revenue catalyst. You'll be the voice of the customer to our product team, the expert in the room with our sales team, and the trusted advisor to some of the largest enterprises.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Solve Big Problems: Work closely with our enterprise sales team to understand customer business goals, challenges, and technical pain points. You'll architect solutions that solve their most complex payment problems, leveraging our core products and custom capabilities. Hence in\-depth understanding of all our products is required.
* Craft Strategic Narratives: Create and deliver compelling presentations, detailed solution documents, and business proposals. You'll translate complex technical concepts into clear, executive\-level narratives that demonstrate Razorpay's unique value proposition and quantify our business value.
* Drive Revenue: Act as a critical enabler for our enterprise sales pipeline. You'll lead technical discussions, build compelling solution demonstrations, and author detailed RFP responses for major deals. Your expertise and communication will directly influence our revenue attainment goals.
* Be an Industry Expert: Drive the strategic viewpoint of the organization towards specific vertical solutions. You'll use your deep industry knowledge to be a change leader for innovative solutions that solve larger, systemic problems within a particular vertical.
* Connect the Dots: Collaborate with sales, product, and engineering teams to ensure a seamless end\-to\-end process—from solution design to successful deployment for key deals. You'll be the go\-to resource for connecting our technology to real\-world business value.
* Champion Knowledge: Contribute to our internal knowledge base and foster a culture of expertise. You'll serve as a subject matter expert, mentoring peers and authoring documentation to elevate the entire team.


**What We're Looking For**
* Problem Solver: Proven creative problem\-solving ability with a track record of leading and delivering full\-lifecycle projects. You can demonstrate how to turn complex challenges into clear, actionable solutions.
* Payments Expert: At least 2\-3 years of experience in the payments or fintech space, with a background in a product, solutions, or sales\-related role.
* Technical Practitioner: Hands\-on experience with technology is a must. You should be comfortable with APIs, technical definitions, and stitching together solutions across different platforms and partner ecosystems.
* Enterprise Advisor: Demonstrated expertise in providing advisory and guidance on large enterprise deployments and complex applications, with a history of identifying additional business opportunities.
* Influential Communicator: Exceptional verbal, presentation, and written communication skills. You have a proven ability to create and deliver technical and business\-focused presentations and documents that influence others and achieve results.
* Documentation Finesse: Established ability in crafting compelling presentations \& solution documents
* Education: An engineering background with an MBA is preferred.


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

797bfd67.title: Solutions Architect
797bfd67.description:
Responsible for defining application technology and architecture, maintaining the architectural runway, ensuring feasibility and sustainability, managing non\-functional requirements, defining delivery approaches, identifying improvement opportunities, monitoring emerging technologies, and mentoring other architects for skill development.
   

  

* Through cross\-team collaboration, define the technology and architecture that connects the application solutions within ARTs, while guiding the development/engineering team in their portion of the solution’s design.
* Define, build, and continuously maintain the application architectural runway to provide a technical foundation that allows teams and ARTs to create new functionality quickly and reliably.
* Collaborate with other architects to ensure application solutions are feasible and sustainable by applying FedEx best practices and design standards.
* Manage non\-functional requirements and compliance to ensure application solutions meet necessary quality attributes such as performance, scalability, security and maintainability for acceptance by stakeholders.

 Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical / Electronics Engineering, MIS or related discipline. TOGAF certification and SAFe Agile certification strongly preferred.
   

  

 Experience: Six to seven (6\-7\) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment with a direct responsibility for strategy formulation and solution/technical architecture, as well as designing, architecting, developing, implementing, and monitoring efficient and effective solutions to diverse and complex business problems.

**Pay**

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine.  Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. a3b3c12d.title: Solution Architect
a3b3c12d.description:
**About Us**
 At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.
   

  

 The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.
   

  

 We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about
 **our What and our Why** 
 and how we can work
 **together** 
 .
   

  

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
 ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.
   

  

 ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.
   

  

 ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.
   

  

 The Global Business Center \- Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.
   

  

 ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate, and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community\-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.
   

  

 To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.
   

  

**What Role You Will Play In Our Team**
 We are looking for a dynamic, creative, and resourceful Solution Architect to join our team at ExxonMobil’s Bengaluru office. This role is ideal for a hands\-on professional who combines deep technical expertise with strong communication and collaboration skills. You will be responsible for architecture that aligns with organizational goals, scalability, security, and performance standards in ExxonMobil’s Upstream business.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**What you will do**

**Other Expectations**

**About You**

* Minimum 4 years of hands\-on as Architect.

**Your Benefits**
 An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:
   

  

* Competitive compensation

e877ac0e.title: AI Solutions Architect
e877ac0e.description:
**Overview**
 At CACTUS AI Solutions, we are building and deploying large\-scale AI systems that power products and enterprise solutions across research, publishing, healthcare, BFSI, government, education, and enterprise transformation. Our ecosystem powers platforms such as Paperpal, R Discovery, and Mind the Graph, and multiple enterprise AI solutions used by millions of users globally.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly experienced and hands\-on AI Solutions Architect who can lead the design, architecture, and technical strategy for enterprise\-scale AI initiatives. This role will play a critical part in shaping how AI solutions are designed, deployed, governed, and scaled across diverse enterprise and government\-facing use cases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is someone who combines strong architecture fundamentals with deep AI/ML understanding, enterprise integration experience, cloud expertise, and practical knowledge of modern AI ecosystems including LLMs, RAG systems, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and AI governance practices.
   

  

**Note** 
 \- For this role, we are looking for Delhi NCR based candidates only.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and drive scalable, secure, and enterprise\-grade architectures for AI/ML platforms, cloud\-native applications, and distributed systems.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate AI/ML models, LLMs, frameworks, and solution approaches, including Generative AI, RAG, semantic search, conversational AI, and intelligent automation.
* Define architecture standards, deployment strategies, integration patterns, and reusable solution frameworks across cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises environments.
* Architect integrations with enterprise platforms using APIs, microservices, and event\-driven architectures while ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Collaborate with engineering, AI/ML, DevOps, and MLOps teams to guide implementation, deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence.
* Drive architecture governance by embedding security, privacy, compliance, auditability, access controls, and Responsible AI practices into solution designs.
* Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions and support technical proposals, architecture reviews, effort estimation, and solution documentation.
* Assess and leverage internal assets, open\-source technologies, and third\-party platforms to accelerate solution delivery and innovation.


**Qualifications And Prerequisites**
* 5–8 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, AI/ML Engineering, or large\-scale platform engineering, with proven expertise in designing enterprise\-grade AI\-powered and cloud\-native solutions.
* Strong understanding of modern AI ecosystems, including LLMs, RAG architectures, semantic retrieval, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and AI deployment patterns.
* Experience architecting distributed systems, enterprise integrations, APIs, microservices, and cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Proven ability to work with cross\-functional teams and enterprise stakeholders to deliver complex, high\-scale technology solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills, with the ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced and ambiguous environments.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Cloud architecture certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent) are preferred.
* Experience contributing to enterprise AI platforms, open\-source initiatives, large\-scale AI deployments, or government/enterprise transformation programs is a plus.


 Application Process
   

  

 Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, we have two technical rounds and one HRBP round.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
   

  

**Accelerating from Anywhere**
 As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.
   

  

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


**About CACTUS**
 Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

08e66d9a.title: Senior Solution Architect
08e66d9a.description:
Metyis is growing! We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect with \+10 years of relevant experience for a full\-time position to join the Technology team based out of Bangalore.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 We are Metyis, a forward\-thinking, global company that collaborates with business partners and clients to create and implement the capacities and capabilities required to improve future performance. We operate across a wide range of industries, and with our embedded partnership model we commit to driving sustainable growth for industry\-leading organisations, elevating their potential with a long\-term vision.
   

  

 At Metyis, we develop integrated solutions that enable growth by working within our business partners’ organisations with diverse and multidisciplinary teams. This collaborative environment allows Metyis to build strategies and execute them through an ecosystem that combines Big Data solutions, Digital Commerce solutions, Marketing \& Design solutions, and Advisory services.
   

  

 Our teams are set up so that you have plenty of room to build bigger and bolder ideas by speaking your mind and being creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you could achieve with a multidisciplinary team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
   

  

 We are Metyis. Partners for Impact.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Interact with C\-level at our clients on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change
* Lead your team in creating new business solutions via data driven insights
* Seize opportunities at the client and at Metyis in our entrepreneurial environment
* Become part of a fast growing international and diverse team


**What You Will Do**
* Understand client business domain and drive Digital Business Transformation (DBT) opportunity.
* Lead end\-to\-end solution architecture across discovery, architecture, estimation, roadmap planning, implementation, and production readiness while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles.
* Define architecture standards covering security, scalability, performance, availability, resiliency, observability, maintainability, cost optimization, and operational excellence while balancing business and technical trade\-offs.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Delivery, Data, AI, and Platform teams to define enterprise architecture, engineering standards, governance frameworks, and best practices across multiple engagements.
* Engage with executive stakeholders, business leaders, and technology teams to drive strategic technology decisions, architecture governance, platform selection, and solution roadmaps.
* Lead technology consulting engagements with prospects and clients by defining target architectures, transformation roadmaps, implementation strategies, business cases, effort estimation, and investment planning.
* Own technical solutioning for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and client presentations, including solution architecture, commercial estimation, delivery approach, staffing models, implementation timelines, and risk assessment.
* Define enterprise technology strategy, modernization roadmaps, cloud adoption, integration architecture, and platform evolution in collaboration with global architecture and engineering leadership.
* Champion modern engineering practices including Agile, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, API\-first design, and AI\-assisted software development.
* Mentor architects and engineering teams through technical leadership, architecture reviews, knowledge sharing, capability development, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support account growth by identifying follow\-on opportunities, defining transformation roadmaps, and building long\-term trusted advisor relationships with clients.


**What You Will Bring**
* 10–15\+ years of experience in designing and delivering enterprise\-scale digital platforms, distributed systems, and cloud\-native solutions, including leading architecture for large transformation programs.
* Strong expertise in software architecture principles, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), SOLID principles, API\-first architecture, microservices, event\-driven architecture, and integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), cloud\-native deployment models, and platform engineering.
* Experience designing observability solutions using tools such as Grafana, ELK, Splunk, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, and implementing operational KPIs, monitoring, and alerting strategies.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, API management, messaging platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, AWS SNS/SQS), middleware, and asynchronous event\-driven architectures.
* Proven experience leading cross\-functional and globally distributed teams in matrix organizations while influencing technical direction without direct authority.
* Experience designing composable, MACH\-based, and headless architectures, including Single Page Applications (SPA), Progressive Web Applications (PWA), and API\-driven digital experiences.
* Extensive experience delivering enterprise digital commerce solutions, marketplaces, omnichannel platforms, mobile applications, middleware, CMS, cloud platforms, and integration ecosystems.
* Experience with one or more enterprise commerce platforms such as Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Adobe Commerce (Magento), HCL Commerce, commercetools, or BigCommerce.
* Strong expertise in cloud architecture across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including security, networking, scalability, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Excellent consulting, stakeholder management, presentation, negotiation, and executive communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business decisions.


**Good to Have:**
* Experience with AI/Generative AI technologies and integrating AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Architecture or Cloud certifications such as TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent.


**We are united by our differences**
 At Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow.
   

  

**Recruitment Disclaimer**
 Metyis only contacts candidates through verified and official channels: LinkedIn (official and verified recruiter profiles), emails ending in @metyis.com, and our Applicant Tracking System (Recruitee). We do not use WhatsApp, social media messaging platforms, or personal accounts for recruitment outreach. If you receive suspicious communication claiming to be from Metyis, please verify the sender and report it through our official website.

b6f8b764.title: Delivery Manager - Consulting Services
b6f8b764.description:
**About The Job:**


The Red Hat Consulting Services team is adding a Services Manager in India. In this role, you will develop, cultivate, and manage relationships within key Enterprise and Commercial customer accounts. You will oversee the successful delivery of projects under your management from kickoff to closeout, including determining scope details and monitoring project progress to ensure that it conforms to customer expectations and contractual agreements. You’ll also help identify and qualify new business opportunities and work with Red Hat’s sales organization to formulate account strategies that promote revenue growth. You’ll partner with Red Hat’s sales representatives to guide consulting sales opportunities from qualification to closing while managing all assigned projects and resources while meeting revenue and booking goals. You’ll need to have a good foundation of technical knowledge, as well as project and scope management expertise, as you'll establish the technical and non\-technical enablement needs for the Consulting team.

**What You Will Do:**

* Cover a territory consisting of Enterprise and Commercial companies
* Work closely with the services sellers to deliver Red Hat's services and solutions using the business requirements of your customers to deliver required outcomes
* Grow your territory through the development of internal business partnerships with the field sales team and alliance and partner programs
* Design and implement effective, high\-impact technical and business solutions for Red Hat's customers with a focus on core Red Hat technologies including OpenShift, Ansible AAP, OpenShift AI, RHEL, and others
* Accurately and consistently provide revenue and booking forecasts for your territory
* Manage revenue and booking goals across all practices; meet margin and use targets
* Ensure successful delivery of all projects
* Coordinate customer managers who manage consultants, fostering a culture of collaboration within your team
* Taking accountability for service delivery performance, meeting customer expectations, and driving future demand
* Providing accurate and regular reports to the management on performance of the service delivery
* Leading personnel management, including staff recruitment, performance assessment, training, and mentoring
* Building strong relationships with teams and stakeholders to enable effective dialogue exchange between departments


Within 12 months, you will be expected to do the following

* Grow your revenue base on a quarterly basis
* Manage escalations without supervision
* Assist with negotiating Red Hat’s master services agreements and statements of work with the customers and the legal team

**What You Will Bring:**

* Knowledge of technical or business consulting practices
* Experience managing technical teams
* Experience in services sales and processes in customer accounts
* Experience in project delivery
* Experience with internal matrix team coordination
* Ability to architect complex solutions using multiple offerings and technologies to deliver requested business value
* Experience adhering to agile methodologies within project teams
* Knowledge of application development or cloud solutions creation and delivery
* Experience in and willingness to speak at public conferences and meetups


\#LI\-VG11

**About Red Hat**


Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. **Inclusion at Red Hat**  

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**  

Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

### **Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. ### **Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email** **application\-assistance@redhat.com****. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.**

 We are seeking a highly experienced
 **Cloud Lead** 
 with strong expertise in
 **AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins** 
 to lead large\-scale cloud transformation and modernization initiatives.  Proficient

* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Jenkins


 Intermediate
   

  

* Python OR Bash OR PowerShell
* Azure DevOps OR GitHub Actions

 Experience

63cede59.description:
**About The Job**
 The Red Hat Consulting Services team is adding a Services Manager in India. In this role, you will develop, cultivate, and manage relationships within key Enterprise and Commercial customer accounts. You will oversee the successful delivery of projects under your management from kickoff to closeout, including determining scope details and monitoring project progress to ensure that it conforms to customer expectations and contractual agreements. You’ll also help identify and qualify new business opportunities and work with Red Hat’s sales organization to formulate account strategies that promote revenue growth. You’ll partner with Red Hat’s sales representatives to guide consulting sales opportunities from qualification to closing while managing all assigned projects and resources while meeting revenue and booking goals. You’ll need to have a good foundation of technical knowledge, as well as project and scope management expertise, as you'll establish the technical and non\-technical enablement needs for the Consulting team.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Cover a territory consisting of Enterprise and Commercial companies
* Work closely with the services sellers to deliver Red Hat's services and solutions using the business requirements of your customers to deliver required outcomes
* Grow your territory through the development of internal business partnerships with the field sales team and alliance and partner programs
* Design and implement effective, high\-impact technical and business solutions for Red Hat's customers with a focus on core Red Hat technologies including OpenShift, Ansible AAP, OpenShift AI, RHEL, and others
* Accurately and consistently provide revenue and booking forecasts for your territory
* Manage revenue and booking goals across all practices; meet margin and use targets
* Ensure successful delivery of all projects
* Coordinate customer managers who manage consultants, fostering a culture of collaboration within your team
* Taking accountability for service delivery performance, meeting customer expectations, and driving future demand
* Providing accurate and regular reports to the management on performance of the service delivery
* Leading personnel management, including staff recruitment, performance assessment, training, and mentoring
* Building strong relationships with teams and stakeholders to enable effective dialogue exchange between departments


 Within 12 months, you will be expected to do the following
   

  

* Grow your revenue base on a quarterly basis
* Manage escalations without supervision
* Assist with negotiating Red Hat’s master services agreements and statements of work with the customers and the legal team


**What You Will Bring**
* Knowledge of technical or business consulting practices
* Experience managing technical teams
* Experience in services sales and processes in customer accounts
* Experience in project delivery
* Experience with internal matrix team coordination
* Ability to architect complex solutions using multiple offerings and technologies to deliver requested business value
* Experience adhering to agile methodologies within project teams
* Knowledge of application development or cloud solutions creation and delivery
* Experience in and willingness to speak at public conferences and meetups


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
   

  

 Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application\-assistance@redhat.com.  \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

 We are seeking a delivery\-focused professional to lead squad\-level outcomes within Security Monitoring \& Analytics (SMA). This role centres on ensuring predictable delivery through active planning, tracking, risk and dependency management, and stakeholder alignment. Working closely with the Technical Product Owner, Tech Leads, and Release Train Engineer, the individual will enable effective agile practices while maintaining a strong focus on delivery flow, transparency, and measurable outcomes.

**Who You Are**
 Experienced in delivery management with a focus on predictability, flow, and transparency in complex environmentsProactive in understanding squad objectives and individual accountabilities to drive delivery outcomesKnowledgeable in SAFe and agile practices, including PI planning, forecasting, and dependency managementSkilled in managing risks, issues, and impediments, with the ability to influence stakeholders and resolve blockersEffective communicator with strong stakeholder management and facilitation skillsCapable of translating delivery data into clear, actionable insights for leadershipExperienced with delivery tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or ConfluenceDemonstrates self\-driven ownership, structured thinking, and collaborative problem\-solvingExposure to Security Monitoring \& Analytics or SOC modernisation programmes is desirableRelevant certifications (e.g., SAFe, PRINCE2, PMP, ITIL) are advantageous
   

  

**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to work on critical cyber security initiatives within a global organisationExposure to large\-scale agile delivery frameworks and cross\-functional collaborationA role that enables visible impact on delivery outcomes and organisational performanceContinuous learning through stakeholder engagement and complex programme environmentsAccess to modern delivery tools and structured governance practices
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Advanced agile delivery practices within SAFe environmentsEnd\-to\-end delivery lifecycle management in security\-focused programmesRisk, issue, and dependency management at scaleStakeholder alignment and communication across global teamsData\-driven reporting and delivery governance techniques
   

  

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

 \#JDEnhancedByTARA

22f0dd86.description:
**Company Description** 
 Asset Analytix Inc. is a data\-driven improvement management solutions provider focused on maintenance and reliability, helping organizations maximize asset value while reducing costs through lean principles and best practices. The company’s 360Navigator Improvement Management Platform automates and streamlines improvement processes across the entire asset life cycle. Combining practitioner\-based expertise with proven processes, robust controls, and established standards, Asset Analytix delivers measurable and sustainable performance improvements. Team members work with clients to drive transformational outcomes in a short timeframe, making a direct impact on operational efficiency and asset reliability.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Client Engagement Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune District, responsible for managing relationships with clients and ensuring successful adoption of Asset Analytix solutions. In this role, the Manager collaborates with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, translate requirements into actionable plans, and oversee improvement initiatives throughout the asset life cycle. Daily activities include coordinating project timelines, facilitating workshops and review meetings, monitoring performance metrics, and providing insights on maintenance and reliability best practices. The Manager also works closely with internal teams to align solution delivery with client expectations, resolve issues promptly, and support continuous improvement in client engagement processes.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support evidence\-based recommendations.
* Candidates should possess Program Management and Project Management skills to plan, execute, and track multiple client initiatives effectively.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Consulting skills to engage stakeholders, present findings, and guide clients through improvement strategies.
* Relevant experience in maintenance, reliability, asset management, or operations improvement is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related discipline; an advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CMRP, Lean/Six Sigma) are an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site with client teams in Pune District, build strong professional relationships, and adapt to diverse organizational cultures.
* Proficiency with data analysis tools, dashboards, and enterprise platforms; familiarity with improvement management or asset lifecycle systems is preferred.

102d01d6.description:
**Overview**
 Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete AI Revenue Workflow Platform that helps sales leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. Outreach infuses agentic AI to power 100s of use cases across sales motions. From new logo prospecting to renewal and expansion, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Global organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including SAP, Siemens, Snowflake, ZoomInfo, and Verizon to name a few. To learn more, please visit www.outreach.io.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At Outreach, Business Systems’ mission is to enable and enhance corporate processes at scale. We are a centralized team providing a suite of services to other Outreachers, helping them to efficiently serve our customers and each other. We are building the team around strong critical thinkers \- individuals who can navigate ambiguity and help us along our journey of discovery and transformation.
   

  

**The Role**
 Outreach is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Business Systems team as a TPM aligned closely to our Finance systems portfolio. This role owns the strategy and execution across our end\-to\-end Finance technology stack, spanning ERP, procurement, expense management, and HR financial workflows.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise systems experience, strong cross\-functional instincts, and the technical fluency to navigate integrations across a modern Finance tech stack.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with Finance, Engineering, and Operations leadership to drive delivery, shape system strategy, and build durable program practices for a high\-visibility portfolio.
   

  

**Your Daily Adventures Will Include**
* Own the TPM strategy for Outreach's Finance systems portfolio, serving as the primary program lead across ERP, procurement, expense, and financial operations tooling
* Lead end\-to\-end program management for large\-scale Finance system initiatives, including milestones, risk mitigation, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication across Finance, Engineering, and Operations
* Develop and execute project plans that span multiple teams and systems; proactively identify and resolve blockers across the full delivery lifecycle
* Navigate shifting requirements and evolving business needs by refining scope, clarifying intent, and realigning delivery expectations with stakeholders
* Drive UAT coordination with business stakeholders, ensuring readiness across Finance workflows before production deployment
* Build and maintain program\-level communication rhythms, tailored for both executive sponsors and cross\-functional leads
* Manage cross\-functional delivery challenges with limited precedent; drive convergence in complex decision spaces involving Finance, IT, and external vendors
* Establish and scale QA checkpoints, integration planning practices, and change management processes within the Finance systems portfolio
* Advise on tooling decisions, integration strategy, and platform trade\-offs across the Finance systems landscape
* Informally guide TPM best practices across the team; contribute to cross\-team execution frameworks and delivery culture


**Our Vision Of You**
* 5\+ years of technical program management experience, with at least 2 years on enterprise finance systems or ERP platforms
* Demonstrated experience leading ERP migrations or large\-scale system transitions (NetSuite, SAP, or equivalent)
* Ability to manage shifting requirements across multi\-stakeholder environments; experience aligning Finance, Engineering, and Operations teams around shared delivery goals
* Strong understanding of enterprise system architecture, data flows, and integrations — able to translate business requirements into technical inputs and flag risks proactively
* Experience coordinating UAT with business stakeholders and driving accountability across cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with Finance\-adjacent tools such as Concur, Workday, ZipHQ, or similar platforms is a strong plus
* Proficient in defect/issue tracking tools such as Jira; comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to clearly communicate program status, risks, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences, up to executive level
* Self\-starter who identifies quality and delivery risks proactively, without waiting to be asked
* Experience in a SaaS or high\-growth technology environment preferred


**Why You’ll Love It Here**
* Generous medical, dental, and vision coverage for full\-time employees and their dependents
* Flexible time off
* 401k to help you save for the future
* Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN\+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA\+), Gender\+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
* A parental leave program that includes not just extended time off but options for a paid night nurse, and a gradual return to work
* Infertility/ assisted reproductive services benefit
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* Plus, unlimited snacks and beverages in our kitchen
* We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status


***Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. d6ebca6d.title: Lead Technology Program Manager
d6ebca6d.description:
Position Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced
 **Lead Technology Program Manager** 
 to drive the successful delivery of complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives that support strategic business priorities and customer commitments.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Business teams to plan, coordinate, and execute large\-scale programs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership, executive communication skills, technical acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex matrix organization. This leader will manage strategic customer initiatives and technology programs, cross\-functional dependencies, risks, financial planning, and executive reporting while ensuring delivery against business objectives.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Program Planning and Execution
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of complex technology programs and strategic initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, schedules, and milestone tracking.
* Coordinate activities across multiple product, engineering, and business teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Track program progress and drive timely resolution of issues that may impact delivery commitments.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Customer\-facing teams to align priorities and execution plans.
* Facilitate cross\-functional discussions to manage dependencies, remove obstacles, and resolve conflicts.
* Drive accountability across stakeholders while fostering a collaborative and results\-oriented environment.


 Governance and Communication
   

  

* Establish and manage program governance processes, operating rhythms, and reporting mechanisms.
* Prepare and deliver clear, concise program status updates for leadership reviews.
* Communicate key milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Ensure transparency into program health and delivery progress.


 Risk and Dependency Management
   

  

* Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, issues, and interdependencies.

 Continuous Improvement

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a data\-driven approach to decision making.

9ee6e0a3.title: Solutions Architect - Del, Cross Industries
9ee6e0a3.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

* Do you like helping customers solve technical problems?
* Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing technologies?
* Do you have a knack for helping companies understand Emerging Technology Domains such as GenAI, Agentic AI, Analytics , Microservices architectures including the integration approaches?
* Do you thrive on rolling up your sleeves , a Builder who can help Architect new and emerging technologies along with been consultative to ensure success?
* Do you want to be part of the Retail / CPG team helping to establish Amazon Web Services as a leading technology platform for some of the largest Brands \& Customers in India.


  

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  

  

As a Solution Architect, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s utility computing web services within strategic accounts and partners. Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the Amazon Web Services technologies as well as broad know\-how around how applications and services are constructed using the Amazon Web Services platform.  

  

The ideal candidate will possess customer\-facing skills that will allow him/her to represent AISPL well within a customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables him/her to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Serve as a key technical member of the Retail/CPG Account team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the Amazon Web Services platform.
* Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Own each technical engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value. (delivery of actual solutions to be done by Amazon Web Services partners)
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
* Understand the Amazon Web Services market segments, customer base, and industry verticals.

  

Key job responsibilities  

This role is within the Retail/CPG team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and based out of
  

Delhi  

  

* As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.

  

* Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.

  

* You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.

  

* As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.

  

To be successful in this role you need to be passionate builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.  

  

Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).  

  

A day in the life  

The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.  

  

Want to learn more about being a Solutions Architect at AMAZON, follow the link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=Js21xKMFdww  

  

About the team  

Retail/CPG Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.  

  

You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to some of the largest Brands/Services/Ecommerce customers in India . This customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 3\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* 3\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

6a814254.title: Technical Solutions Consultant, PDM, PLM
6a814254.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C\+\+, Python).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field.
* 5 years of experience with Siemens teamcenter, and 1 year of experience in technical leadership.
* Proficient in ITK, Java, ReactJS, JavaScript, with experience in developing extensions, workflow handlers, and services.
* In\-depth knowledge of PLM servers/APIs, RDBMS, and infrastructure scaling frameworks, and adept at navigating ambiguity, fostering creativity, and driving operational efficiency.
* Expertise in cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP), for deploying and scaling PLM solutions.
* Strong problem\-solving, leadership, and communication skills for effective global team collaboration.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross\-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.  

  

You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.



As a Technical Solution Consultant you will help refine and grow the capabilities of current Product Data Management (PDM) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, driving continuous improvement to meet the Engineering needs. You will design, develop and sustain PLM, New Product Introduction (NPI) and supply chain related application systems.


In this role, you will also promote best practices and internal business processes. You will be responsive and able to adapt quickly to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment. You will work in a data driven environment, have a desire to drive change, and are excited by the opportunity to analyze systematic issues and implement solutions to challenging problems.


Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices \& Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices \& Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Architect and optimize Siemens team center solutions, managing the configuration, installation, maintenance, and ongoing support of teamcenter PLM application, including integrations with CAD applications.
* Manage, optimize and support cloud infrastructure for teamcenter, leveraging GCP technologies to ensure scalability, high availability, and security compliance.
* Collaborate with global teams to deliver tailored solutions, providing implementation and configuration expertise.
* Design robust application architectures, including microservices and scalable frameworks, while aligning with development best practices.
* Author and review technical documentation, drive design/code reviews, and identify opportunities to enhance functionality with cloud technologies.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

* Experience managing client\-facing SEO engagements and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills with expertise in GA4, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio.
* Proven experience driving measurable improvements in organic traffic, rankings, conversions, and revenue.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Experience leading cross\-functional teams and mentoring junior team members.

**Preferred Experience**


* Experience with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI\-powered search ecosystems.
* Understanding of Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and emerging AI search experiences.
* Experience leveraging AI tools for SEO analysis, content optimization, workflow automation, and insight generation.
* Familiarity with entity\-based search, semantic search, and knowledge graph optimization.

* Experience in consulting, digital agencies, or enterprise SEO environments
