Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

About the Role\& Team
  
As a member of our newly establishedERP Make\& Asset Management team within Roche Digital Technology (RDT), you will be a vital asset in driving our global operations forward. We are looking for a collaborative expert who doesn't just configure systems, but deeply understandsend\-to\-end (E2E) manufacturing process flows and integration dynamics in a complex, multi\-partner environment.
  
Rather than working in a silo, you will work hand\-in\-hand with Roche internal teams and global vendors to ensure seamless daily operations and drive continuous business improvements. If you thrive on taking true ownership, connecting the dots across system boundaries, and diving into complex supply chain networks to solve tough challenges, this role is built for you.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* E2E Solution Delivery\& Integration: Work as a key contributor within the Make team to design, deliver, and support ERP capabilities supporting External Manufacturing and collaboration platforms (GEP Nexxe). Drive strong integration logic across internal SAP modules and partner platforms.
* Process Flow\& Operations Support: Ensure smooth daily operations while supporting the business with new features, integrations, and changing operational needs. Apply a strong "process\-first" mindset to ensure end\-to\-end data integrity across system boundaries.
* E2E Ownership\& Problem Solving: Take full accountability for complex, cross\-system operational and technical challenges. Dig deep into end\-to\-end process flows to identify root causes and proactively propose sustainable, scalable solutions—even when navigating crowded stakeholder environments.
* Stakeholder\& Partner Collaboration: Act as a core bridge between Roche internal business teams, RDT cross functional teams and external system provider. Facilitate clear communication, align expectations, and foster strong team dynamics across a multi\-player matrix.
* Continuous Improvement\& Innovation: Continuously evaluate current solutions against business requirements to streamline external partner collaboration, reduce friction, and align with global ERP roadmaps.


Qualifications\& Experience
  
  

* Domain Expertise: Solid hands\-on experience inSAP ERP / S/4HANA (MM\& QM modules). Demonstrated expertise in External Manufacturing and collaboration tools (e.g., SAP Ariba, SNC, E2open, Coupa, or O9 Solutions), with proven experienceintegrating these tools with S/4HANA using middleware such as Mulesoft, SAP CPI, or Tibco.
* End\-to\-End\& Integration Thinking: Strong understanding of E2E manufacturing process flows and key integration points (Procurement, Inventory Management, Quality Control, Supply Chain, and Third\-Party System Interfaces via middleware/APIs).
* Curious\& Analytical Mindset: High analytical capabilities combined with a relentless curiosity to see "the big picture." You are not satisfied with surface\-level fixes; you take pride in understanding why a process works and taking the effort to solve complex topics thoroughly.
* Self\-Driven\& Accountable: A self\-starter who takes personal ownership of outcomes. Comfortable taking the lead, going the extra mile to get alignment, and navigating ambiguous or high\-touch situations involving multiple stakeholders.
* Business Process First: Advanced problem\-solving skills with a strong process\-oriented mindset. You understandbusiness operational impact, not just system configuration.
* Global\& Collaborative Mindset: Demonstrated experience working effectively across cross\-functional, global teams and external vendor environments. Experience in Agile / SAFe framework methodologies is a plus.
* Education: University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, Supply Chain Management, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


What We Offer You
  
  

* The opportunity to be a foundational part of a newly forming, business\-critical global RDT team.
* A hybrid, flexible working model based out of our state\-of\-the\-art facility in Hyderabad.
* A team culture driven by psychological safety, shared success, and continuous learning.


\#Hyderabad2026
  
  

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.

 The Solution Account Lead (SAL) is a strategic leader who combines deep SAP expertise, business acumen, and end\-to\-end SCM domain knowledge to drive LoB cloud revenue, customer success, accelerate adoption of innovation (especially AI), and position the organization as a market leader. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
   

  

 Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
   

  

 As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
   

  

**About The Job**
 You'll play a critical role in supporting our enterprise customers early in their journey to ensure the absolute success of their architectural foundations. You'll will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production\-ready ecosystem. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor, leading new customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.
   

  

 Sitting at the heart of our customer\-first culture, you will shape tailored onboarding blueprints, orchestrate complex delivery workstreams, and guarantee a predictable, accelerated time‑to‑value. For our fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self‑managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deliver secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role (e.g., Solution Architect, Solution Engineer, Onboarding Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, or Technical Consulting).
* Hands\-on experience with production workloads in at least one major cloud provider ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Deep technical proficiency in core networking infrastructure, including VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with ETL/CDC platforms and data ingestion.
* Proven track record implementing Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) design.
* Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container environments).
* Hands\-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j).
* Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk).
* Exposure to cloud compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and data residency deployment patterns.


**Responsibilities**
* Drive customer value by translating complex business requirements into tailored technical solutions that solve core business challenges and accelerate cloud adoption.
* Lead complex technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to align on success criteria, KPIs, milestones, and mitigation strategies for project risks.
* Guide the instantiation of Neo4j AuraDB environments or self\-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures utilizing private endpoints and IP allow lists.
* Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption\-at\-rest protocols, and enforce least\-privileged access through enterprise SSO and RBAC configurations.
* Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise development teams on Neo4j driver optimization, connection pooling, and retry logic.
* Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools for logs and metrics, while delivering best\-practice workshops on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.

8002c80b.description:
Job Description:

Schneider Electric SE is a French multinational company that specializes in digital automation and energy management. Schneider Electric is a publicly traded Fortune Global 500 company, the company posted revenues of €34\.2 billion. It addresses homes, buildings, data centers, infrastructure and industries, by combining energy technologies, real\-time automation, software, and services. Schneider Electric is the parent company of APC, Aveva, L\&T E\&A among so many.
Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low\-voltage switchgear, medium\-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.**Job Description**  

**Position:** Software Tester / QA Engineer – Digital Solutions  

**Location:** Navi Mumbai (Mahape) Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech Experience: 3–7 Years  

**Role Summary**  

We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Software Automation Tester with hands\-on experience in SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems testing. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing manual and automated test scripts to validate the functionality, performance, and safety of SCADA\-based industrial control systems. You will work closely with software engineers, control systems engineers, and project managers to ensure the highest quality across our critical infrastructure solutions.  

**Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables**  

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for SCADA applications using industry\-standard frameworks and scripting languages.
* Build end\-to\-end test suites to test, alarm management, historian modules, and communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870, IEC 61850, SNMP, OPC\-UA/DA).
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous regression testing.
* Create and manage test data, simulation environments, and configurations for realistic SCADA testing.
* Execute functional, regression, performance on SCADA platforms.
* Monitor automated test runs, triage failures, and log defects with clear reproduction steps in issue\-tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, etc.).
* Generate detailed test reports, coverage metrics, and traceability matrices aligned with project requirements.
* Participate in automation code reviews for test scripts to ensure quality, readability, and maintainability.
* Work with control systems and software engineers to understand system architecture, PLC/RTU integrations, and data flows.
* Contribute to test strategy, test plans, and QA documentation as per relevant industry standards.
* Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively propose automation solutions to reduce manual effort.
* Support root cause analysis and provide feedback for continuous quality improvement.
* Develop test strategies, test plans, and test cases based on business requirements and design documents.
* Identify, document, track, and verify software defects.
* Validate REST APIs, web applications, and mobile applications.
* Prepare test reports, defect metrics, and quality dashboards.
* Collaborate closely with development teams to resolve issues.
 **Functional / Technical Competencies**  

* Testing Tools \& Technologies
* Selenium
* Cypress
* Postman
* JMeter

  

* TestNG
* Playwright (Preferred)
* Testing Expertise
* Functional Testing
* Regression Testing
* Integration Testing
* API Testing
* Performance Testing
* Security Testing
* User Acceptance Testing
* Knowledge Areas
* SDLC \& STLC
* Agile/Scrum Methodologies
* Defect Lifecycle Management
* Jira / Azure DevOps
* CI/CD Pipeline Validation
* OWASP Security Principles

  

**Preferred Skills**  

* Automation Framework Development
* Programming Knowledge (Java, JavaScript, Python)
* Azure DevOps
* Docker and Container Platforms
* Industrial IoT Application Testing
 **Key Behavioral Competencies**  

* Detail\-Oriented Approach
* Strong Analytical Skills
* Quality Mindset
* Effective Communication
* Collaboration and Teamwork
* Proactive Problem Solving

3c056ca2.title: Senior/Lead Solution Architect- Node.js
3c056ca2.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are looking for a **Senior/Lead Solution Architect** with deep expertise in Node.js to join our growing team in India and help design cutting\-edge solutions for global clients. In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of large\-scale, high\-performance solutions, working closely with clients and internal teams. From pre\-sales to go\-live, your expertise will shape the future of enterprise technology.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and implement the architecture for backend services using Node.js and related frameworks, meeting architectural significant requirements (ASRs)
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to the development team, mentoring on best practices, code standards, and design patterns in a hands\-on way, including peer programming with developers on the team
* Conduct code reviews, enforce quality standards, and ensure maintainability, efficiency, and security of the codebase
* Collaborate with front\-end developers, DevOps teams, and other stakeholders to deliver full\-stack solutions
* Identify and address performance bottlenecks, optimize application performance, and ensure responsiveness
* Implement and enforce security best practices, authentication, and data protection strategies
* Troubleshoot and debug complex issues across the application stack, providing timely resolutions
* Engage proactively in architecture discussions and take a leadership role in customer site assignments

**Requirements**

* 18\-27 years of experience in IT, with a strong background in solution architecture
* Proficiency in JavaScript and Node.js, including deep understanding of the event loop, asynchronous programming, and module system
* Expertise in Node.js frameworks such as Express.js, along with familiarity with other relevant libraries
* Skills in designing and developing RESTful APIs and GraphQL APIs
* Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and DynamoDB
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and version control best practices
* Background in unit testing, integration testing, and debugging tools
* Knowledge of security best practices, authentication methods such as OAuth and JWT, and data protection strategies
* Deep experience developing cloud native solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address performance issues systematically
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with fluency in English
* Experience mentoring and guiding developers on the team

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

737ea0c2.title: Senior Software Architect — Agentic AI Engineering
737ea0c2.description:
About the Role PrismHR is the technology engine behind Vensure Employer Solutions, powering the payroll, benefits administration, and compliance systems that businesses depend on every day. We're looking for a Senior Software Architect to take ownership of the architecture vision across this platform — with a specific mandate to bring genuine agentic AI engineering into how our products work — and drive how it evolves as we build the next generation of SaaS capability. This is a hands\-on, high\-trust role. You'll work directly with developers, QA, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and senior executives to shape both near\-term features and long\-term technical direction. You'll be expected to move fluidly between whiteboard architecture sessions, hands\-on prototyping, and boardroom conversations about technology strategy.
  
The Real Challenge of This Role You will not be architecting a system you built. You'll be stepping into an existing, mission\-critical platform — one with real history, real constraints, and real people who know it deeply. Your job is to learn it fast, earn the trust of the teams who live in it every day, and turn what you learn from developers, QA, BAs, and Product Owners into sound architectural decisions and new feature designs that improve the experience for the customers who rely on our payroll, benefits, and compliance systems. No one will be holding your hand. You'll need to be comfortable figuring things out — diagnosing ambiguity, asking the right people the right questions, and driving toward a working answer — largely on your own initiative.
  
What You'll Do • Create high\-quality, working prototypes and proofs of concept to guide development teams. • Partner with other architects to build and maintain an architecture vision and roadmap for the PrismHR platform. • Work with executive management to shape technology strategy, weighing both technical and business trends. • Partner with product leaders to design applications that support the product roadmap. • Drive design and integration of major new capabilities into the product line alongside senior developers, balancing long\-term architectural soundness with short\-term market needs and security. • Lead, coach, and develop architects and software developers, raising the bar for how high\-quality software gets built.
  
What We're Looking For • A proven, practicing Software Architect — you've held architect\-level scope and title for multiple recent years, not a senior engineer looking to make the jump into architecture for the first time. This role's scope is genuinely demanding, and we need someone who has already done this job successfully. • Demonstrated success learning systems you didn't build — you can point to real examples of joining an existing codebase or platform, getting up to speed quickly by working closely with the people who know it, and successfully architecting or delivering on it. • Deep technical\-to\-business translation skills — you're able to sit with stakeholders who describe a need in business terms and turn that into sound, deliberate technical decisions. • Balanced, full\-application understanding — you understand how the frontend, backend, data layer, and infrastructure all fit together, and you don't default to a frontend\- or backend\-only lens when architecting a solution. • 10\+ years of software development experience across the full SaaS development lifecycle, with a strong grasp of Agile methods and experience leading development teams in an Agile environment. • Genuine agentic AI engineering experience — this is the core requirement for this role. We need someone who has designed and built systems where multiple AI agents work together in an orchestrated workflow to accomplish something for an end user. Using AI tools to code faster, brainstorm, or research is valuable but is not what this requirement means — we're specifically looking for hands\-on experience building agent\-based frameworks, orchestration patterns, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and working with protocols like MCP. • Data engineering and pipeline experience for AI/ML — particularly with vector and hybrid databases, and pipelines that feed large language or predictive models. • Fluency across our broader technology stack — Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and ASP.NET Core — along with DevOps practices (containers, configuration management, monitoring, deployment automation), streaming/messaging technologies (Azure Service Bus, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar), and cloud deployment/troubleshooting on Azure or AWS. • Comfort using AI\-assisted development tooling (such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code) in your own day\-to\-day work — this is a baseline expectation, distinct from the agentic engineering requirement above. • A genuine interest in legacy modernization and familiarity with emerging open\-source technologies. • Strong leadership and communication skills — you can operate credibly with individual developers, senior engineers, and executives alike. • B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent experience. • Based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh and available on\-site for a split shift aligned to 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time, to overlap with US\-based stakeholders.
  
Why Join Us • Shape the architecture of a platform that's core to how thousands of businesses run payroll, benefits, and compliance. • Real influence — from whiteboard to boardroom — over how agentic AI gets built into a platform millions of end users touch. • Ground\-floor ownership of what genuine agentic engineering looks like across our product line, not a bolt\-on AI feature. • A technical leadership role with genuine autonomy and executive visibility.

Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, Pune, Gurugram, Haryana, India

93123dc5.title: Program Manager 4
93123dc5.description:
**Job Description**
 Principal Program Manager, OCI Transitions and Migrations
   

  

 Are you a creative problem\-solver who thrives on complex challenges? Do you enjoy bringing structure to ambiguity, aligning diverse stakeholders, and driving large\-scale programs to successful outcomes? If so, you may be the perfect fit for our team as a Principal Program Manager.
   

  

 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is transforming how organizations run their most important applications and workloads. The OCI Transitions and Migrations team helps customers plan and execute complex transitions to Oracle Cloud, coordinating activities across customer teams, engineering, operations, product management, support, sales, and other Oracle organizations.
   

  

 As a Principal Program Manager for OCI Transitions and Migrations, you will lead high\-impact migration and transition programs, establish clear execution plans, manage cross\-functional dependencies, and ensure successful delivery. You will act as a central point of accountability, communicate program status to senior leadership, and drive resolution of issues that span teams and organizations.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

**8\+ Years of Related Experience:**
 Eight or more years of experience in program management, project management, cloud migrations, enterprise technology delivery, consulting, operations, or a related field.
   

  

**Program Leadership and Execution:**
 Demonstrated experience leading large, complex programs across multiple teams, workstreams, and organizational boundaries. Proven ability to develop integrated plans, roadmaps, milestones, governance models, and success measures.
   

  

**Cloud and Migration Experience:**
 Experience supporting cloud transitions, enterprise migrations, infrastructure programs, application migrations, data migrations, or technology transformation initiatives. Experience with OCI, AWS, Azure, or other enterprise cloud platforms is preferred.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Leadership:**
 Ability to build strong relationships, align stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and drive shared outcomes across engineering, operations, product, support, sales, customer, and leadership teams.
   

  

**Risk, Dependency, and Change Management:**
 Experience identifying risks, managing complex dependencies, developing mitigation and recovery plans, and maintaining progress through changing priorities or ambiguous conditions.
   

  

**Communication and Influence:**
 Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex information clearly, influence without direct authority, and represent programs effectively with senior leaders.
   

  

**Strategic and Analytical Thinking:**
 Ability to connect program execution to broader customer and business objectives, work with large amounts of qualitative and quantitative information, assess program health, and make sound recommendations.
   

  

**Educational Background:**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Lead Program Delivery:**
 Lead complex OCI transition and migration programs from planning through execution, stabilization, and completion, ensuring delivery aligns with scope, schedule, customer commitments, and business objectives.
   

  

**Manage Roadmaps, Dependencies, and Resources:**
 Develop and maintain integrated program roadmaps, milestones, ownership models, dependencies, resource requirements, and success criteria across cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**Drive Stakeholder Alignment and Execution:**
 Establish alignment and accountability across customer teams, engineering, operations, product management, support, sales, and partner organizations. Remove barriers and drive timely decisions and actions.
   

  

**Manage Risks and Resolve Issues:**
 Identify risks, issues, and dependencies early; develop mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans; and independently drive resolution of cross\-team and division\-level challenges.
   

  

**Establish Program Governance:**
 Create and maintain effective governance, including decision\-making processes, escalation paths, status reporting, operating cadences, metrics, and executive review mechanisms.
   

  

**Communicate Program Status and Recommendations:**
 Provide clear written and verbal updates on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and customer impact. Present complex issues with relevant data, tradeoffs, options, and recommendations.
   

  

**Represent the Program With Senior Leadership:**
 Represent the program and organization independently in discussions through the VP level and support higher\-level executive engagements as appropriate.
   

  

**Maintain Customer and Operational Excellence:**
 Ensure a consistent Oracle customer experience throughout the transition and migration lifecycle while maintaining high standards for quality, readiness, and execution.
   

  

**Improve Program Practices:**
 Identify and implement improvements to planning, governance, reporting, risk management, communications, and execution. Develop reusable templates, dashboards, metrics, and best practices that improve consistency and predictability.
   

  

**Build Relationships and Mentor Others:**
 Build trusted partnerships across teams, organizations, cultures, and geographies, while providing guidance and mentorship to other program managers.
   

  

 Join Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and help customers successfully transition their most important workloads to the cloud. Your leadership, judgment, and ability to drive complex programs will play a critical role in delivering successful migration outcomes and improving how OCI executes transitions at scale.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Identifies, prioritizes, and successfully executes a broad portfolio of functional initiatives and programs. Plans and directs schedules for multiple programs running simultaneously. Partners closely with global cross\-functional teams to understand and capture requirements for programs. Navigates complex dependencies between cross\-functional teams and organizational priorities to optimize the critical path and addresses \& mitigates risks. Effectively influences internal and external teams to prioritize; Drives mitigation plans and ensures ownership for each item and regular follow up through to program closure while ensuring resolution of risk and issues, escalating, as necessary. Provides rigorous management and analysis of overall portfolio budget (including spend and forecasted spend vs. budget, spend per program and historical trends, etc.). Establishes scalable frameworks (process, tools, etc.) for the end\-to\-end project and manages stakeholders applying project management standards and documentation best practices. Runs standups and sprint planning exercises for programs owned. Builds and maintains consistent reporting across numerous programs. Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel. Performs other duties as assigned.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC4
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

12606f3b.title: Expert Technical Program Manager- Remote
12606f3b.description:
Welcome to Veradigm! Our Mission is to be the most trusted provider of innovative solutions that empower all stakeholders across the healthcare continuum to deliver world\-class outcomes. Our Vision is a Connected Community of Health that spans continents and borders. With the largest community of clients in healthcare, Veradigm is able to deliver an integrated platform of clinical, financial, connectivity and information solutions to facilitate enhanced collaboration and exchange of critical patient information.
   

  

 Veradigm
   

  

 Veradigm is here to transform health, insightfully. Veradigm delivers a unique combination of point\-of\-care clinical and financial solutions, a commitment to open interoperability, a large and diverse healthcare provider footprint, along with industry proven expert insights. We are dedicated to simplifying the complicated healthcare system with next\-generation technology and solutions, transforming healthcare from the point\-of\-patient care to everyday life.
   

  

 For more information, please explore www.veradigm.com.
   

  

**Overview**
 What will your job look like:
   

  

 The Expert Technical Program Manager will focus primarily on the Veradigm EHR product, responsible for developing program strategy in alignment with the program's long\-term vision with little oversight. This role emphasizes ensuring product stability, managing ongoing enhancements, and overseeing critical maintenance activities for our established EHR platform. The Expert Technical Program Manager will collaborate with development teams to maintain existing features, manage product updates, and ensure regulatory requirements are met that drive a great product experience and high value for our clients. The Expert Technical Program Manager owns communication across teams, eliminates risk to execution, and owns the outcome.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Product Goals and Execution –
   

  

* Develop critical goals related to user experience, quality, usability, reliability, security, scalability, ease\-of\-use, installation, and responsiveness that exceeds client and market expectations for the Veradigm EHR product
* Drive product enhancements and coordinate feature updates in an Agile software development environment in collaboration with the leadership team.
* Responsible for TPM engagement on maintenance activities, bug fixes, security patches, and product updates


 Cross\-Functional Communication –
   

  

* Work with Development, Quality, User Research, and Customer Success teams during to shape the product's technical feature set and usability while ensuring the highest quality products are delivered on time, on budget, and with superior performance and support
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, and Quality teams to ensure regulatory adherence and product standards
* Develop key product themes as the foundational messaging for marketing and other corporate constituents
* Provides frequent status updates and impact assessments to the members of the leadership team


 Product Evangelism –
   

  

* Represent their stakeholders and evangelize the Veradigm EHR product, assuring that the market continues adopting the current product by coordinating activities across our field organization and continually being the champion for the product
* Track and analyze product usage metrics and performance indicators to report on progress toward key metrics and goals
* Ensures the ongoing quality, security, design, experience, and value of the Veradigm EHR in the market
* Ability and comfort with acting as a mentor to other Program Managers
* Identifies and communicates potential prioritization of features and manages trade\-offs
* Provides key messaging on EHR capabilities and market positioning


**Qualifications**
 An Ideal Candidate will have:
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree
* MBA (Preferred)


**Experience**
* Strong domain expertise in EHR product management or healthcare IT, with preferred experience in Health IT
* A minimum of at least 7\+ years of demonstrated success in product management or program management
* Experience in an Agile environment and ability to drive Software Development Lifecycle
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Understanding of EHR market dynamics, healthcare technology requirements, and competitive positioning
* Should have the capability to maintain and enhance products based on changing market and customer requirements
* Should have a flair for understanding healthcare technology platforms that are prevalent in market/competition
* Should have the ability to translate customer problems and regulatory requirements into features and design requirements
* Demonstrates behaviors indicative of Veradigm's values


**Travel Requirements**
* National \& International may be required (estimated 10 – 20%)


**Benefits**
 Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.
   

  

* Competitive salary \& performance bonuses
* Quarterly Company\-Wide Recharge Days
* Flexible Work Environment (Remote/Hybrid Options)
* Professional development and certification reimbursement
* Comprehensive health, retirement, and wellness benefits.
* Peer\-based incentive “Cheer” awards
* “All in to Win” bonus Program


 To know more about the benefits and culture at Veradigm, please visit the links mentioned below: \-
   

  

 https://veradigm.com/about\-veradigm/careers/benefits/
   

  

 https://veradigm.com/about\-veradigm/careers/culture/
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. No job applicant or employee shall receive less favorable treatment or be disadvantaged because of their gender, marital or family status, color, race, ethnic origin, religion, disability or age; nor be subject to less favorable treatment or be disadvantaged on any other basis prohibited by applicable law.
   

  

 Veradigm is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse and inclusive workforce.

614067f5.description:
**About the role**

They define, communicate and govern the architecture for given business domains in order to ensure it enables and delivers the Tesco Business Strategy.  At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital landscape with cutting\-edge, tailored strategies.
   

  

 We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post\-launch, we've earned the distinction of being Salesforce's \#1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.
   

  

 Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI\-powered transformation. Here, you'll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI\-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you're ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.
   

  

 As a
 **Salesforce Technical Architect** 
 focused on Agentforce and AI, you will be responsible for building compelling Agentforce\-powered experiences for users and delivering impactful business value to our clients. You'll have the opportunity to make significant contributions to our success by working with the rest of our talented AI team to delight customers. This position is focused on architecting and executing technical solutions for Agentforce and related\-technologies.
   

  

**You will have the opportunity to:**
* Lead and own the technical solution design. This includes designing and understanding the complete Agentforce solution which includes topics, instructions, actions with corresponding automation/code, agent deployment methods, and supporting data structures.
* Deep dive into the limits and boundaries of Agentforce Agents, finding novel solutions to drive business outcomes.
* Collaborate with customers, Project Managers, Solution Architects, Developers and UX Designers to translate business needs into well\-architected solutions
* Oversee and contribute to all stages of the project lifecycle—from initial design through development, testing, and final deployment
* Follow and understand new Salesforce products and technical capabilities


**Required Qualifications:**
* 6\+ years of experience in application and software development
* 4\+ years of experience with Salesforce in a development role
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Proficiency in Apex and JavaScript, with exposure or working knowledge of modern coding languages (e.g. Python, Java, C\#)
* Experience developing Salesforce technologies including Flows, Lightning Web Components, or Visualforce
* Understanding of front\-end web development principles and technologies (HTML/CSS)
* Strong communication skills; the ability to convey complex technical details to all audiences
* Experience with using source control and branching/pull requests strategies
* Familiarity with CI/CD solutions and DevOps principles
* 15 years of full\-time education


**Preferred Skills:**
* Experience working with Agentic AI Systems and Generative AI capabilities
* Any additional Salesforce certifications are a plus, preferably Platform Developer II or Agentforce Specialist certifications


**What can you expect in the interview process?** 
  

  

* Recruiter screen (phone) \- 30 minutes
+ Introductory conversation to discuss the role and your experience

* Panel Interview with Real\-Time Exercise (Video) \- 60 minutes
+ You'll receive a prompt and talk through potential solution options and live on the spot (no offline preparation required)
+ You'll get some time to interact with NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture delivery team members
+ The call will be split into two parts:

* Organization lead interview (Video) \- 45 minutes
+ You'll talk through your career goals and relevant work examples
+ You'll discuss challenges you have overcome and the tools you used to get there

* Leadership interview (Video) \- 45 minutes
+ You'll meet with a member of our leadership team


**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
*All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.*
 What's it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?
   

  

* Remote \& In\-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we're focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
* Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet\-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
* Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in\-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9\-5 isn't possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
* Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it's a no\-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls \& company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.

**About The Job**
 The Technical Account Manager (TAM) delivers strategic technical and architectural guidance to key customers, enabling them to optimize their Red Hat infrastructure. This role cultivates strong relationships, develops deep technical expertise of customer environments and exercises good judgment to make informed decisions that impact customer success. The TAM is responsible for working independently with minimal instruction to resolve moderately complex technical issues. This role proactively coaches customers on best practices for utilizing Red Hat solutions, anticipates and mitigates potential customer challenges, serving as a trusted advisor and advocate for assigned accounts. The TAM demonstrates a solid understanding of customer business needs and technical environments, contributing significantly to customer success and retention.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Perform technical reviews \& share knowledge to proactively identify \& prevent issues
* Understand your customers' technical infrastructures, hardware, processes, and offerings
* Perform initial or secondary investigations and respond to online and phone support requests
* Deliver key portfolio updates and assist customers with upgrades
* Manage customer cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans \& keep documentation on customer environments updated
* Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction with each qualified engagement through the complete adoption life cycle of our offerings
* Engage with Red Hat's field teams, customers to ensure a positive platform \& cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long\-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat platform \& cloud solutions and our cloud road\-map align to customer use cases
* Capture Red Hat product capabilities and identify gaps as related to customer use cases through a closed\-loop process for each step of the engagement life cycle
* Engage with Red Hat's product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns based on customer engagements and personal experience that guide platform adoption
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat’s platform \& cloud technologies strategy
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a subject matter expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas or process areas
* Travel to visit customers, partners, conferences, and other events as needed


**What You Will Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in science or a technical field; engineering or computer science
* Competent reading and writing skills in English
* Ability to convey information to customers in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to effectively manage and grow existing enterprise customer and partner relationships by delivering best\-in\-class support
* Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills, with a passion for problem solving and investigation
* Upstream involvement in open source projects (patches submitted for upstream) is a plus
* Indian citizenship or authorization to work in India
* Red Hat OpenStack Platform \- RHOSP
+ Fundamental understanding of the OpenStack, Container architecture, and administration experience across all working components
+ Deep understanding and troubleshooting skills on OpenStack core components.
+ Deployment and troubleshooting experience of Openstack cluster on bare metal or non\-bare metal environments.
+ Planning, Designing, and implementation of Openstack products on various hardware.
+ Technical and Deep understanding of Ceph cluster storage and its functionalities.
+ Experience with Linux operating system installation, configuration, upgrade, and maintenance.
+ Technical knowledge of the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform and its components is a plus


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
   

  

**Inclusion at Red Hat**
 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**


LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence runs a lot of them across two continents. As VP, PMO, you'll lead the CCOE program\-management function and the India\-based team of project managers and scrum masters who keep delivery moving across the five CCOE teams. If you're a people\-first delivery leader who can turn a portfolio of overseas work into predictable outcomes, this is your seat.


As the VP, PMO, you lead the program\-management function for LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) and manage the team of project managers and scrum masters — primarily based in the India Global Capability Center (GCC) — who support the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery). You are the single point of accountability for coordinating CCOE projects and tasks executed in the India GCC, and you drive intake, prioritization, milestone tracking, and risk / dependency management across the portfolio. You partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on program\-level cadence and with the VPs leading the CCOE teams to align commitments and balance capacity across LPL's US offices and India. This is a people\-leadership and delivery role — not an engineering or on\-call role — focused on growing a high\-performing PMO and making CCOE delivery predictable.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Build and grow the India\-based PMO as a high\-performing, cohesive team that the CCOE teams trust to run their projects — the delivery backbone for work executed overseas
* Champion agentic AI in program management: AI\-assisted status synthesis and executive reporting, automated risk and dependency surfacing from Jira, and meeting\-notes\-to\-action items — modeling AI\-forward delivery for the PMO team
* Lead the CCOE program\-management function: manage a team of project managers and scrum masters supporting the five CCOE teams across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC)
* Own all people\-management responsibilities for the PMO team: hiring, onboarding, weekly 1:1s, performance management, career development, and capacity planning
* Serve as the single point of accountability for coordinating CCOE projects and tasks executed in the India GCC — planning, sequencing, and reporting status across overseas delivery
* Drive program and project delivery across the CCOE portfolio: intake, prioritization, milestone tracking, and risk / issue / dependency management with clear executive status
* Partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on program\-level cadence: program increment planning, release\-train events, and portfolio reporting
* Standardize PMO practice across CCOE: Jira and Confluence hygiene, reporting dashboards, delivery metrics (predictability, throughput, cycle time), and continuous improvement
* Partner with the VPs leading the five CCOE teams and the Foundations pods to align delivery commitments, remove cross\-team blockers, and balance capacity across the US and India

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years in program / project management including 4\+ years directly managing a team of project managers and/or scrum masters; Bachelor's degree (or equivalent work experience)
* Demonstrated experience as a people manager — hiring, performance management, and career development — of a delivery / PMO team, preferably including an India GCC / offshore team
* Strong program\-management discipline across a technical portfolio: intake, prioritization, milestone / risk / dependency management, and executive reporting in Jira and Confluence
* Experience partnering with an enterprise EPMO / RTE on program\-level events and portfolio reporting (scaled\-Agile experience preferred)
* Experience coordinating delivery across US and India / GCC time zones in a fast\-paced, regulated environment (financial services preferred)

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* Servant\-leader people manager who grows project managers and scrum masters
* Calm under delivery pressure; drives clarity across many concurrent projects
* Excellent executive communicator who makes portfolio status and risk legible to senior leaders
* Data\-driven on delivery health (predictability, throughput, cycle time) — reports early and honestly
* Skilled at cross\-time\-zone coordination between the US and India / GCC
* Bias for pragmatic process that accelerates delivery, not process for its own sake
* Builds high\-trust relationships across CCOE engineering leadership, the enterprise EPMO, and vendor partners

**Preferences:**
----------------

1e89f688.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and dynamic Senior WebRTC \& Live Streaming Architect / Lead Engineer to spearhead the development and optimization of real\-time communication solutions. This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead innovative projects, architect scalable cloud\-based streaming platforms, and drive the future of live multimedia experiences. As a key technical leader, you will collaborate across teams to design robust, high\-performance systems that deliver seamless live streaming and WebRTC functionalities to users worldwide. Your expertise will shape the architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement of cutting\-edge streaming solutions that push the boundaries of real\-time media delivery.

**Duties**

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of WebRTC\-based live streaming architectures, ensuring scalability, low latency, and high reliability.
* Architect cloud\-native solutions leveraging AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms, integrating microservices and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Develop and optimize real\-time media pipelines using technologies like JavaScript, Python, C\#, Java, and related frameworks to ensure smooth live video and audio transmission.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and implement comprehensive system designs using UML diagrams and best practices.
* Oversee continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines utilizing Jenkins, Git, Maven, Ansible, and other DevOps tools to streamline development workflows.
* Ensure system security by implementing HTTPS protocols, RESTful APIs, WCF services, and adhering to best practices for web services and API integrations.
* Conduct performance tuning, troubleshooting, and incident resolution for live streaming platforms while maintaining documentation aligned with SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) standards.
* Stay abreast of emerging trends in WebRTC technology, cloud computing, microservices architecture, and multimedia streaming to innovate solutions that enhance user experience.

**Skills**

* Extensive experience with WebRTC protocols and live streaming technologies in large\-scale environments.
* Proficiency in front\-end frameworks such as Angular, Ember.js, Backbone.js, Kendo UI, Bootstrap for developing intuitive web interfaces.
* Strong backend development skills using C\#, ASP.NET MVC/.NET Core, Java Spring Framework, Python or Perl for building resilient APIs and services.
* Deep understanding of cloud architecture principles with hands\-on experience in AWS (S3\), Azure (Blob Storage), or similar cloud platforms; familiarity with Kubernetes and Docker container orchestration.
* Expertise in database management including MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle (PL/SQL), NoSQL databases like MongoDB or Cassandra for data persistence needs.
* Knowledge of system design patterns such as service\-oriented architecture (SOA), microservices architecture, and enterprise integration techniques like SOAP and REST APIs.
* Experience with version control systems such as Git/SVN or Jenkins for release management; familiarity with build tools like Maven or Ant.
* Ability to interpret UML diagrams for system modeling; experience with WebSphere or WebLogic application servers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of web design principles including HTML5, CSS3, AJAX; familiarity with front\-end libraries like React or Ext JS is advantageous.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices including Ansible automation scripts and CI/CD pipelines to ensure rapid deployment cycles.

Join us to lead transformative projects at the forefront of real\-time multimedia technology! Your expertise will empower millions of users worldwide by delivering innovative live streaming experiences that are reliable, scalable, and engaging.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

* Enterprise\-scale solution architecture leadership, defining target architectures, technology roadmaps, design standards, and architectural governance across complex banking platforms.
* Experienced in architecting strategic banking platforms using event\-driven, API\-led, cloud\-native, and domain\-centric design principles.
* Extensive experience in designing and implementing large\-scale modernization of legacy banking applications, including migration of Deposits, pricing, interest, and accounting capabilities to strategic platforms.
* Cloud and platform transformation, leading large\-scale implementations on BCP (Barclays Cloud) or AWS with a strong focus on resilience, security, scalability, observability, and regulatory compliance.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Good understanding of Demand Deposit Accounts (DDA), Cash Management, and Liquidity Management, including account servicing, balance management, cash concentration, sweeping, pooling, virtual accounts, and liquidity optimisation solutions.
* Strong understanding of corporate banking products and services, including payments, collections, receivables, account services, and treasury management.
* Strong data architecture and database expertise across enterprise relational, distributed, and NoSQL platforms.
* Proven experience in regulatory\-driven architecture and design, ensuring auditability, traceability, data governance, and compliance with banking regulations.
* Experience delivering highly resilient and available banking platforms supporting critical customer journeys and large\-scale transaction processing.
* Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership skills, including mentoring architects, influencing strategic investment decisions, driving cross\-functional alignment, and partnering with business and operations leadership.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To lead the portfolio management team in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that portfolio management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Leading of portfolio management team, including setting of portfolio vision, management of portfolio performance, and provision of guidance and support to portfolio analysts.
* Monitoring of portfolio performance, including tracking of project progress, managing budgets, identification of thematic risks and issues, and reporting on portfolio status to senior management.
* Management of portfolio documentation, including aggregation of portfolio book of work, schedules, and budgets, and ensuring that portfolio documentation is up\-to\-date and accurate.
* Facilitation of portfolio governance, including ensuring that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives, aligned with the controls and governance standards and that portfolio thematic risks and issues are managed effectively.
* Managing the portfolio Book of Work outlining the sequence and dependencies of change initiatives, considering factors like resource availability, stakeholder buy\-in, and potential risks.
* Facilitation of change management activities, to ensure that change initiatives are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.
* Continuous improvement of portfolio management practices, including identification of areas for improvement and implementation of changes to improve portfolio performance.
* Collaboration with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that portfolio management practices are aligned with their needs and expectations.
* Development of portfolio management processes that are aligned with controls and governance standards and that support the delivery of successful projects.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

926d7eee.description:
**About Bioscan Research:** 




 Bioscan Research is an Ahmedabad\-based medical technology company focused on improving outcomes in traumatic brain injury through innovative, machine\-learning\-powered NIRS technology. Its flagship product,
 **CEREBO®** 
 , enables rapid, non\-invasive assessment of intracranial bleeding and supports earlier clinical decision\-making at the point of care.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a
 **Clinical Engagement Manager** 
 who can bridge
 **clinical science, healthcare professionals, and business development** 
 . The role will involve engaging with hospitals, clinicians, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and channel partners to communicate the clinical value of Bioscan’s technologies, develop strong institutional relationships, and support the adoption and effective use of CEREBO®. The ideal candidate should be medically or scientifically credible, confident in interacting with senior clinicians, and comfortable working in a field\-facing environment. This is a highly collaborative role requiring a combination of
 **clinical knowledge, communication, relationship management, and commercial understanding** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. **Clinical \& Medical Engagement**


* Represent Bioscan Research as a credible clinical and scientific interface for healthcare professionals.
* Engage with clinicians, hospital leadership, emergency departments, trauma teams, neurologists, neurosurgeons, intensivists, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Communicate the clinical utility, evidence, indications, limitations, and appropriate use of CEREBO® in a clear, accurate, and compliant manner.
* Understand clinical workflows and identify opportunities where Bioscan’s technologies can address unmet clinical needs.
* Gather clinical feedback, objections, requirements, and insights from the field and communicate them effectively to internal teams.
* Support the development of scientifically robust product messaging based on available clinical evidence.



  





**2\. Hospital \& Clinical Adoption** 



* Develop and maintain strong relationships with hospitals and healthcare institutions.
* Engage with multiple stakeholders within an institution to facilitate evaluation, clinical introduction, and adoption of Bioscan products.
* Conduct clinical discussions, product demonstrations, case\-based discussions, and scientific presentations for healthcare professionals.
* Understand institutional decision\-making processes and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to move clinical opportunities forward.
* Support hospitals during initial implementation and ensure appropriate clinical understanding and utilisation of the technology.
* Identify opportunities for expanding the use of Bioscan products within existing institutions.



  





**3\.KOL \& Scientific Network Development** 



* Identify and develop relationships with relevant KOLs in neurology, neurosurgery, emergency medicine, trauma, critical care, and related specialities.
* Facilitate scientific discussions, advisory boards, clinical collaborations, investigator\-led initiatives, and educational programs.
* Develop long\-term relationships with clinicians who can contribute to clinical validation, evidence generation, education, and adoption.
* Capture KOL feedback and translate clinical insights into actionable recommendations for product, clinical, and business teams.



  





**4\. Scientific Communication \& Medico\-Marketing** 



* Support the development of scientific and clinical communication materials, including presentations, brochures, CME content, clinical FAQs, case studies, and digital educational content.
* Develop and deliver CME programs, workshops, roundtables, product demonstrations, and clinical education sessions.
* Identify relevant national and international conferences, congresses, symposiums, and scientific forums for clinical engagement and institutional visibility.
* Support Bioscan's participation in conferences and scientific events.
* Ensure all external communication remains scientifically accurate, evidence\-based, and compliant.



  





**5\. Clinical Data \& Field Intelligence** 



* Collect and document clinical feedback, real\-world use cases, customer insights, and field observations.
* Maintain structured records of clinical interactions, institutional requirements, product feedback, and adoption barriers.
* Identify recurring clinical needs, objections, competitive insights, and opportunities from interactions with healthcare professionals.
* Work with the clinical and product teams to translate field insights into product improvements, evidence\-generation priorities, and educational initiatives.
* Support clinical studies, publications, grant activities, and regulatory documentation where required.



  





**6\. Channel Partner Development \& Enablement** 



* Support identification, evaluation, and onboarding of suitable channel partners.
* Build clinical capability within distributor and partner organisations through structured product and clinical training.
* Develop product presentations, clinical FAQs, objection\-handling resources, and other field\-enablement materials.
* Accompany channel partners for key institutional and clinical engagements where required.
* Provide ongoing clinical and product support to channel partners and help them effectively communicate the value proposition to healthcare professionals.
* Monitor partner feedback, market intelligence, and institutional requirements and communicate these insights internally.



  





**7\.Internal Training \& Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Train internal teams on clinical indications, product science, clinical evidence, appropriate use, and competitive differentiation.
* Work closely with Medical Affairs, Clinical, Product, Marketing, Regulatory, and Commercial teams.
* Support the development of structured clinical engagement strategies for priority hospitals, specialities, and geographies.
* Contribute to internal reviews of customer feedback, clinical adoption, competitive landscape, and market opportunities.



  





**Skills \& Experience:** 



* Degree in
 **Medicine, Life Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related healthcare discipline** 
 .
* **2–5 years of experience** 
 in medical devices, healthcare technology, medical affairs, clinical applications, or a related field.
* Experience interacting with
 **doctors, hospitals, KOLs, or healthcare institutions** 
 is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of clinical workflows and ability to discuss medical and scientific concepts with healthcare professionals.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Comfortable conducting face\-to\-face clinical discussions, product demonstrations, and presentations.
* Ability to understand clinical evidence and translate it into practical clinical value.
* Strong ownership, follow\-through, and ability to work independently in a field\-facing role.
* Willingness to travel extensively for hospital visits, conferences, clinical engagements, and partner meetings.
* Prior experience in a
 **customer\-facing medical device role** 
 will be an advantage.
