**About Neo4j**
 Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise\-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy\-to\-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
   

  

 Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
   

  

 As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
   

  

**About The Job**
 You'll play a critical role in supporting our enterprise customers early in their journey to ensure the absolute success of their architectural foundations. You'll will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production\-ready ecosystem. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor, leading new customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.
   

  

 Sitting at the heart of our customer\-first culture, you will shape tailored onboarding blueprints, orchestrate complex delivery workstreams, and guarantee a predictable, accelerated time‑to‑value. For our fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self‑managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deliver secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role (e.g., Solution Architect, Solution Engineer, Onboarding Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, or Technical Consulting).
* Hands\-on experience with production workloads in at least one major cloud provider ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Deep technical proficiency in core networking infrastructure, including VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints.
* Hands\-on experience and technical proficiency in SQL or NoSQL databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with ETL/CDC platforms and data ingestion.
* Proven track record implementing Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) design.
* Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container environments).
* Hands\-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j).
* Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk).
* Exposure to cloud compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and data residency deployment patterns.


**Responsibilities**
* Drive customer value by translating complex business requirements into tailored technical solutions that solve core business challenges and accelerate cloud adoption.
* Lead complex technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to align on success criteria, KPIs, milestones, and mitigation strategies for project risks.
* Guide the instantiation of Neo4j AuraDB environments or self\-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures utilizing private endpoints and IP allow lists.
* Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption\-at\-rest protocols, and enforce least\-privileged access through enterprise SSO and RBAC configurations.
* Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise development teams on Neo4j driver optimization, connection pooling, and retry logic.
* Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools for logs and metrics, while delivering best\-practice workshops on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
* Produce high\-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and a next\-step backlog—to seamlessly transition customers to Professional Services and Cloud Operations teams.
* Synthesise field insights and lessons learned to continuously iterate and optimise Neo4j’s global technical onboarding methodology and frameworks.

f2caa349.title: Program Manager
f2caa349.description:
What This Role Is
   

  

 Every year, hundreds of thousands of students across India decide they want to study abroad. Some come through K12 school partnerships, some find their way in directly. Either way, they enter a journey \- discovery, counseling, application, offer, enrollment \- that runs through dozens of handoffs between people, platforms, and teams. When that journey works, a student ends up at a university that fits their budget, their course, and their ambitions, and the business realizes revenue at the moment they enroll. When it doesn't, applications stall, deadlines slip, and a student who could have enrolled goes quiet.
   

  

 The problem is not that any single team is failing. It's that the highest\-leverage work in a business like this doesn't live inside one function \- it lives in the transformation and optimization projects that cut across Tech, Product, Marketing, and Operations, and someone needs to own them end to end. A funnel improvement that Marketing wants tested needs Product to build it and Tech to ship it. A new process that could remove a structural inefficiency needs someone to design it, prove it, and hand it off cleanly. Right now, that ownership happens informally, project by project, and the work that would compound doesn't get the sustained, disciplined execution it needs.
   

  

 This is where this role sits. You will run multiple 'Strategize \- Build \- Operate \- Transfer' projects a year \- some of them genuinely 0\-1 (new ideas that need user research, market research, and hypothesis testing before anyone knows if they work), some of them optimization projects on things that already exist but need better process design and a new benchmark for what good looks like. You will also be asked to take on whatever else is critical for the business to win, even when it doesn't have a job title yet.
   

  

 You will own full\-cycle delivery for these projects \- from framing the problem with the right stakeholders, through build and testing, to launch, operating it long enough to prove it works, and transferring it cleanly to whoever owns it long\-term. You are the person who makes sure a project doesn't just get discussed. It gets shipped, it gets proven, and it gets handed off in a state someone else can run with.
   

  

 What Makes This Role Different
   

  

 Most program management roles ask you to track a roadmap someone else designed. This one asks you to build the roadmap itself \- deciding what the next transformation or optimization project should even be, then owning it across three or four functions that don't naturally report to the same person. The Strategize\-Build\-Operate\-Transfer model means you don't hand a project off the moment it launches; you stay accountable until it's actually working and someone else can run it without you.
   

  

 The Manifest ecosystem gives this role real range: some projects will be genuinely 0\-1 \- a new idea nobody has tested yet \- and others will be 1\-100 \- scaling something that already works but is starting to strain under its own complexity. Few program roles at this stage give you exposure to both ends of that spectrum in the same year.
   

  

 This is a build role, not a maintenance one. There is no finished playbook for how these projects should run \- you're expected to design the frameworks, set the benchmarks, and prove through disciplined experimentation what should scale and what shouldn't.
   

  

 What You Own
   

  

**Transformation projects (Strategize \- Build \- Operate \- Transfer)**
* Translate a business problem into a project plan that Tech, Product, Marketing and Business teams can actually execute against
* Own the full lifecycle of assigned projects \- scoping, stakeholder alignment, build, testing, launch, and post\-launch review
* Own multiple SBOT\-cycle projects a year, end to end, from initial strategy through a clean operational handoff
* Define what "operate" looks like well enough to prove a project works before transferring ownership
* Ensure nothing gets handed off half\-finished \- the transfer is only complete when the receiving team can run it without you


**0\-1 initiatives**
* Lead user research, market research, and hypothesis testing on new ideas before committing resources to build them
* Design and run experiments that give a clear read on whether an idea is worth scaling
* Turn ambiguous, early\-stage problems into a testable plan within weeks, not quarters


**Optimization and process design**
* Identify structural inefficiencies across the business and turn them into scoped optimization projects
* Build the frameworks and process designs that make a function run better, not just faster
* Set new benchmarks for what "good" looks like once a process has been redesigned


**Cross\-functional execution and influence**
* Be the connective layer between Tech, Product, Marketing, and Operations so a project doesn't stall in the gap between roadmaps
* Lead cross\-functional execution through credibility, influence, and clear decision\-making rather than formal authority
* Take on whatever else is critical for the business to win, even without a predefined mandate


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 The markers below reflect where Student Placements is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In your first weeks, you're not shipping yet \- you're building a working map of how projects actually move through Tech, Product, and Marketing today, and forming a point of view on where the highest\-leverage transformation or optimization opportunities sit. You'll know you're on track when stakeholders start coming to you before a project stalls, not after.
   

  

 By the middle of your first year, you've run at least one full SBOT cycle from strategy to clean handoff, and the people around you trust that if you've said something will happen, it will. You've proven, through real experiments rather than opinion, which 0\-1 ideas are worth scaling and which aren't.
   

  

 Longer term, the way the business runs cross\-functional projects looks different because you built it that way \- frameworks that outlast the specific projects they were built for, a track record of transformations that actually stuck, and a reputation as the person who gets called in when something critical and undefined needs to happen.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

 What You Bring
   

  

 You've spent five to eight years building things inside high\-growth environments, and you've likely seen both ends of that growth curve \- the 0\-1 phase, where the job is rapid experimentation, hypothesis testing, and getting an MVP in front of real users, and the 1\-100 phase, where the job becomes process design and managing the complexity that scale creates. You know which mode a problem calls for and you don't try to apply 1\-100 rigor to a 0\-1 problem, or vice versa.
   

  

 You have real comfort operating in ambiguity, and more than that, you're fast at moving from ambiguity to clarity \- you ask the right question early, you don't wait for someone to hand you a clean brief, and you get to a workable answer quickly rather than a perfect one slowly.
   

  

 You think in first principles. When a process is broken, you don't default to the existing framework \- you rebuild the logic from the ground up and design something better, then prove it works before asking anyone to trust it.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what this role is building and your first reaction was not "this sounds like a coordination job." It was "this is exactly the kind of ambiguous, high\-leverage problem I want to be handed." That's the person this role is for.
   

  

 Why Manifest
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility \- connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.

6493300c.title: Program Manager
6493300c.description:
Join Us in Shaping the Future of AI \& Technology
 



  





 At GoML, we design and deliver next\-generation technology solutions across Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI/ML, Data Engineering, Cloud, and enterprise technology.
 



 We’re looking for an experienced Program Manager to drive internal strategic initiatives, improve cross\-functional execution, strengthen program governance, and create greater predictability across teams.
 



  





 This is primarily an internal\-facing role, working across Delivery, Engineering, Architecture, Product, Pre\-Sales, Sales, Operations, and Leadership. The goal is to improve internal execution and operational effectiveness, ultimately enabling stronger customer outcomes.
 



  





 Why You? Why Now?
 



 As GoML scales, we need stronger program management across interconnected teams and initiatives.
 



 You will bring structure to complex programs, improve visibility, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure teams stay aligned on priorities, ownership, and outcomes.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 



 First 30 Days: Understand \& Align
 


* Understand GoML’s business, technology offerings, delivery model, and internal processes.
* Build relationships across Delivery, Engineering, Product, Architecture, Operations, and Leadership.
* Review active programs, priorities, dashboards, risks, resource plans, and dependencies.
* Identify gaps in planning, ownership, communication, governance, and cross\-team coordination.
* Establish clear visibility into program health and key execution challenges.

* Own planning and execution across multiple internal programs and cross\-functional initiatives.
* Define clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables, owners, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Drive alignment across Engineering, Delivery, Product, QA, DevOps, Data, and other teams.

* Proactively identify blockers and drive mitigation and closure.
* Run structured program reviews, governance meetings, and leadership updates.

* Support capacity planning, prioritization, and resource decisions.
* Lead retrospectives and convert learnings into measurable process improvements.

 Key Responsibilities
 



 Program Management

* Define objectives, milestones, governance, dependencies, ownership, and success measures.

 Cross\-Functional Execution

 Risk \& Governance

* Identify recurring inefficiencies and coordination gaps.

5792aa4d.description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Position : Principal, Cloud Data Platform Engineer**
======================================================

**Position Overview**
---------------------


The Principal \- Cloud Data Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high\-performance cloud\-based data platforms that support analytics, machine learning, and enterprise data needs. This role ensures that data solutions are optimized for performance, cost, and reliability, while meeting governance, compliance, and business requirements. The engineer collaborates closely with data scientists, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver modern data capabilities on cloud platforms. Should have deep technical expertise, strong design judgment, and the ability to influence without authority.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Platform Engineering \& Development**

* Design, implement, and maintain cloud\-native data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).
* Develop and optimize data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and processing of structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data.
* Build reusable frameworks and automation for data workflows, monitoring, and scaling.
* Ensure data storage and compute solutions are optimized for performance, security, and cost efficiency.
* Integrate cloud data services with enterprise applications, APIs, and third\-party tools.

### **Data Management \& Governance**

* Implement data quality, lineage, and cataloging solutions across the data platform.
* Enforce governance, security, and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2\).
* Work with architects and security teams to implement role\-based access, encryption, and audit controls.
* Support metadata management, data discoverability, and enterprise\-wide data democratization.

### **Operations \& Reliability**

* Manage the operational health of the cloud data platform, including monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting.
* Establish CI/CD pipelines for data services and platform components.
* Implement disaster recovery, backup, and failover strategies.
* Continuously optimize platform performance, cost, and scalability.

### **Collaboration \& Innovation**

* Partner with data scientists, BI teams, and application developers to enable advanced analytics and AI/ML workloads.
* Evaluate emerging cloud data services and recommend adoption based on enterprise needs.
* Provide technical expertise in designing cloud\-based data architectures and solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in cloud engineering and data development.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Education \& Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* **15\+ years of total work experience** in technology infrastructure.
* 10\+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, or platform engineering.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure).
* Strong experience with big data and data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Databricks, Flink).
* Proven expertise in building data pipelines with tools like Apache Airflow, dbt, Kafka, or similar.

### **Skills \& Competencies:**

* In\-depth knowledge and experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or similar cloud data platforms.
* Extensive knowledge and real hands\-on experience of AI/ML data pipelines and feature engineering.
* Exposure to regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
* Proficiency in SQL and one or more programming languages (Python, Java, or Scala).
* Deep understanding of cloud\-native data services (e.g., AWS Redshift, Glue, S3, Athena; Azure Synapse, Data Factory; GCP BigQuery, Dataflow).
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).
* Knowledge of FinOps principles for cost\-efficient data platform design.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Excellent communication, mentorship, and ability to influence cross\-functional teams.

**Key Success Metrics**
-----------------------

* Uptime, performance, and reliability of the cloud data platform.
* Data availability, quality, and accessibility for business and analytics use cases.
* Efficiency and scalability of data pipelines and processing.
* Cost optimization and resource utilization of cloud data services.
* Adoption and satisfaction of data platform services by business and analytics teams

**Success Indicators**
----------------------

* Stable, scalable, and secure data platforms running in production.
* Reduced data incidents and faster root‑cause resolution.
* Improved developer productivity through reusable frameworks and standards.
* Strong technical mentorship and uplift of data engineering capabilities.
* Trusted technical advisor to architecture, security, and business leadership.
 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:
   

  

 At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital landscape with cutting\-edge, tailored strategies.
   

  

 We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post\-launch, we've earned the distinction of being Salesforce's \#1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.
   

  

 Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI\-powered transformation. Here, you'll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI\-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you're ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.
   

  

 As a Technical Architect, Data \& AI focused on Salesforce Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud) and Agentforce, you will be responsible for owning the end\-to\-end technical solution that turns unified customer data into intelligent, AI\-powered experiences for our clients. You'll have the opportunity to make significant contributions to our success by working with the rest of our talented AI and Data team to delight customers.
   

  

 This position is focused on architecting and executing technical solutions across the Data 360 and Agentforce platform—designing scalable data models, identity resolution strategies, real\-time activation patterns, and the agentic solutions built on top of them.
   

  

**You'll have the opportunity to:**
* Lead and own the technical solution design across Data 360 and Agentforce—including data streams, DLOs, DMOs, identity resolution, calculated insights, segments, real\-time activation, and the agent topics, instructions, and actions that consume that data.
* Design scalable and secure data architectures on Salesforce Data 360—defining ingestion patterns, harmonization, identity resolution rules, and zero\-copy / data federation strategies.
* Deep dive into the limits and boundaries of Data 360 and Agentforce, finding novel solutions to drive business outcomes.
* Architect RAG and Generative AI solutions leveraging Unstructured DMOs, Retrievers, Search Indexes, and Document Processing, applying RAG best practices.
* Collaborate with customers, Project Managers, Solution Architects, Developers, and UX Designers to translate business needs into well\-architected solutions.
* Oversee and contribute to all stages of the project lifecycle—from initial design through development, testing, and final deployment.
* Define integration frameworks and reference architectures connecting Data 360, MuleSoft, enterprise data warehouses, and other systems using real\-time and batch patterns.
* Establish DevOps, source control, and CI/CD practices for data and AI solutions.
* Coach and mentor developers and junior architects, and follow and understand new Salesforce products and technical capabilities.


**Required Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of experience in application, data, or software development and architecture
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with the Salesforce Platform in a development or architecture role
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field
* Hands\-on experience architecting and implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud)—data streams, DLOs, DMOs, identity resolution, calculated insights, and activation
* Proficiency in SQL and Apex, with exposure or working knowledge of modern coding languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java)
* Experience designing data integration patterns across enterprise systems (MuleSoft, ETL/ELT tooling, data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift)
* Understanding of data modeling, governance, security, and privacy best practices
* Experience with source control, branching/pull request strategies, and familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps principles
* Strong communication skills; the ability to convey complex technical details to all audiences


**Preferred Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with Agentforce or other Generative AI / agentic platforms
* Experience building RAG solutions with Unstructured DMOs, Retrievers, and Search Indexes
* Salesforce certifications, preferably Data Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or Agentforce Specialist
* Experience defining robust testing approaches for data and GenAI solutions


**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
*All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.*
 What's it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?
   

  

* Remote \& In\-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we're focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
* Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet\-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
* Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in\-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9\-5 isn't possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
* Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it's a no\-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls \& company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
* Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don't forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

bae18999.description:
This position will involve assisting in the delivery of the Firm’s Fund Solutions and Restructuring services based in Mumbai and/or Delhi. Typical assignments will include participating in fund and restructuring advisory, asset wind down support and asset management projects.
   

  

 Our Fund Solutions and Restructuring professionals serve as financial advisors to fund managers, companies, financial sponsors, lenders, creditors and other interested parties in special and distressed situations across virtually every industry and every situation throughout the business life cycle.
   

  

 As a VP/Manager, Fund Solutions, you will be responsible for supporting complex fund liquidation and wind\-down engagements across jurisdictions. This role will be based in India and will collaborate closely with global teams in the U.S., Europe, and APAC to manage, lead and deliver high\-quality solutions to asset managers, fund administrators, and institutional investors navigating end\-of\-life fund scenarios. In addition to training junior staff members, the successful candidate will work on a range of assignments including supporting the global teams including management of fund operations (mainly in End Of Fund Life situations for global funds) such as accounting, taxation, legal and investor relations. You will also work on asset management, financial analysis, NAV workings and exit related strategies for such funds. The candidate will support the growth of the Fund Solutions and Restructuring business in the Asia \& EMEA region.
   

  

**Navigating Responsibilities**
* Coordinating and working with multiple teams across Kroll to ensure deadlines are met and proactively communicate progress/updates with external stakeholders.
* Review the work of the junior team members, coordinate and manage workflow amongst the team and ensure timely delivery of the projects.
* Understanding public and private databases like Pitchbook, Preqin and Capital IQ is a plus.
* Review fund documentation (LPAs, IMs, governing documents) to identify constraints and obligations.
* Draft and present liquidation strategy memos, investor updates, and board\-level communications.
* Oversee the efficient and timely progression of a portfolio of Fund Solutions and Restructuring projects.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Understanding of valuation concepts
* Strong hold on accounting and financial concepts.
* Prior exposures to fund structures, such as master/feeder, management fee, carry etc. is preferred
* Ability to interpret and apply foreign rules, regulations and laws is a plus. Ability to work in regulated environments like SEC, Cayman, Mauritius etc.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with fund managers, financial sponsors, creditors, asset agents and solicitors.


**Essential Traits**

CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. The solution architect works independently on assigned deliverables, taking direction and priorities from the senior solution architect, while managing day to day execution autonomously. Key will be to deliver timely data products or expose data from sources via the enterprise data platform for use in the assigned strategic initiative. It is recognized some creativity might be applied to get data timely in a safe and secure manner, while paving the way for the strategic solution.
   

  

 Act as the primary architecture point of contact across both projects for deliverables specified by the senior solution architect .
   

  

 Facilitate decision making between business, data, engineering, security, and vendor teams.
   

  

 Manage architecture risks, technical debt, and cross project dependencies.
   

  

 Influence senior stakeholders and delivery teams through clear communication and architecture leadership.

 Solution \& Data Architecture

 Creating architecture artefacts as per ways of working
   

  

 Define data products, information models, data flows, and integration patterns.
   

  

 Design scalable data architectures supporting analytics, AI, and operational use cases.
   

  

 Ensure consistent master, reference, and transactional data management principles.
   

  

 Establish data governance, lineage, quality, ownership, and lifecycle practices.
   

  

 Work with Data Architects and Data Engineers to ensure architecture standards are implemented effectively.

 Data products
   

  

 Streaming and batch processing

 Data observability
   

  

 DataOps practices
   

  

 AI \& Advanced Analytics
   

  

 Support architecture decisions involving AI, GenAI, and agent\-based solutions.
   

  

 Guide the adoption of Microsoft Foundry and Databricks based AI capabilities.
   

  

 Ensure security, governance, responsible AI, and operational considerations are embedded into solution designs.
   

  

 Stakeholder Management
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities

f2133d28.title: Coupa Program Manager
f2133d28.description:
**Coupa Program Manager**  

**Location: Gurugram, India**  

**The role requires working the U.S. shift to support U.S. stakeholders (the latest shift end time will be approximately midnight IST).**  

**3\-Month Contract to Hire role**  

**$37/hr USD \| No C2C**

  

Our client, a leading SaaS company, is seeking a Coupa Program Manager to take ownership and provide strategic leadership for our Coupa ecosystem. This is a senior, hands\-on role for someone who is passionate about building a world\-class Procure\-to\-Pay function. You will be the organization's foremost expert on Coupa, accountable for its performance, roadmap, and adoption.  

A key part of your mission will be to act as a strategic and influential partner to the Procurement department, guiding the team in best practices and shaping how the platform is managed to maximize efficiency and value. You will also serve as the technical lead and mentor for team members who assist with Coupa operations, helping to elevate their skills and ensure operational excellence.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Assume primary ownership of the Coupa platform, serving as the lead strategist responsible for its day\-to\-day stability and long\-term strategic improvements.
* Architect and implement end\-to\-end P2P solutions, driving the adoption of new features and managing platform release cycles.
* Influence and guide the Procurement team on process optimization, ensuring the platform's configuration and usage align with strategic business goals.
* Guide, mentor, and upskill team members.
* Serve as the escalation point for the most complex technical issues, including integration troubleshooting and advanced configuration challenges.
* Maintain and optimize all core Coupa configurations (e.g., business rules, approval chains, chart of accounts, and suppliers).
* Proactively monitor and enforce data quality standards across supplier data, catalogs, and accounting structures.
* Perform basic ad\-hoc operational tasks in Workday Financials as needed to assist the wider finance team.
* Create and own all documentation for processes, configurations, and best practices.

 **Qualifications \& Experience**

  

* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in a Coupa\-focused role with a clear progression towards platform ownership and strategy.
* Deep, expert\-level knowledge of Coupa modules, including Procure\-to\-Order (P2O), and their associated architectures.
* Proven ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders and business partners, particularly within Procurement functions.
* Strong understanding of system configuration, business rules, complex approval workflows, user roles, and integration points.
* Experience mentoring team members and providing technical guidance.
* Excellent problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work independently and lead through influence.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Significant experience with Coupa integrations, particularly with ERP systems like Workday Financials.
* Configuration experience in Workday Financials.
* Experience in change management, process documentation, or developing internal training programs.
* Coupa certifications (e.g., Coupa Admin, Coupa Certified Professional, or Solutions Architect) are strongly preferred.

667ec715.title: Regional HR Service Delivery Manager (APAC)
667ec715.description:
The Regional HR Service Delivery Manager will play a pivotal role in building and overseeing HR service delivery operations for their assigned region, ensuring client and employee HR tickets and inquiries are resolved accurately and on time as Globalli scales. This role builds the team, infrastructure, and knowledge base needed to support HR service delivery, while navigating global HR rules and client\-specific cases to maintain compliance and adherence to regulatory standards across the region.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


### **Regional HR Service Delivery and Scalability**


* Serve as the regional subject matter expert for HR processes, country\-specific requirements, and client\-specific case handling.
* Establish and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and a knowledge base that enable the team to operate accurately and consistently as headcount and client volume scale.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Payroll Operations, Account Management, Product, Legal, and Risk \& Compliance to enhance HR service delivery and educate internal teams.
* Manage client and employee HR tickets and inquiries, ensuring timely resolution and high client and employee satisfaction.
* Troubleshoot HR service delivery issues and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to reach timely resolutions across multiple employment models.
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including case\-handling guides and compliant standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Build out and lead a regional team of HR Delivery Specialists and Employee Relationship Coordinators to support Globalli's growth.

### **HR Service Delivery Compliance, Escalations and Regional Readiness**


* Regional HR service ownership: Oversee Globalli's ability to deliver HR services within the assigned region, aligning operational capacity with business demand.
* Compliance navigation: Apply global and regional HR rules and regulations to client\-specific and cross\-border cases to maintain compliance and adherence to regulatory standards.
* Issue resolution: Investigate and resolve HR service escalations and complex client or employee cases.
* Documentation and reporting: Maintain accurate, audit\-ready documentation of HR service processes, controls, and compliance.
* Regulatory monitoring: Track and interpret HR legislation and regulatory changes, document impacts, and communicate updates to internal teams.
* Escalation management: Serve as the escalation point for client and employee HR complaints, ensuring they are managed fairly and effectively and root causes addressed to prevent recurrence.
* Implementation oversight: Coordinate and oversee the onboarding of new countries and clients into HR service delivery, ensuring scalable operational processes.
* Local vendor engagement: Coordinate with local vendors, including local counsel, as need to support compliant HR service delivery in region\-specific and complex cases.
* KPI and SLA management: Monitor KPIs and SLAs for HR service delivery across the region.

**What You'll Bring:**
----------------------


* 5\+ years of proven HR service delivery experience managing multi\-country or regional HR operations in a high\-growth or startup environment.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex information clearly across formats.
* Hands\-on experience building and scaling a team and its supporting infrastructure (SOPs, knowledge base) in a fast\-growing environment.
* Working knowledge of global HR rules and regulations, with the ability to apply them to client\-specific and cross\-border cases.
* Comfortable working remotely and independently in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* Multilingual capabilities (English required; additional languages a plus).
* Client\-Centric Approach: Experience supporting high\-touch enterprise accounts and managing escalations with professionalism.
* Problem\-Solving Skills: Skilled in resolving complex client and employee HR tickets and inquiries in a timely manner.
* Adaptability: Thrive in ambiguity and adapt quickly to shifting priorities and jurisdictions.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong documentation skills with a focus on building infrastructure and knowledge bases that support scale.

a898c98e.description:
**What is special about Lighthouse?**
 Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.
   

  

**What’s unique about this role?**
 Solution Consultants in the AI \& Analytics group are specialists focused on managing the application of our proprietary predictive AI and GenAI solutions for specific litigations and investigations. They also play a key role in designing and refining enterprise analytics programs for our corporate clients.
   

  

 As part of an innovation\-focused team, Lighthouse AI \& Analytics consultants play a pivotal role in articulating and prioritizing the requirements for the next wave of our proprietary tools and play a central role in validating functionality of new tools once developed. This role is both highly consultative and highly process/tech\-oriented requiring a deep knowledge of discovery workflows and requirements, and high literacy with respect to the state\-of\-the\-art in discovery review and analytics technology.
   

  

**What will this person do?**
* Execution of AI \& Analytics client projects, including:
+ Scoping and implementation on projects leveraging predictive AI, GenAI, and/or structured analytics.
+ Ensuring client requirements remain current across the lifecycle of the engagement and (re)aligning development approach to those requirements.
+ Meticulous data tracking, statistical validation design and implementation, and metrics reporting to support the transparency and accountability of algorithmic discovery review.
+ Coordination with support and technical teams across the organization to ensure we are leveraging the full suite of LH capabilities to provide best\-in\-class support and value to our clients.
+ Tracking and escalating project risk concerns up the chain, as necessary.
+ Providing end\-of\-project metrics to inform ROI analyses and quarterly business reviews.

* Contribution to operational initiatives, including:
+ Documenting lessons learned for internal discussion and process/technology improvements.
+ Implementing and updating AI \& Analytics training curriculum (composed of a suite of documentation, simulation activities, and evaluation) for new members of the team or secondees from other groups who are supporting AI \& Analytics workflows.
+ Providing requirements analysis and user validation input to our product development teams.
+ Collaborating with marketing, client success, and sales on client\-facing overviews of Lighthouse AI \& Analytics solutions.


**Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you had the following:**
* Advanced degree preferred in relevant discipline (law, technology, statistics)
* Minimum 5 years’ litigation or eDiscovery industry experience required.
* Minimum 3 years advanced analytics in eDiscovery required.
* Prior in\-house corporate legal, law firm legal staff or eDiscovery vendor experience required.
* Excellent knowledge of eDiscovery technology, including key applications and programs such as Relativity Analytics, Relativity aiR, Reveal (Brainspace), and comparable analytics platforms.
* Excellent knowledge of litigation support and legal discovery process and concepts
* Proven success and desire to consult with clients/internal departments, projecting expertise and solving day\-to\-day challenges as well as strategic challenges.
* Experience leading complex projects and managing multidisciplinary teams from other departments preferred.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills with clients and internal staff (demonstrated both in relaxed atmosphere and under pressure)
* Customer service demeanor: consultative, approachable, respectful, and polite
* Ability to multitask under pressure.


**Work Environment and Physical Demands**
* Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table.
* Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting.
* Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).


 Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment where everyone can feel safe, is respected, and can show up as themselves. Come as you are!
   

  

 As required by applicable pay transparency laws, Lighthouse complies with compensation disclosure requirements for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location, or other relevant factors. The salary range for this position may be tailored to be lower or higher in different talent markets.
   

  

 This role will be eligible to participate in an annual bonus or incentive program.
   

  

 As a trailblazer and catalyst for change, Lighthouse rises to each opportunity to help our clients, and our people do what they do best—shine.
   

  

 This position will work for and be employed by Lighthouse's India subsidiary, which is an independent company located in India.

017dcc13.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**About The Role \& Team**
**As a member of our newly established
 **ERP Make \& Asset Management team** 
 within Roche Digital Technology (RDT), you will be a vital asset in driving our global operations forward. We are looking for a collaborative expert who doesn't just configure systems, but deeply understands
 **end\-to\-end (E2E) manufacturing process flows** 
 and integration dynamics in a complex, multi\-partner environment.**
**Rather than working in a silo, you will work hand\-in\-hand with Roche internal teams and global vendors to ensure seamless daily operations and drive continuous business improvements. If you thrive on taking true ownership, connecting the dots across system boundaries, and diving into complex supply chain networks to solve tough challenges, this role is built for you.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* E2E Solution Delivery \& Integration: Work as a key contributor within the Make team to design, deliver, and support ERP capabilities supporting External Manufacturing and collaboration platforms (GEP Nexxe). Drive strong integration logic across internal SAP modules and partner platforms
* Process Flow \& Operations Support: Ensure smooth daily operations while supporting the business with new features, integrations, and changing operational needs. Apply a strong "process\-first" mindset to ensure end\-to\-end data integrity across system boundaries
* E2E Ownership \& Problem Solving: Take full accountability for complex, cross\-system operational and technical challenges. Dig deep into end\-to\-end process flows to identify root causes and proactively propose sustainable, scalable solutions—even when navigating crowded stakeholder environments
* Stakeholder \& Partner Collaboration: Act as a core bridge between Roche internal business teams, RDT cross functional teams and external system provider. Facilitate clear communication, align expectations, and foster strong team dynamics across a multi\-player matrix
* Continuous Improvement \& Innovation: Continuously evaluate current solutions against business requirements to streamline external partner collaboration, reduce friction, and align with global ERP roadmaps


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Domain Expertise: Solid hands\-on experience in SAP ERP / S/4HANA (MM \& QM modules). Demonstrated expertise in External Manufacturing and collaboration tools (e.g., SAP Ariba, SNC, E2open, Coupa, or O9 Solutions), with proven experience integrating these tools with S/4HANA using middleware such as Mulesoft, SAP CPI, or Tibco
* End\-to\-End \& Integration Thinking: Strong understanding of E2E manufacturing process flows and key integration points (Procurement, Inventory Management, Quality Control, Supply Chain, and Third\-Party System Interfaces via middleware/APIs)
* Curious \& Analytical Mindset: High analytical capabilities combined with a relentless curiosity to see "the big picture." You are not satisfied with surface\-level fixes; you take pride in understanding why a process works and taking the effort to solve complex topics thoroughly
* Self\-Driven \& Accountable: A self\-starter who takes personal ownership of outcomes. Comfortable taking the lead, going the extra mile to get alignment, and navigating ambiguous or high\-touch situations involving multiple stakeholders
* Business Process First: Advanced problem\-solving skills with a strong process\-oriented mindset. You understand business operational impact, not just system configuration
* Global \& Collaborative Mindset: Demonstrated experience working effectively across cross\-functional, global teams and external vendor environments. Experience in Agile / SAFe framework methodologies is a plus
* Education: University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, Supply Chain Management, or an equivalent combination of education and experience


****What We Offer You****
* The opportunity to be a foundational part of a newly forming, business\-critical global RDT team
* A hybrid, flexible working model based out of our state\-of\-the\-art facility in Hyderabad
* A team culture driven by psychological safety, shared success, and continuous learning


**\#Hyderabad2026**
 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

**About the Role**



PrismHR is the technology engine behind Vensure Employer Solutions, and the infrastructure underneath it — our Azure cloud environment, our Windows and Linux systems, and the automation and monitoring that keep it all running — has to be dependable. We're looking for a Principal Infrastructure Engineer to join a tight\-knit, five\-person infrastructure team responsible for day\-to\-day operations across our environment, not a single fixed project.



Beyond the day\-to\-day, you'll be expected to take real ownership of significant initiatives as they come up — including an upcoming Windows Server 2025 upgrade and a database version upgrade. You'll be trusted to drive these forward independently, with minimal oversight.


**Why Communication Matters So Much for This Role**



We want to be upfront about something: the previous person in this role struggled with communication — not being direct in answers, not documenting work clearly, and going quiet during projects instead of staying engaged and visible. That created real problems for the team. So for this hire, clear and direct communication, solid written documentation, and staying engaged and visible throughout a project are treated as core requirements, not soft extras.


**What You'll Do**


* Own day\-to\-day infrastructure operations across a small, close\-knit team — this is a hands\-on operational role, not a narrowly scoped project assignment.
* Design, manage, and troubleshoot cloud infrastructure in Azure, including networking, load balancing, and network segmentation.
* Own disaster recovery readiness, including Azure Site Recovery configuration, testing, and failover.
* Administer and maintain a primarily Windows environment (\~70% of systems), along with Linux systems.
* Maintain and extend configuration management using Puppet.
* Manage containerized workloads using Docker, including Docker Swarm.
* Support and improve monitoring using Zabbix and Grafana, with an eye toward future adoption of Prometheus and Azure Monitor.
* Take ownership of major initiatives as they arise — including the upcoming Windows Server 2025 and database version upgrades — driving them from planning through execution.
* Document your work clearly and consistently, and communicate progress, blockers, and decisions directly and proactively to the team.

**What We're Looking For**


* **Clear, direct communication and sustained engagement** — you give straight answers, document your work as you go, explain what you're doing and why, and stay visibly engaged throughout a project from start to finish. This is one of the most important things we're evaluating for this specific hire.
* **Strong Azure cloud infrastructure experience** — networking, load balancing, and segmentation. Azure is our primary infrastructure environment, so this is a core requirement. AWS experience is a plus but not required.
* **Disaster recovery experience, ideally with Azure Site Recovery** — this is close to a firm requirement given how central DR readiness is to this role.
* **Strong systems administration skills across Windows and Linux** — with Windows prioritized, since roughly 70% of our systems run Windows.
* **Puppet experience** — our current configuration management platform. Chef or Ansible experience is acceptable if you can demonstrate you can translate that experience to Puppet.
* **Strong Docker experience** — particularly with Docker Swarm and Docker Community Edition.
* **Monitoring experience** — Zabbix and Grafana experience is directly relevant; familiarity with Prometheus or Azure Monitor is a plus as we look to expand our monitoring stack.
* **Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills** — both are considered highly important for this role.
* **Comfort owning significant initiatives independently** — you'll be expected to drive major projects like upgrades forward with minimal hand\-holding.
* **PEO, payroll, benefits, compliance, or tax systems experience is not required** — general familiarity with these concepts is helpful but is not a requirement for this role.
* **Based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh** and available on\-site for a split shift aligned to 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time.

**Why Join Us**


* Real ownership — you'll drive significant initiatives, not just tickets, from day one.
* A small, close\-knit team where your communication and follow\-through are genuinely valued and visible.
* A modern, Azure\-centric infrastructure environment with real investment in disaster recovery and monitoring maturity.

A principal\-level role with genuine autonomy and trust.

\#DistroRPO
\#LI\-PROMOTED
\#LI\-Onsite

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

25800118.title: Program Manager - Operations
25800118.description:
**Overview:** 
 Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as India’s no. 1 RPM Company.
   

  

 We are seeking visionary individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. As a part of our dynamic team, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with top healthcare providers in the country, applying AI\-powered RPM solutions to tackle some of the most pressing challenges in healthcare \- enhancing staff efficiency, improving patient outcomes, and pioneering the next generation of care models.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager to own and drive high\-priority business and operational initiatives for Dozee India Business. This is a high\-ownership role where you will take projects from problem definition to execution and scale.
   

  

 The role requires someone who is comfortable working with ambiguity, figuring out unknowns, coordinating across teams, and adapting the approach based on learnings.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own projects end\-to\-end — from defining the problem and approach to execution and measurable outcomes
* Build processes and solutions from scratch where there is no existing playbook
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Sales, Operations, Customer Success, Product, Technology and Finance
* Identify bottlenecks, solve problems and pivot quickly based on data and feedback
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement and drive their implementation
* Build dashboards, trackers and operating mechanisms to improve visibility and execution
* Track key metrics and regularly communicate progress, risks and outcomes to leadership
* Distributor Channel Management: Build and operationalize processes, tracking mechanisms and performance dashboards for Dozee's distributor network.
* Digital Outreach Automation: Design and automate client outreach journeys, including segmentation, communication workflows, follow\-ups and performance tracking.


 Other projects may span
 **business operations, customer success, sales, automation and strategic initiatives** 
 .
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* Graduate from a Tier\-1 college/institute
* 2–6 years of experience in program management, consulting, strategy \& operations, business operations, product operations or similar roles
* Experience executing projects from scratch and handling ambiguous problem statements
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Strong cross\-functional stakeholder management skills
* Hands\-on experience with automation, AI, no\-code/low\-code tools or process improvement
* Strong ownership, execution orientation and ability to work independently
* Excellent communication and ability to manage multiple priorities


**Vision \& Mission**
**Save Million lives with Health AI**
 Dozee is India’s leading AI\-Powered
 **contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)** 
 and
 **Early Warning System (EWS).** 
 A solution that continuously monitors patients and provides early warnings of clinical deterioration, enabling timely interventions and enhancing patient safety in hospitals, nursing facilities and patient homes. A
 **"Made in India for the World"** 
 solution, Dozee has pioneered the world’s first non\-contact blood pressure monitoring system. Trusted by leading healthcare providers in India, the USA, and Africa, Dozee is transforming patient safety and care by enhancing outcomes and reducing costs.
   

  

 Dozee is adopted by
 **300\+ hospitals** 
 and

 . Dozee has monitored over

 Delivered

 and Saved

34c8af5f.title: Technical Program Manager
34c8af5f.description:
**About The Company**
 Abacus.AI is a pioneering company in the field of Generative AI, dedicated to shaping the future of work through innovative AI\-powered solutions. Our mission is to empower enterprises and professionals with intelligent tools that automate workflows, boost productivity, and unlock new levels of operational capabilities. With a focus on cutting\-edge technology, we develop platforms that are transforming industries and setting new standards in AI applications. Our flagship products, ChatLLM and DeepAgent, are rapidly expanding AI platforms trusted by thousands of users worldwide, reflecting our commitment to delivering scalable, reliable, and impactful AI solutions.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an exceptional Technical Program Manager to join our dynamic team remotely from India. In this role, you will be instrumental in driving the successful execution of complex engineering, product, and business initiatives as we scale our AI platform. Your expertise will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with strategic business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, product management, design, quality assurance, and leadership, to coordinate efforts and facilitate seamless communication. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a proven track record of managing large\-scale programs in fast\-paced environments.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 4–7 years of professional experience in program or project management within a technical environment.
* Current role as a Technical Program Manager or Technical Project Manager.
* Solid understanding of software development processes and system architecture.
* Experience managing complex, cross\-functional engineering programs from inception to completion.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, design, QA, and executive teams.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and execution skills.
* Experience working in fast\-paced product organizations with weekly or faster release cycles.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities with a bias for action.
* Experience in billing, payments, subscriptions, invoicing, revenue systems, or financial transactions.
* Preferred: Experience at a payments or fintech company or ownership of billing/payment initiatives.


**Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of strategic technical programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Develop comprehensive program plans, define key milestones, and monitor progress to ensure timely delivery.
* Manage dependencies, identify risks, resolve blockers, and coordinate efforts across multiple teams.
* Drive alignment and communication among engineering, product, design, and business stakeholders.
* Lead release planning activities, ensuring high\-quality releases on schedule.
* Track and report on program health using relevant metrics, providing regular updates to leadership.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements to enhance engineering efficiency and delivery predictability.
* Ensure all initiatives are executed in accordance with business priorities and customer impact considerations.


**Benefits**
 At Abacus.AI, we value our team members and offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your professional growth and personal well\-being. You will have the opportunity to work remotely, providing flexibility and work\-life balance. Our benefits include competitive compensation packages, health insurance coverage, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment that encourages innovation and continuous learning. Additionally, you will be part of a forward\-thinking company that is at the forefront of AI technology, with ample opportunities to contribute to groundbreaking projects and advance your career in a rapidly evolving industry.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Abacus.AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and excellence, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive and succeed.
